202001.description:
Unable to believe that the person who sent the flowers was the king, Luna journeys to the Land of the Dead in place of the princess.

Luna's goal, with the special ability to speak with flowers, is to become a "flower master" who, like her late parents, uses the blessings of flowers to improve people's lives. Undaunted by her harsh circumstances, she continues to work hard, and one day, the path to becoming an apprentice to a "royal flower master" opens up. Little does she know that this leads to a fateful encounter...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 骸骨王と身代わりの王女 ルーナと臆病な王様
title.romaji: Gaikotsu Ou to Migawari no Oujo Luna to Okubyou na Ou-sama

202002.description:
Charlotte, the princess of Valose, is an eccentric person with a penchant for beautiful people, due to a childhood misconception that "love = beauty = happiness." She has repeatedly turned down marriage proposals, saying she can't compromise, but her fiancé tells her she'll never find love if she continues like this... She secretly travels to a neighboring country to scout out her soulmate!

A free-spirited princess longing for love sets out on a journey in search of it!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 箱入り皇女は至高の恋をお望みです！ ～理想の殿方を探す旅に出ます。ただし、美しい者以外認めません!?～
title.romaji: Hakoiri Koujou wa Shikou no Koi wo Onozomi desu!: Risou no Tonogata wo Sagasu Tabi ni Demasu. Tadashi, Utsukushisha Igai Mitomemasen!?

202003.description:
A bittersweet, romantic tale of the imperial capital, woven by a young businessman from a count's family and a lonely, orphaned girl.

After losing both parents in a freak accident, Komura Hina, a young girl scorned as a "daughter of a deserted house," never gave up her pride. Now all alone, Hina endures relentless harassment every day from her uncle, Hisanao, who is obsessed with her late mother... One day, Toki Miyataka, a young businessman known for his ruthlessness and ruthlessness, appears and proposes a contract marriage, taking advantage of his family's advantages.

"I'll put it bluntly: Become my wife."

Their married life began with mutual interests. Furthermore, Toki, who is fighting for the earl's succession, is surrounded by enemies, and Hina becomes embroiled in a twisted web of love, hate, and revenge.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 侯爵令嬢の嫁入り ～その運命は契約結婚から始まる～
title.romaji: Koushaku Reijou no Yomeiri: Sono Unmei wa Keiyaku Kekkon kara Hajimaru

202004.description:
The nationally popular girl group coc9tail has announced that they will be disbanding by the end of the year! Among the fans shocked by the sudden news was the hugely popular actor Hiiragi Misato. Misato's "oshi" is one of the members, Mayuzumi Ibuki. Because Misato supports Ibuki, a top idol, in a pure and honest way, they have maintained a "fan distance" despite being in the same agency, but with Ibuki's retirement approaching, their relationship is about to change...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

202005.description:
Elentina, the daughter of an Earl, has decided to remain single for the rest of her life, hiding the fact that she is a "witch." Just when she was finally able to break off her engagement with the man her father had chosen for her, Duke Arden has somehow proposed to her!?

I don't want to get married while keeping my true identity a secret...so I'll have to break off our engagement again!

She decides to do this and tries all sorts of schemes, but the Duke won't give up at all!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 独身主義の令嬢は、公爵様の溺愛から逃れたい
title.romaji: Dokushin Shugi no Reijou wa, Koushaku-sama no Dekiai kara Nogaretai

202006.description:
The manga will tell the life story of Ukita Naoie, the "assassination daimyō" and "dark hero" of the Sengoku period.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 殺っちゃえ!! 宇喜多さん

202007.description:
He was the swordsmanship instructor to the third Tokugawa Shogun, Iemitsu, and a legendary swordsman.

What if Yagyu Jubei was a woman? This is the latest work by master Nagai Go, set in a grand historical what-if scenario. The highly popular serialization in Weekly Post, a sexy period drama in which the more she strips off, the stronger she becomes, begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

202008.description:
The "Ruler," a god-like alien creature with immense power to rule the universe. Halil, a mixed-race boy forced to kill his own family, is destined to rule the planet he was born on, Myvana. This is the story of Halil, who must choose between his human desire for a family and his alien instincts, as he searches for his true identity and calling.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

202009.description:
Erika has endured countless slights at the hands of her mother’s charge, the wealthy daughter of the Blanche home. But when the girl falls ill, Erika’s mother is jailed by her father, the cruel Marquis Blanche. To free her, Erika must play the role of the Marquis’ daughter in a sham marriage with Lord Sebastian Aklief. Sworn to secrecy, Erika must rely on her kind heart and newly awakening powers to help her navigate this new world of intrigue, magic, and mystery to free her mother—and herself!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I’m A Fake Bride Who’ll Run Away Someday

title.english: I'm the Fake Bride Who Plans to Run Away

title.native: 触ってみなくちゃ分かんないよっ！

202011.description:
Youhei, a talented writer, and Kazuki, an office worker, live together in a suburban apartment. Inspired by the Edo-period cookbook "Hyakuchinmono," Youhei attempts to create ten dishes from a single ingredient for his next novel, and Kazuki gets caught up in the process... What will the "mouthfuls" of broad beans, potatoes, and corn taste like as they enjoy their time in the kitchen?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

202012.description: Rokka, whose great-grandmother was a superintendant and was suddenly hospitalized, and was suddenly made the new caretaker of a share house instead of her busy parents has many problems had many problems in her personality. It's a story she suddenly fell into just after failing her unversity entrance exam. When she reluctantly visited the house, there were many colorful residents, a bright white dog, and a finally an unfamiliar man living there. The interactions between the puzzling man and the other residents changed her heart.

title.native: しらゆき荘の小人さん
いんびりの村 －顔の同じ男たち－
title.romaji: Inbiri no Mura: Kao no Onaji Otokotachi

202014.description:
Sora has always lived her life without telling anyone about her strong psychic abilities. Because of this, she was forced to quit the company she joined right after graduating. Feeling miserable, she suddenly receives a will from her estranged grandfather... Starting a new life as the caretaker of the mysterious Daikanyama apartment complex, Houmeikan, Sora finds herself embroiled in one strange incident after another. Watched over by her taciturn and handsome childhood friend Reo and Houmeikan's resident and acting caretaker, Midou, Sora begins to find her place in the world as she interacts with the mysterious residents.

A thrilling and growing occult work story!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Stronger than most, Gyeong-Ja Yuk is back! After a tough day, Kyung-Ja, having broken up with her lover and repeatedly failing at finding a job, receives a job offer from a major corporation called "The Shield." With no academic background or connections, Gyeong-Ja is skeptical, but dreams of a warm and comfortable office job, so she goes for an interview...

but the company, its employees, and the interviewees are all unusual?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

synonyms: I Got Into a Passionate Relationship With a Sexy Girl I Met at a Convenience Store.

202017.description:
Taiga and Yamagami were childhood friends, close like brothers...or were they? Their relationship became strained after Yamagami, who used to be a bit of a dodder, transformed into a high-spec, elite, glasses-wearing guy.

"Oh, I wish I had a kinder, cuter female childhood friend."

Whether Taiga's wish was granted or it was a whim of the gods, Yamagami was cursed with the following: "When he sneezes, he turns into a woman" and "When he feels love, he turns back into a man." (Taiga is cursed to remain a virgin forever.) The key to this "love" lies with his awful childhood friend, Taiga...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Nonnadia, an ordinary commoner schoolgirl, finds her fiance, a former prince who made a huge mistake when he graduated!? This is the start of her thrilling life living together with the sparkling prince!

(Source: Saizensen, translated)

title.romaji: Yarakashi Ouji ga Uchi ni Kita!

202037.description:
It's been a long and hard road to become an adventurer, but Polka the elf has finally made it into the guild. Luckily for her there are a couple of rough senior guild members ready to give her some proper training, some equipment, and a whole lot of cum!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

202038.description:
Everyone uses their true feelings and their public image differently.

Although she is dissatisfied with the sex she has with her boyfriend, she still loves him. Still, the question that crosses her mind is, "Am I going to die without ever having good sex?" Honoka, an office worker, suddenly makes a passing desire come true. It's a purely physical relationship. "This isn't love, so it can't be helped," she thinks. However, Honoka's boyfriend is also in a public relationship with another woman... A modern human drama about true nature, where love, sex, and calculation intertwine.

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

202039.description:
In order to combat declining birthrates, the government has introduced a new mandatory course for students: Fuck Buddy Training. Once each week, girls are assigned men to "practice" having sex with. If you skip out, you can't graduate, and if you get a bad grade, you're assigned "remedial coursework" until you've learned your lesson! How will straitlaced Ayase and easygoing Mayu fare in this week's classes?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

＜Included Works＞

1. “Atema no Koi”（当て馬の恋）
A timid man, Mutou, and a rough, tomboyish girl, Rinka. The two of them were cooperating to sabotage the love lives of the people they each liked… but after they both got rejected at the same time, they somehow ended up spending the night together!? Their constantly clashing relationship begins to change little by little...

2. “Gyarubasu Arerugii!”（ぎゃるばす・あれるぎー!）
A world where different species coexist. Yakumo, a member of the Public Morals Committee, has one big problem — he can’t stop getting aroused by his next-seat neighbor, the super-lewd succubus gal, Elulu! Of course, she totally notices, and thus begins his “training” — including titjobs and frottage sessions…

3. “Moichido Kanadete, Ruusutaa”（もいちど奏でて、ルースター）
Mayu, a straightforward older sister type running a poultry farm in the countryside, is visited by her ex-boyfriend who once left saying he’d become a band musician. To comfort the man broken by failure, she starts with a blowjob and moves into serious lovemaking! Rekindled feelings ignite in a tender, passionate night…

4. “Niji ga Sakanakute mo”（虹が咲かなくても）
Amemori, the protagonist, has stopped going to college and shut himself in at home. His caring junior, Suzune, keeps coming over to look after him — but when he sees her defenseless chest, he can’t help getting an erection… and ends up losing his virginity to her in the heat of the moment!? But what is Suzune’s true intention…?

5. “Hari no Ketsuraku”（玻璃の欠落）
A forbidden erotic tale set in the Taishou era — a two-part story! Shirou, who was taken into the wealthy Shinonome family as the husband-to-be of their daughter Chiyoko, ends up in a secret relationship not with her, but with Yukiko — the daughter of a concubine who is treated as an outcast in the household…

202044.description:
One night in the park, Izumi Naoya meets Aoi, a stray succubus.

Apparently, succubi are often required to submit "sperm milking reports," and Aoi is looking for someone to help with this.

Naoya accepts the request, but is informed that there is very little time left until the report is due. Aoi also has trouble remembering almost nothing during the act (it felt so good), which is unbecoming of a succubus.

With a difficult future ahead, a short-term "collaboration project" begins in bed!


Before long, special feelings begin to grow between them...

Ga-Yun, who has lived her entire life under her mother's control, denied even the right to make her own choices, meets Tae-Eun at a wedding arranged by her mother, and falls in love at first sight, certain of marriage. With her mother's approval, the man is her perfect ideal type... Ga-Yun's seemingly rosy future is suddenly shattered by the arrival of Tae-Eun's twin brother, Tae-Seok. The unfortunate man who lost his older sister to Tae-Eun suddenly enters Ga-Yun's life, further turmoil. Trapped between love and suspicion, Ga-Yun sinks deeper into a swamp of lies and tragedy.

(Source: Naver, translated)

202049.description:
Han Yi-Sol, a high school freshman who loves birdwatching, is joined by Choi Ro-Woon, the unlucky top student in the entire school, and In Jeong-Min, who has been attending the same academy since middle school and has become her best friend.

"One side treats me too harshly, and the other side overprotects me...!"

This is an observation of the love and friendship of young people just about to leave the nest.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: A Youth Observation Journal: Wings Before the Nest

202050.description:
Catherine, the daughter of a count and a psychic, discovers that La Noire, a fortune teller who can even predict death, is actually poisoning people to do so. She also discovers that her husband is plotting to use La Noire's poison to poison herself and her father. Will Catherine be able to eliminate the witch's poison and exact revenge on her husband, Jerome?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Part of YLAB's Gold String universe.

202052.description:
A developer's day begins with an error alarm. Bug checks on the way to work, a game of wits in the conference room, and troubleshooting at night. But even all that messing up becomes comic material. This developer gag comic refactors every moment, from commuting to overtime, into a humorous experience! Even if you don't know anything about programming, it's still hilarious. Just laugh and go.

(Source: Naver, translated)

202053.description:
A collection of short stories spanning a variety of genres, offering the thrill of a full-length film. Enjoy a diverse range of short stories, spanning thrillers, comedy, drama, and romance.

(Source: Naver, translated)

202056.description:
Emblyn, the princess of the castle tower, has lived a life of scorn and ridicule, shunned by the king. Driven to her limit by the king's violence, she dreams of freedom, and one day, at the queen's behest, she sets out for the Redian territory. However, powerless and alone, she impulsively writes a letter to Triss, the heir to the Aek ducal family, asking him to be her guardian, having witnessed his devotion to her younger sister. Then, after clashing with her father over her sister's marriage, Triss runs away from the ducal family and heads without hesitation to the Winter Garden of the Redian territory, where Emblyn is staying...

"I, Triss Aek, pledge my honor before God to protect Emblyn from this moment on until death breaks my oath."

(Source: Naver, translated)

202058.description:
Myung-Hwan, diagnosed with a terminal illness, boards a plane to Las Vegas for his final journey. His first-class seatmate, Ki-Ju, turns out to be a terrorist, and he hijacks the plane. At 30,000 feet! A live broadcast of murder unfolds from the hijacked plane!

Will Myung-Hwan be able to stop the terrorist attack and return safely?

(Source: Naver, translated)

202059.description:
In 1984, Choi Geum-Hyeok, who was continuing his military service, endures hell every day due to the cruel harassment of his superiors and the betrayal of his trusted girlfriend. Exhausted by the misery, Geum-Hyeok cannot endure the taunts of his superior while on duty and ends up shooting him and running away... Will Geum-Hyeok be able to safely shake off his pursuers in a life of repeated hiding and running? A thriller about Choi Geum-Hyeok, a deserter who escapes from the harsh military life, and Captain Jo Chung-Ho who is in pursuit!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Shasha has read this novel before. It's an all-ages fantasy romance about a political power struggle, a slow-burn with a hundred chapters before a single kiss. But when she wakes up inside the novel as the protagonist's brother's handmaid, the once-innocent romance turns intoxicatingly intense!

Star employee Se-Jeong’s life turns upside down when her agency’s massive new client arrives—Ji-Hoon Doh, her first love from college and biggest mistake. Their secret affair ignites old sparks. Se-Jeong tries to keep him at arm's length, but Ji-Hoon is still madly in love and won't let her run again.

202068.description:
He hadn't seen Se-Kyung since they were nineteen—his first love, his old wound. She was still elegant, untouchable, and casually cruel. Still the most beautiful thing he'd ever seen. "Let's date. You and me. A contract relationship." The "contract" was the excuse. The "relationship" was everything.

Tigerfolk actor Seo Yong-Woo has it all... fame, wealth, and a flourishing career. Yet behind the glamorous spotlight, something still seems to be missing. Seeking companionship, he rescues a hungry stray cat discovered wandering on set. However, bringing this mysterious feline home comes with unforeseen complications. High school student Kuno Sousuke had a strange dream. In a completely white space, there was a blackboard with the question, "If you could take one thing to a deserted island, what would it be?" While his classmates gave safe answers, Sousuke blurted out "crafting ability."

When he came to, he found himself and his childhood friend transported to a deserted island in another world!? And to top it off, he was granted the crafting abilities he had answered to the blackboard.

With his crafting ability, Sousuke easily conquers the harsh island life! Surrounded by a cool, quiet childhood friend, a kind gal, a pure beauty, and a serious class president, his days are comfortable and full of pleasure.

Once a princess, Ethelyn died at the hands of the merciless Duke Ripherius. Now reborn as a maid in his household—and worse, as his secret lover—she finds herself the object of his twisted affection. But as she plots her escape, one question haunts her: what if her death was never what it seemed?

202084.description: Blade endures harsh training alongside rivals and three elite saint candidates to become his dream role: a Holy Knight. But one absolute rule governs these knights: they must only bond with a partner officially recognized by the Church. Violating this means ability confiscation and expulsion. One morning, Blade awakens to find a Sacred Mark—proof of an unrecognized bond—carved onto his lower torso. Now he must find his secret partner while guarding the mark's existence... or face ruin!

To one, Hae-Yoon is a precious toy; to the other, an irreplaceable treasure. As the twins’ twisted desires begin to blur the line between love and possession, can Hae-Yoon escape from their beautiful but dangerous grasp?

202087.description:
Ko Woon-Ha lives in constant pursuit of stimulation, yet his dulled senses leave him unable to truly feel pain, let alone pleasure. That changes after a single night with Cha Gyu-Won, the younger brother of his FWB, when Woon-Ha is able to experience genuine desire for the first time in his life. The problem is, Gyu-Won is everything Woon-Ha claims to despise: younger, inexperienced, and sworn to remain chaste until marriage, he seems to cling to a naive fantasy of a first love that will last forever. Convinced he’s made the worst possible mistake, Woon-Ha tries to brush it off as nothing more than a lapse in judgment…until the reality of his situation hits him harder than he though possible: Gyu-Won might be the only one who can make him feel anything - both physically and emotionally.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hui-Seong, who fell in love with Han-Gyeol after watching his short track speed skating performance during their school days, goes abroad to study. Upon his return, Han-Gyeol, now a national short track athlete, awaits Hui-Seong. The two become drunken sexual partners and awkwardly come to terms with their own feelings. With a major life goal ahead of them, can they find synergy through each other?

Tono Jin, a former inn employee, is reincarnated from the modern world into another world and bestowed with cheat abilities. Excited about his first time in another world, Jin encounters Slime-kun for the first time. Slime-kun's attacks are incredibly powerful, contrary to his cute appearance. Jin tries to resist using his cheat abilities, but hot water simply comes out of his palm, dealing no damage whatsoever!? Jin is in a dire situation, and begs a female adventurer named Oralia, who happens to be passing by, to help him out, saying, "I'll do whatever you say!" She barely escapes with her life. However, Jin doesn't know at the time that he's chosen the wrong person to help him, and the true power of the skill he's been bestowed...! In the light of day, Sister Alicia Snowell is a faithful and devoted bride of the gods, dedicated to serving the Holy Church and its followers. In the shadows, she’s one of the Church’s top inquisitors, tasked with hunting down and eliminating heretics by any means necessary. Alicia’s latest mission: assassinate the Hero Elcyon, slayer of the mighty Demon Lord, whose growing fame threatens to eclipse the Church’s political power. In order to kill the divinely protected, supposedly unkillable Hero, Alicia first needs to win Elcyon’s heart. There’s just one problem—Elcyon turns out to be a girl named Cion! Alicia’s at a loss for what to do, but while she tries to figure out how to seduce a girl, more trouble brews on the horizon. With remnants of the demon army still at large, Alicia and Cion face one deadly supernatural battle after another! Where will the two girls’ intertwining paths lead them?

Uema Natsuki, a woman in her 30s who is currently looking for a husband and has never had a boyfriend, reunites with her childhood friend and first love, Nagahama Kouto, for the first time in eight years. 202111.description:
“I’d like to buy your time—for two hundred thousand yen a month.”

For Sakata, the winter of his junior year brings nothing but loss. His mother is dead, his useless father is gone, and each day nearly costs him everything he has left. Then a young man named Nishikawa approaches him with an offer—and generous pay that could give his mother a proper funeral. However, the deal comes with several bizarre conditions that Sakata must meet: go to school every day, get into the same university as Nishikawa, and lastly, act like his friend until the end of their contract. As their bond deepens, the two boys starved for love must face the question neither dared to ask: Can a friendship built entirely on money turn into something real?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Lu Hao, the first among his generation to awaken four meridians, quickly becomes a target within his own martial clan. Threatened by Lu Hao’s extraordinary talent, the patriarch conspires against him, leading to his betrayal and the destruction of his meridians—casting him out as a cripple in the eyes of the martial world. Just as all hope seems lost, an ancient and powerful divine dragon bloodline stirs awake within him. Empowered by this newfound force, Lu Hao sets out to reclaim his place, face hidden enemies, and unravel the deep, unresolved mysteries tied to his past life.

In a world where dungeons appear and skilled players battle for glory, Yukari Kanzaki dreams of clearing the legendary Luluheart Dungeon. Branded “powerless,” he is denied even the chance to enter. But when a Dungeon Break unleashes monsters into the world, Yukari saves an injured girl—only to discover she is Luluheart, the Demon Lord herself. Granted a chance to save the world, Yukari returns six years into the past, armed with the ability to regress through death.

The emperor awaiting him, Tae Won, is rumored to be a merciless despot, yet he greets Yi-Hyeon with unexpected innocence and charm. But that gentleness doesn’t last. Beneath the smile lies obsession, and Tae Won’s growing fixation leaves Yi-Hyeon frightened and confused. Separated from his family and slowly losing himself, Yi-Hyeon begins to fade.

Can love - or survival - exist under an emperor’s twisted devotion, in a palace swallowed by a moonless night?

She was supposed to have died on the execution platform, but when she woke up, she found herself reincarnated as a baby!

In her previous life, she was the caretaker of the national treasure "Magic Crystal," but was falsely accused and died a tragic death. In her new life, she became a noblewoman, as she had always hoped - but her family was a cruel, tyrannical family!? What's more, the family was set to perish in the future!

"I absolutely don't want to perish! I must protect this tyrannical family!"

An unexpected interaction with her clumsy father begins... A baby with memories of his previous life fights to survive!

Daphne became Empress after marrying her first love in a world where political marriages are the norm. But her life begins to unravel when Rosetta, a blind woman, suddenly appears and claims to be carrying the Emperor’s child. Worse still, rather than deny it, the Emperor accepts Rosetta and grows cold toward Daphne. Then Mephis, a handsome court painter, enters her life with a bold and straightforward request: that she become his sponsor. As these two unexpected figures enter Daphne’s world, their sudden arrival suggests something far more than mere coincidence.

202120.description:
Kei Wataya, age 28, is an unwed single mother from a small town... whose beloved son refuses to go to class. The pitying looks she gets from her fellow clinic staff, not to mention the rest of the world, are almost bad enough to make her wince. Between work and trying to help her son integrate into school better, Kei's got her hands too full to worry about romance... and that's assuming anyone would even be interested in a woman with so much "baggage." That's where 40-year-old doctor, Nagisa Kamijo, comes in. He's more than a decade older than Kei, and his disparaging view of women is just one of many reasons they don't get along, so there's no danger of love blooming between them... Or so she thought, until a bizarre proposal from Kamijo lights a spark that might just become more. She couldn't care less about love or romance, and she doesn't regret the life she chose, but some nights she yearns to feel the warmth of another body... Tune in for an age-gap romance just as off-kilter as it is passionate, between a single mother who's "done with men" and a doctor who "hates" women.

She wants him to leave, but he's an annoying playboy, so why is her heart wavering so much...? What's more, this man has a secret... Chizuru has been avoiding romance due to a certain problem. But her junior colleague, Izumi, finds out about her troubles... She ends up having a physical relationship with a junior colleague!? A happy adult love story that starts with the body.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: カラダの恋は沼でした。
title.romaji: Karada no Koi wa Numa Deshita.

202130.description:
The regent held immense power and harbored treacherous ambitions. Zang Xiaojing, the emperor's most favored younger brother, was determined to eliminate this thorn in his side for his elder brother. However, he lured the enemy deep into his territory and ended up sacrificing himself.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

202131.description:
Stories featuring the lives of Kyo, Ayame, Daiki & Chinatsu are revealed!
The second novel in the series, depicting "the interlude of youth"!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

202132.description:
The Myers are out of luck. Not only did the tyrant emperor strip them of their title and land, but Alexis, the head of the family, took his own life because of it... And no one's more shocked than his wife, Louise, when he suddenly wakes up a completely different person! But Louise doesn't realize that Alexis has been possessed by a hero from another world, one who's determined to save the Myers once and for all. Can the new Alexis become the family's savior? Or will he be rejected as a fake?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: My Perfect Husband Who Came Back to Life
無能老公變成全能主角

202133.description:
Our protagonist, Aki, was dumped brutally in the past, and the trauma has caused her to give up all feminine traits. Then, Aki is approached by Hajime, a member of the basketball team. At first, Hajime thinks Aki is a boy and challenges her to matches at every opportunity, but by chance, he finds out that Aki is a girl. Perhaps as a reaction to what had happened up until then, Hajime has fallen head over heels in love with Aki and honestly confesses his feelings to her. Though confused, Aki gradually opens up to Hajime's attitude.

The incident occurred after the incident, and Aki begins to have feelings for Hajime. One day, a man appears before her. It is none other than Fumiya, the boy who caused Aki's trauma...! What's more, Fumiya says he likes Aki. Is Aki, who supposedly had given up being a girl, once again popular? This is the beginning. What will become of the love between the three of them...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

202134.description:
When her junior high school closes, Harima Kurumi transfers to Shirahagi Academy. Since she lives far away, she decides to live in the school's Keyaki dormitory. On her first day at the dormitory, Kurumi treats the school prince, Kyoutaro, who is carrying her luggage, as suspicious and throws him away. Kyoutaro tells her, "I'm never going near you again."

After such a terrible first meeting, the two are initially awkward with each other. However, through dorm life, Kyoutaro gradually opens up to Kurumi, who is able to express her feelings honestly. Kurumi also becomes close with her roommate Mayuko and Kyoutaro's best friend, Motochika, and begins to enjoy dorm life. However, because of a secret Kyoutaro is harboring, the love and friendship between the four of them take an unexpected turn...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

202135.description:
There's a perennial aspiring hero, born with the makings of a hero, but never given the opportunity to truly realize his talents, leaving him gripped by feelings of inferiority and defeat. He dismisses other heroes as mere populist kitsch and prides himself on becoming a true hero. Then, after a fraudulent loan from a loan shark, he's forced to enter the hero audition he so loathed—the very height of kitsch. Will he become kitsch or a true hero, the Übermensch?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

202136.description:
Born the granddaughter of a shaman, Go Bok-Sil. Her grandmother, who often found herself alone, decided to offer a final prayer before passing away: "Please give me the one who will make Bok-Sil happy!" But there was no word from her destined one. So, Bok-Sil set out to find what she loved. A prop shop she'd opened in the shaman's home. Friendly customers and wonderful friends. And then there was the baseball team, Taeyang Wales, and the hitter, Yun Cheong-Il. Bok-Sil went to the baseball stadium to cheer on her favorite team. That day, Cheong-Il's home run ball was uncannily beautiful. As if possessed, she rushed to catch the ball, only to collide with an unknown man. And with that, an unbelievable transformation unfolded...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

202137.description:
One day, Hime dreams that she receives "something" from a wizard. She goes to the Magic Research Club (commonly known as Maho-Ken), which is rumored to research magic and curses, to ask for advice, but finds that the club members are all handsome, eccentric people. Three handsome boys get into a slightly strange love battle over Hime!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Notes:
- Includes two extra chapters.
- Includes the one-shot "Koi ga Hajimaru 1-funkan (恋がはじまる1分間)".
- Includes the one-shot "Miyako Haru Ichiban! (みやこ春一番！)".

202139.description:
Saori is a volleyball fanatic who lives for volleyball. She is forced to do sexual relief by the trash former Japan national coach, Nakagaki, but before she knows it, she is seduced... and in the end, she is seduced herself...
(Source: Toronana translated)

Note: Released at Comiket 106,107

202140.description:
One day, I woke up... and I had become a character in an erotic game!?
The game I played in my previous life, "Ecstasy Labyrinth," was
a game where you create a girl character and challenge erotic trap dungeons.
So when I'm reincarnated into such a world as the most beautiful girl in the world...
I have no choice but to enter the erotic trap dungeon!
What!? The pleasure of being a woman feels too good...!?
Formerly a man, Lalatinha's sexual desire is unstoppable...!
(Source: Melonbooks Translated)

Note: Released at Comiket 102

title.native: せっかくエロゲにTS転生したのでエロトラップダンジョンにもぐります
title.romaji: Sekkaku Eroge ni TS Tensei Shita node Ero Trap Dungeon ni Mogurimasu

202141.description:
Captured and milked... A tale of connecting with an innocent creature...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Isekairakuten Vol.46

202142.description:
“Stop crying. Nothing happened. If anything, I was the one who got pounced on.”

After six years of pining, PR manager Lee Jeong-Yeon’s confession plans crumble when she learns her boss, Gong Ji-Hyeok, loves someone else. Spiraling in despair, she impulsively meets an online stranger—only to find herself cornered in a hotel room.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Office Danpyeonseon (오피스 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Office Short Stories] You Shouldn’t Eat Just Anything When You’re Hungry
[辦公室短篇] 再餓也別亂吃

title.english: Just Because You're Hungry Doesn't Mean You Eat Just Anything

202143.description:
Elena, the only daughter of a wealthy family, accidentally witnesses a friend's intimate moment with her lover and becomes curious about sex. As she grows closer to her loyal chauffeur, Kale, their secret bond blossoms into a forbidden love her father can never accept.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: The Young Lady Is Too Curious

202144.description:
Black panther Pyo Yoontae returns to So Jeongseo’s small town with one objective: to find his first love who had fur as white as snow. Being the school outcast, Jeongseo decides to help Yoontae in the hopes of finally making a friend. Besides, Yoontae’s first love surely can’t be Jeongseo himself, since he’s a weasel with brown fur. But something about Yoontae feels awfully similar to a forgotten childhood playmate, and there is one secret Jeongseo is keeping from him. Every winter, Jeongseo actually sheds his fur and turns snow-white!

(Source: Tappytoon)

202145.description:
Si-Won dreams of becoming a fashion designer. He meets his perfect model in Seo-Hu, the famous “bucket-hat guy,” from campus. With his angelic face and perfect proportions, no one else will do. But the closer the two become, the more a strange feeling of temptation creeps in...

(Source: Manta)

202146.description:
Poor young man Imori-kun is held captive in the mysterious apartment complex Gekkouso, managed by the tyrannical youkai Yamori-senpai. This silly youkai comedy is filled with troublesome youkai, including a poverty god and a beckoning cat!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ヤモリ先輩といっしょでいいんじゃね？
title.romaji: Yamori-senpai to Issho de Iin ja ne?

202147.description:
Aoi is a third-year junior high school boy. And then there's Hinata, a mysterious boy he meets under a cherry blossom tree. They each have their own motives...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: レムレスブルーの午前2時

202148.description:
Jikkai High, with a low academic score of just nine, is a bottom-tier school where delinquents from all over the country gather, with new transfer students arriving almost every week. Our protagonist, Jou Sago, is terrible at fighting and spends his days being looked down on by everyone... but everything changes when the strongest of them all, Goku Hitomi, transfers in.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

202149.description:
"I'll promote you to the CEO's wife." A secret marriage to a handsome, egotistical CEO!? Suzuka is an ordinary office lady with no redeeming qualities. She is always asked to do odd jobs, but one day, by chance, she closes a big deal and receives an order from the CEO to be promoted! She is assigned to... the position of "CEO's wife"! "I'll teach you this too," he says, even giving the inexperienced Suzuka some sexual instruction!? What will become of this fake marriage...?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 花嫁に配属されました

202150.description:
Men and women reverse roles in this courtesan battle fantasy!
Yoshiwara, a world where men are forbidden from entering. Inside this world, all males must be eradicated -- the only exception being the "male geisha" who serve there. But these men want their freedom, and it seems the only way to get it is to stand up against Yoshiwara with an overwhelming force...

202152.description:
Woobin, the popular boy at school, is secretly a huge fan of the anime "Love Love Me", especially its heroine, Yoi. The moment he meets Ah-yoon, a classmate who looks just like Yoi, he falls for her at first sight... A fluttering high school romance between Woo-bin, the popular boy hiding his otaku identity, and Ah-yoon, the ultimate otaku who dreams of sharing her favorite anime with everyone!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Thud... I Think I’ve Fallen for You...?

202153.description:
Finally, Byeokwu has mastered it—the Sacred Art of Grand Clarity, one of the most precious arts of the Gonryun Clan. But nothing he learned in seclusion could’ve prepared him to understand the state of things one hundred years later. Leaving his clan behind, Byeokwu starts a new life as a chef at the Gonryun Tavern, determined to help the owner turn a profit. And if his noodles are good enough to tempt the Divine Demon of the Bloody Heaven into changing his ways? Surely, there are worse things.

(Source: Tapas)

202154.description: Note: The first story in Metatoon's Yeonhagong Danpyeonseon (연하공 단편선) Collection.

202155.description:
High school student Tsukigi Renya's powerful pheromones make him so popular that he can barely function normally. He's driven to lust by every female on the planet and intimidated by every male. Because of this, he lives a lonely life, unable to make a single friend. But one day, he encounters a strange-looking cat(?). Renya is delighted to meet a creature that isn't driven to lust or intimidating, but the cat(?) turns out to be an extraordinary creature from outside Earth...!

This is the start of a tentacle-based non-human love comedy featuring a transforming creature and a protagonist with troubles with women!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The One Who Loves You Most Is I

title.native: セカイでいちばんアイしてる

202157.description:
High school freshman Rei Shizuka isn't blessed with height or strength, but he has a more accurate two-handed shot than anyone else. However, this weapon, which doesn't shine in boys' basketball, is denied every day. Is his weapon invincible to anyone or anything? Just as he begins to lose confidence, an encounter with Misaka Haku, a transfer student from America with a street style, changes his destiny! Stick to your own style!

The combination of two-handed shot and street style creates a miracle, and the coolest youth basketball season begins!

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

202158.description: Compilation of various Astro Boy side stories from different publications that were first published in 1964 to 1981.

202159.description:
Ruby, a diva who has lost her heart, and Anon, a young composer who sold his soul to a noble demon. Anon continues his arduous journey with only one goal: to restore the heart of his childhood friend, the diva Ruby!! His journey of redemption begins now!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: シャントラ —絶対依存の歌姫—

202161.description:
Maga Taki, a second-year high school student, is handsome, rich, and popular; he lives a fulfilling life. In December, Santa Claus appears before Taki...or rather, it's the "Three Choice Fairy," Santaku Rose! Santaku Rose offers Taki three presents to fill the loneliness that he feels is lurking in his heart. But there's nothing Taki wants...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

202162.description:
One day, Natsuya, an ordinary middle school student, meets a daikon radish. "Want to pick up a daikon radish?" Natsuya ignores him, but the radish follows him home...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: あおくび大根 生ですの。

202163.description:
Hui-Won, who had been harboring a grudge against his younger parachute team leader, Ju-Young, had been bullying him. Hui-Won, who had a crush on Ju-Young's beauty, had been secretly drawing BL comics featuring herself and Ju-Young, pursuing his hobby as a popular doujinshi artist. Then one day, Ju-Young discovers Hui-Won's storyboard notes! Thinking it was over, Hui-Won cautiously watches, but Ju-Young demands that he rape him, just like in the comics...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

202164.description:
Seiya, the editor-in-chief of Bunko G, a charismatic editor-in-chief of a group of handsome men, loves light novels and has dedicated his entire life to them! For the sake of his beloved light novels, Seiya will even chase a motorcycle courier and crash into a truck! In the midst of a storm, Seiya prays to the "Moe God"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 今日も、先輩の言いなり
幼なじみのタイプを聞いたら完全に俺だった
title.romaji: Osananajimi no Type wo Kiitara Kanzen ni Ore datta

title.native: 御子柴くんと水無瀬くんは友達じゃないらしい
title.romaji: Mikoshiba-kun to Minase-kun wa Tomodachi ja Nai Rashii

title.native: ここから先は幼なじみ以上です
title.romaji: Kokokara Saki wa Osananajimi Ijou desu

title.native: ゴルゴ13 さいとうたかをセレクション
苛烈な愛しかいらない
各界著名人セレクション BEST of ゴルゴ13
妄想しがちな俺と、リアルで沼な後輩くん。
title.romaji: Mousou Shigachi na Ore to, Real de Numa na Kouhai-kun.

title.native: リーダーズチョイス BEST 13 of ゴルゴ13
幻の花 白山宣之傑作集
title.romaji: Maboroshi no Hana: Shirayama Nobuyuki Kessakushuu

202180.description:
The year is 2025. Due to the enactment of the "Special Economic Zone Bill" aimed at revitalizing the economy, foreign communities have sprung up all over the country. As each community seeks their own interests, the security situation in these areas continues to deteriorate. And amid this unstable situation, one assassin makes a name for herself.

(Source: Leed Publishing, translated)
synonyms: バレット バレエ バッドガールズ

202181.description:
A lone diner stands in the remote frontier. Drawn by the cooking of a human known only as “Master,” demons, elves, and others of all races gather to savor his food. On the stage of this small restaurant, a gourmet tale of joy and sorrow alike begins to unfold!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Meals on the Frontier of Another World

202182.description:
Meiko has the perfect life. Kentaro is the perfect husband. He supports the family with his high-salary job at the bank, helps around the house, and is the perfect father to their son, Kota. On his days off, he even volunteers at their son's daycare. Little does she know that he is having an affair with none other than one of Kota's daycare workers. Devastated, how will Meiko handle this affair?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Cheated: The Perfect Husband Turned Out to be a Scumbag
title.native: サレ妻の事情～理想の夫が実はクズで～
title.romaji: Saretsuma no Jijou: Risou no Otto ga Jitsu wa Kuzu de

202183.description:
Head over heels for the first time in 10 years!! 29 years old and with no one to call a significant other, Haruka's been focused on her work to keep her mind off the turmoil of her (nonexistent) romantic life. That all changed though when she bumped into Chikage, a student at the nearby university... love at first sight! This is all so new... or rather it feels like it since it's been too long... but now Haruka's got to figure out how to close the distance and learn more about this person she just happened to be looking at from afar for so long. One day, on her way back from work, Haruka decides to browse the bookstore near her office when, lo and behold, Chikage's working the register! Who would've thought it'd be Chikage that pops the question?! "Will you be a practice girlfriend for me?" ...Practice?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Going Gaga Over a Younger Guy
title.native: 一目惚れした年下男子と××することになりまして
title.romaji: Hitomebore shita Toshishita Danshi to xx suru Koto ni Narimashite

202184.description:
The white, round-shaped Hacchinpamos is an endangered species that is prone to dying over trivial matters. Many people are fascinated by its lovable clumsiness! Let's have some pamonication with the obedient and lovable Hacchinpamos!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 絶滅寸前の動物 ハッチンパモス

202185.description:
This full-color manga features one hundred different yuri scenarios, all from the artist Muromaki's #100DaysofYuriChallenge!

Packed full of high-school, adult, and age-gap couples in cute, funny, and spicy scenarios alike, this book has plenty for readers to enjoy!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: とある人妻の淫蕩日記
八尺様・出会いと搾取

202189.description:
The story centers on 009 and other cyborg warriors' battle against the former Japanese naval forces and their supposedly sunken battleships, the Yamato and Nagato, that suddenly appear in the Pacific Ocean and started attacking various regions.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: サイボーグ009　太平洋の亡霊
キスのあとまで教えてあげる
title.romaji: Kiss no Ato Made Oshiete Ageru

202192.description:
Thanks to his false bragging, Geon-Woo's friends think he has lots of experience in the bedroom when he's actually a virgin who hasn't even kissed anyone before. When Han-Eul, the pretty upperclassman Geon-Woo admires, asks to sleep with him, Geon-Woo is nervous but on cloud nine. However, Han-Eul's intimidating friend, Ji-Ho, is waiting for them at the place of their hookup. Not only that, but Han-Eul insists on having a threesome with Geon-Woo and Ji-Ho, claiming it's the only way he can be satisfied! And so, poor Geon-Woo is trapped in a dangerously filthy throuple with no way out...

(Source: Tappytoon)

202193.description:
"You're going to be my Cinderella."

It is the Taisho Period. Sakura has always been treated cruelly by her step-mother and younger sister in the home of the Shirahoshis, a fallen noble family. Rinko, her younger sister, gets engaged to an heir to a powerful conglomerate and is set to be introduced as his fiancee at her debut party. Sakura attends her party, but is ridiculed by the other guests due to Rinko's cruel scheme. Right then, Eisei Kuroyuki, an heir to Japan's most powerful conglomerate, steps in to help her. Known for his ironfisted ways, Eisei never bows to authority no matter who they are, even if it's a member of the Imperial Diet. Why would such a man fall for Sakura and dote on her? A Cinderella story with passionate romance begins!! Oh, and filled with plenty of justice served for Sakura's enemies as well!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: A Tyrant's Cinderella: Passionate Romance in the Taisho Period
title.native: 暴君のシンデレラ～大正溺愛浪漫譚～
title.romaji: Boukun no Cinderella: Taisho Dekiai Roman Tan

202194.description:
After losing his sense of smell, genius perfumer Si-Bon tries to end his life but is saved by Ha-Eoon, the owner of a small antique shop. Planning to stay just 3 months before returning to France, Si-Bon takes a live-in job there and finds himself slowly drawn into Ha-Eoon's world with no escape.

(Source: Manta)

202195.description:
Protected his entire life by his loyal butler, Se-Jin, young heir Lee Han-Eul is discovering the real world for the very first time. As he tastes freedom, friendship, and first love, long-buried secrets begin to resurface. Why does Se-Jin seem to care for him as much as he watches over him? The discovery of a terrible secret about his birth will fundamentally change Han-Eul’s view of the world—and his feelings for his butler.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: My Butler Is Overprotective of Me!

202196.description:
Chun-Li, who can predict people's deaths, has been oppressed by her family for being cursed. One day, she is married to Emperor Seiran, who is rumored to cause those around him to die one after another. "I don't mind dying for Chun-Li," her own father thought, so he forced her into the harem as a "sacrifice." Chun-Li thought she could die at any time, but Seiran, who learned of Chun-Li's ability to predict death, became interested in her.

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title.native: 後宮の生贄妃～どうせ死ぬのなら、皇帝に愛されます～
title.romaji: Koukyuu no Ikenie Hi: Douse Shinu no Nara, Koutei ni Aisaremasu

title.native: 吸血姫は少女マンガが描けない
title.romaji: Kyuuketsu-hime wa Shoujo Manga ga Egakenai

202198.description: Note: Originally published in LaLa DX 2021 September issue.

202199.description: Note: Originally published in LaLa 2021 November issue.

synonyms: User Manual for My Best Friend

202201.description: Ohara, a troublesome streamer who caused a stir with a video of him trespassing in an abandoned building and is now in debt, is looking to make a viral video that will turn his life around. He gathers people who could be used as stepping stones and heads to an abandoned village where a group of girls are rumored to have disappeared. However, the village is actually lurking a monster made of flesh that eats humans. A tragedy begins, with the victims being fools who enter forbidden territory...!

title.romaji: Niku Kai no Shoujiru Mura nite

title.native: 熟女風俗に行ったら親友の母親が出てきた件
title.romaji: Jukujo Fuuzoku ni Ittara Shinyuu no Hahaoya ga Detekita Kudan

202204.description:
A suffocating aura.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-05

202206.description:
“Ellion, we’re close friends, right…?”

Rosaline never actually wanted to go to the monastery, but after a careless childhood promise, she’s stuck with no way out. In desperation, she turns to her childhood friend, Ellion, to vent her frustrations. As they brainstorm ways to escape her fate, she reaches a bold conclusion: she must break the vow of chastity that the monastery prizes so dearly. The only question is, who should be her partner in crime? Just then, her eyes land on the perfect candidate sitting right in front of her.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [순정 단편선] 내가 소꿉친구를 유혹하게 된 사정
[Sunjeong Danpyeonseon] Naega Sokkupchingureul Yuhokage Doen Sajeong
How I Ended Up Seducing My Childhood Friend

title.english: How I Ended Up Seducing My Childhood Friend

202209.description:
The phone rings in the dead of night. Summoned to the newly built gymnasium, Yumi witnesses a terrifying sight. Strange incidents occur one after another. A classic horror story set in a frightening school.

(Source: Number Nine, translated)

202210.description:
A world stained black. Driven by the Black Witch, humanity is forced into a vast city where light and color converge. To reclaim the world, humanity continues its pioneering efforts, and a boy named Kay aspires to join the expeditionary force. But he’s rejected because he is colorless, lacking any hue. Then one day, through an unexpected incident, Kay gains the color black....

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: いもうとはサキュバス

202212.description:
The “Missing Pieces” series, which allows readers to compare the first magazine publications with Osamu Tezuka's own revised tankoubon editions, has previously had releases of Black Jack and Mitsume ga Tooru, both of which received great acclaim.

This time, as part of the series, we present Hi no Tori: Missing Pieces - Boukyou-hen compiling the "Boukyou (Nostalgia)" arc of Hi no Tori—which underwent particularly extensive revisions—and its related work, the “Hagoromo (Robe of Feathers)” arc. The “Boukyou” arc and the related “Hagoromo” arc, revised three times over the years, show astonishingly bold alterations—from minor details like dialogue changes, character deletions, and art style revisions, to major structural overhauls—revealing Osamu Tezuka's relentless creative drive.

Experience this historic endeavor up close.

(Source: Rittorsha, translated)

title.native: 火の鳥 ミッシング・ピーシズ《望郷編》
title.romaji: Hi no Tori: Missing Pieces - Boukyou-hen

202213.description:
The setting is Aonokushima, a remote island in the Pacific Ocean far from Honshu. There, Reigo Murasame, a high school student, lives alone. His parents died in an accident, and his grandmother, who took him in to the island, also recently passed away. Still, he has no intention of leaving the island. Because he has someone he has feelings for, Ichika Kannagi. One summer day, the two of them decide to go to a summer festival. When they learn that there is a secret festival that is held exclusively for adults, they head off to a place deep in the mountain that is off-limits. Unbeknownst to me, that was the beginning of a tragedy.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

202214.description:
It follows the lively daily life of Ashibe, who has been promoted to third grade, and Goma-chan, who remains the same as ever. Now that he is in third grade, Ashibe wants to show that he has grown in some way. He asks Goma-chan about it, but gets no reply.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 小3アシベ QQゴマちゃん

202215.description:
After the death of her grandmother, Akari moves from Tokyo to stay with her widowed grandfather. She takes up a part-time job in their family's convenience store "Ayahashi", sitting right on the border of the town and the mountains. There's just one problem - when night falls, not all of the customers arriving are human!

(Source: Manga Planet)

title.native: あやかしコンビニエンス

202216.description:
A few days ago, a disappearance occurred at a karaoke bar. Aoki Tokiya, who works there part-time, becomes embroiled in even more bizarre incidents. Meanwhile, Midorima, who is investigating the disappearance, has his eye on the culprit, but his identity remains a mystery... Members of the game commentator group "White Tails" appear in this story, depicting the battle between Tsukumo-shi and the yokai!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 会社の同僚と…シちゃいました。

202218.description:
Kwon Heemang is a jobless recluse living a shut-in lifestyle without a single friend to her name. Her mundane existence takes a supernatural turn after a freak accident grants her the ability to see ghosts, leading to a haunting encounter with Kim Sarang. The lingering spirit strikes a deal: she will leave Heemang alone only after fulfilling her final wish. Sarang died just one month into her first relationship, never having the chance to truly experience intimacy with her boyfriend.

Before Heemang can protest, Sarang possesses her body and tracks down her ex, Choi Taemin, a popular, younger student celebrating his return to college after military service. In a bold, possessed frenzy, Heemang catches Taemin off guard with an intense kiss in front of everyone. Shaken and humiliated once the possession lifts, Heemang flees the scene. However, Taemin, who secretly admires assertive older women, finds himself completely smitten by the mysterious "crazy woman" who stole his heart.

(Source: Lezhin US)

202219.description:
Lighthearted, nonsensical, absurd, erotic... A collection of short stories and single-panel works from Osamu Tezuka's “adult comics,” where he freely pursued the pure fun of manga! 1000 pages of unique works brimming with black humor, sci-fi, and the absurd.
・Features the original magazine editions using almost exclusively Osamu Tezuka's handwritten text.
・Includes numerous works unpublished in collected volumes or complete editions, plus newly discovered single-panel pieces.
・Complete collection of all 50 episodes of “Yoromeki Doubutsuki” and all 156 installments of the single-panel serial “Osamu Tezuka no TV Manga.”
・Features a color single-panel gallery at the beginning (16 pages total).

(Source: Kokushokan Koukai, translated)

Use it all, break through limits. Innate wisdom, academic pinnacle. Multiple forms, transcending evolution. Reborn, starting from scratch, infinitely evolving.

202223.description:
The "Eternal Flame" has returned to its proper place, but the peaceful and prosperous times are shattered by a bizarre phenomenon. A sudden meteor shower unleashes the "Heart of the Earth," a world element hidden within the Earth's core! This unleashes an unprecedented war between the Celestials, the Dragons, and the Asuras. To quell the chaos, Sanzang, entrusted by Tathagata, embarks on a journey to seal the "Heart of the Earth." The westward-bound team reunites, embarking on an unknown and treacherous journey...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

202228.description:
If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out?

Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

202234.description:
Magritte, the second daughter of Viscount Nefershall, has no magical powers and was raised as a servant by her talented older sister, who called her "leftovers." Even in this situation, the cheerful Magritte lives happily every day, fueled by her favorite cooking and memories of her past life. One day, she takes her sister's place when she runs away and is married to her sister's fiance, Marquis Ganongoulf.

The Marquis is feared by everyone, rumored to wield the terrifying "corruption magic," but Magritte doesn't let this situation scare her. Instead, she seems genuinely excited to experience the Marquis's magic...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Itsuwari Seijo wa Nemuranai Kaizoku no Dakimakura ni Narimashita

202236.description:
Anneliese, a young lady, has been praised for her genius since she was a child. But one day, just before her wedding to her fiancé, the crown prince, he cheats on her, breaks off the engagement, and then she is exiled. Outraged by this unreasonable treatment of their daughter, her parents decide to abandon their country and emigrate to a neighboring country.

Annelise is actually a reincarnated person, and she uses the knowledge from her previous life to come up with groundbreaking ideas. And as Anneliese's success spreads both domestically and internationally, her homeland, which allowed her to flee, realizes the magnitude of its mistake...

A new world for the talented reincarnated young lady's second life!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 捨てられ才女は家族とのんびり生きることにします
title.romaji: Suterare Saijo wa Kazoku to Nonbiri Ikiru Koto ni Shimasu

202238.description:
Lavinia was framed by her beloved father and labeled a villainous young lady. To raise funds for her revenge, she chose Hotel Alheim, a converted Demon King's castle. She tried to seduce the handsome young general manager, Ruudbert, a descendant of the Demon King, and seize management rights, but her attempt failed quickly.

However, Lavinia, who aims to rise to power, uses her "knowledge of evil" to solve the problems of guests one after another. A tale of ambition and humanity unfolds at the Demon King's hotel!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Su Mu is reborn and re-enters the “Apocalypse” system, facing deadly situations where Death itself comes knocking and an array of demons and eerie creatures awaken to threaten the world. Against all odds, he turns the tables and becomes an unstoppable king, joining his teammates in a desperate fight to reverse their fate and ignite a nationwide awakening and evolution.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: 死神を喰らい、俺は王となる
Strange Invasion, I Took Over the God of Death and Counterattacked to Become the King

202242.description:
Her ex-boyfriend, who she broke up with due to differences in social status, shows up as her boss!? A Cinderella love story of adults, with secrets to protect and true feelings...!

Wendy's ex-boyfriend, Dennis, who was supposed to inherit the viscounty in place of his brother who passed away suddenly, appears as her boss after she has been transferred to a position as a royal civil servant. While bewildered by Dennis, who is still as kind and protective as he was three years ago, Wendy, aware of her position, tries to distance herself from him. But to begin with, Wendy has a huge secret that she must absolutely hide from Dennis...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

202244.description:
Daigoro the cat lives a happy life with his beloved grandmother. One day, his grandmother goes out to buy food for Daigoro and never returns, her whereabouts unknown. Worried that something has happened to her grandmother, Daigoro sets out alone to search for her...!

A great adventure in human society! A slapstick cat comedy begins!!

(Source: Gorakuweb, translated)

title.native: 悪評令嬢なのに、美貌の公子が迫ってくる
title.romaji: Akuhyou Reijou Nanoni, Bibou no Koushi ga Semattekuru

202246.description:
The apocalypse game swept across the globe and merged with the real world, causing the collapse of order. In his previous life, Ye Xiao devoted everything to elevating his fiancée, Liu Ruyan, to the pinnacle of power, only to have his heart literally ripped out by her on the day of their engagement and transplanted into her male best friend. Reborn into a new life, Ye Xiao resolves to ascend the throne alone. Before the game closes its recharge portal, he spends billions of his fortune to switch to a god-level profession.

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)
synonyms: Starting As The God Of Wealth, Taming Billions Of Divine Pets!

title.native: 开局转职财神，驯化亿万神宠!
title.romaji: Kaiju Zhuanzhi Caishen, Xunhua Yiwan Shen Chong!

202248.description:
The Empress Dowager who ruled on behalf of the emperor, the pure and flawless Saintess of the Demonic Sect, the one-armed sword master ranked ninth in the world, the emotionless Celestial Maiden of Mount Taihua, and the chivalrous yet tender-hearted Sword Master of the Spring and Autumn Period… Danger lurks everywhere. In a past life, they were my mortal enemies. In this life, they are my concubines. They once all tried to kill me. So now, they have all submitted to me in shame and humiliation.

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)
synonyms: My Enemy Became My Cultivation Partne

title.native: 我的仇敌成了我的道侣
title.romaji: Wo de Choudi Chengle Wo de Dao Lu

202255.description:
1. Kyonyuu Kaa-san ga Boku no Me mo Mae de Oji-san no Namachin de Ikimakutta Hanashi (巨乳母さんが僕の目の前でおじさんの生チンでイキまくった話); Comiket 103, COMITIA147
2. Kyonyuu Kaa-san ga Boku no Me mo Mae de 2 ~Bonyuu Mamire de Ikimakutta Hanashi~ Kyonyuu Kaa-san ga Boku no Me mo Mae de 2: Bonyuu Mamire de Ikimakutta Hanashi (巨乳母さんが僕の目の前で2〜母乳まみれでイキまくった話〜); COMIC1☆24, COMITIA148

title.romaji: Kyonyuu Kaa-san ga Boku no Me mo Mae de Oji-san no Namachin de Ikimakutta Hanashi

202256.description:
Ho-Wen, who had retired from his long military career and was working as a daycare security guard, discovers that his former superior, Rayus, has moved into the same neighborhood. But Rayus, Ho-Wen explains, is more special than just another superior.

"You ignored me seven times, and now you're confessing to me, do you think I'll believe you?!"

What happened between a senior and junior colleague who haven't seen each other in a long time?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

title.native: 母さんが僕の目の前で中出し痴漢されちゃった話
title.romaji: Kaa-san ga Boku no Me no Mae de Chuu Chikan Sarechatta Hanashi

202259.description:
Wanting to search out her childhood friend's true nature.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Weekly Kairakuten 2022 No.17, 18

title.native: 義姉ちゃん、オナホになってよ。

202261.description:
Count Millietta, the daughter of an earl, is approaching marriageable age. At a fiancé-hunting evening party, she randomly hands a knight the handkerchief they first met... and the next day he shows up at her estate and proposes to her! Though confused, Millietta finds herself drawn to the kind knight.

But the truth is... "I have no intention of letting you get away—no matter what it takes." Will his overprotective, overly loving nature (a yandere) gradually become clear?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 夜会で『適当に』ハンカチを渡しただけなのに、騎士様から婚約を迫られています
title.romaji: Yakai de "Tekitou ni" Hankachi wo Watashita dake Nanoni, Kishi-sama Kara Konyaku wo Semarareteimasu

202262.description:
Fleur, the daughter of a baron, has been plagued by the advances of Victor, the son of a duke and a genius at magic, ever since he proposed to her as a child. So she tries to retaliate against him, which embarrasses her, but... it ends up making him happy, saying, "I'm so glad you think of me that much!"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 公爵子息の執着から逃げられそうにないので、逃げないことにしました
title.romaji: Koushaku Shisoku no Shuuchaku Kara Nigerare Souninai node, Nigenai Koto ni Shimashita

202263.description:
On this planet, where a substance called Eurium, which contains extraordinary energy, is produced, people living in the wasteland fight over it. The protagonist, Goodjet, sets out on a journey to his hometown, the "Knight's Castle."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 碧雲物語 ~女のおれが霊法界の男子校に入ったら~
title.romaji: Hekiun Monogatari: Onna no Ore ga Rei Houkai no Danshikou ni Haittara

202265.description:
In a world where magic is everything, Princess Electra is branded as incompetent and unable to use any magic. But one day, the enemy country's most powerful magician, the Holy King, approaches her, claiming that she is "the only person who can kill him"...!?

"If you could kill me, I couldn't be happier."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 聖王猊下は無能王女に殺されたい
title.romaji: Seiou Geika wa Munou Oujo ni Korosaretai

202267.description:
Do-Young, a repeat student looking for a private tutor to help him get into a Korean university, decides to take lessons from his class president, who was introduced to him by a high school friend. However, Ha-Jin, the class president from the first semester who disliked him, joins as his tutor...

Do-Young is constantly distracted by Ha-Jin, and Ha-Jin suggests canceling the tutoring.

"If I misbehave again, you can hit me, punish me, or whatever you want!"

Do-Young, unable to give up on the tutoring, says these urgent words, sending the class into a completely different direction.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: I Hate This Kind of Tutoring!

202268.description:
Si-Won and Beom-Woo had been friends since childhood. Therefore, the news that Si-Won had suddenly left to study abroad without a word deeply hurt Beom-Woo. Six years later, a familiar voice sharply pierced Beom-Woo, who had been living a dissolute life...

"Are you a slut?"

As if to prove that much had changed in their relationship.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

202270.description:
Morita Shinichi is a charismatic editor who has driven the manga industry, with over 50 million copies of his work in print. He oversees well over 100 authors, and if he works on them, they're sure to sell... But then, the "most dangerous" new author, Komomo, comes to him with a proposal! This is a manga artist and editor's work story that exposes the methods of manga editors that you don't want to be known about!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: こももりた～持ち込みに来たのは極道娘～
title.romaji: Komomo Rita: Mochikomi ni Kita no wa Gokudou Musume

202271.description:
Is this a strange phenomenon or an incident?

A diary of the dead is delivered to Kuki Yuuji, who lives in Shinshu. It is a memento of Kuki Sadaichi, Yuuji's great-uncle who died in battle at the end of the Pacific War, and it contains a strange obsession with life. From that day on, mysterious events begin to occur around Yuji, such as the destruction of his gravestone and the disappearance of his grandfather. Yuuji and his wife Yuriko decide to turn to Hokuto Souichirou, an expert on paranormal phenomena, for help, but...

(Source: Monthly Comic Flapper, translated)

202272.description: Kagetora Fujiwara, an undefeated high school fighter, prides himself on being the toughest guy in school. But one day, he suffers an unfortunate "traffic accident". When he wakes up from the accident, he finds himself... transformed into a girl!! As Kagetora reels in shock, an unexpected "visitor" arrives, piling on the drama—!?!?

202273.description: While sealing Digimons that appear in a devastated futuristic city, Ryoma encounters a small Digimon and ends up taking it home with him...

title.native: デジモンビリーバーズ

202274.description:
1-3. Yorimichi (よりみち, Dropping By); Comic Kairakuten 2023-11, 2024-01, 2025-03
4. Okaeri (おかえり, Welcome Home); Comic Kairakuten 2024-03
5. Okaeri no Omake (おかえりのおまけ, Welcome Home - Bonus); Weekly Kairakuten 2025 No.26
6. Futari wa Koibito (ふたりは恋人, They're Lovers); Comic Kairakuten 2025-02

title.native: バ先の人妻を孕ませるまで
title.romaji: Basaki no Hitozuma wo Haramaseru made

202275.description:
he Blood Ghost King of the Ronin, the son-in-law of the Seven Kings of Ronin who ruled the Ronin world at the time, suddenly died under suspicious circumstances...

Not only the Ronin world, but the martial arts world of the world was thrown into chaos, and those who had harbored wild ambitions for a long time each drew their hidden swords!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

202276.description:
The most powerful martial art of all time is the Heavenly Demon's Golden Wind. Shaolin's Reverse Heaven and Earth Strike can counter the Golden Wind, but it cannot defeat it, only providing a single defensive measure. Only one being can subdue the Golden Wind. He is the invincible Cheonhyang, the one who cannot be matched by anyone and compels them to swear obedience!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

202277.description:
The Ghostly Heaven! The Poisonous Heaven! The Emperor's Heaven! The Afflicted Heaven! The Mysterious Heaven! It is called the Ninefold Heaven. The Ninefold Heaven suddenly appeared in the world, ended the thousand-year era of the Demonic Cult, and then disappeared. The martial arts people finally learned one truth through the fall of the thousand-year Demonic Cult. The fact that there exist secret protagonists who control the human world from behind the scenes and shape history!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

202278.description:
Iizuka, a non-drinker, falls in love with Ogasawara, the top drinker in the general affairs department, and wants to drink with her. By chance, he meets Yoshizumi, the proprietress of the drinking spot "Akayoroshi," and begins to walk the path of alcohol with her guidance.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ふたなり娘はヤりざかり
転校先のド田舎でクラスの彼女候補たちが全員発情期すぎる
title.romaji: Tenkou Saki no Do-Inaka de Class no Kanojyo Kouho Tachi ga Zenin Hatsujyouki Sugiru

202283.description:
"I just opened the cap of a plastic bottle."

Remembering the smile of a young girl who thanked him for such a trivial thing, 18-year-old Shido Isamu tries to escape the world of the Yakuza, which he had one foot in. However, the Yakuza who were chasing him suddenly transform into hideous monsters. On the verge of death, Isamu is faced with a "choice." "Become a monster and fight, or die" -- those who crave "life," get closer to "death." A bloody battle action game where you punch, punch, punch, and punch!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

202284.description:
I want to warp that expression. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Rookie manga artist Sakagami Yayoi is guided by a mysterious doll named "Nakano-loving Nakano-san" to enjoy delicious food and a mysterious experience at a bar in Nakano! A gourmet report from the mecca of subculture.

202292.description:
Tian Yuan loved growing flowers, so transmigrating to a cultivation world to raise Spirit Plants should have been a natural fit for him, but after he unexpectedly awakened a Gardener System, things got weird… How did this seed end up growing into a Flower Demon Empress?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

On the remote island of Beomhae, Se-ju has spent years loathing the suffocating traditions of her home. As she becomes entangled with a man harboring a dark secret, the island she once considered a prison becomes the backdrop for a perilous affair. In a place where secrets are buried as deep as the sea, she must decide if he is her ticket to freedom or a beautiful trap.

(Source: Lezhin US)

202294.description:
In order to repay her debts, the daughter of an earl, Corne, becomes the caretaker of the second prince, Melvin. One day, while Melvin is at her mercy, she discovers his secret! He is a recluse who doesn't trust people!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

202297.description:
The semi-criminal group "REAL GOD GROUP" and their debtor, Kotegawa Pan, arrive at a lake deep in the mountains where a mass murder took place 30 years ago. Pan doesn't want to spend even five seconds with these guys, who have zero academic ability and zero ethics, but the party that takes place at the lake is the worst: loud music, chase after Pan as he runs away, and whoever catches him first gets to have sex. He'd rather die, but he's also afraid of dying. After running through the dark forest, Pan meets...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: どっちが？どっちも？お姉ちゃん⁉

202299.description:
Han-Gyeol , who was treated like a fool by his ex, ended up cheating on him after a long relationship. To console his empty heart, he decides to vacation in the countryside where he lived with his parents as a child. His damned ex-lover is too busy fucking someone else, so he feels heavy inside. Han-Gyeol, enjoying a relaxing masturbation session at home during his rare vacation, is caught by a strange man...?! But that man is Sung-Chan, the kid next door who used to play with him?

"You were the one who asked me to marry you first...!"

Sung-Chan presses him, mentioning a mysterious proposal Han-Gyeol made in the past. Well, I can't remember a thing about it!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

202304.description:
“Want to take a break from drinking with me?”

Ayako Suzumura, an office lady who loves alcohol, has a habit of flirting with people when she gets drunk. One morning, Moe-kun, the college guy living next door, came to visit her. Last night, a tipsy Ayako had asked him, “Please make miso soup for me every morning,” and he brought her homemade food. This encounter changes their neighborly relationship... and a weekend-only, heart-fluttering alcohol-free day life begins!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 週末は恋を召し上がれ

202306.description:
Seeking the power of a dragon's body...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Isekairakuten Vol.43

202307.description:
Lumiera, known as the “Ice Flower Doll” for her beautiful yet expressionless face, decides to “smile” for the stern yet kind Knight Commander, Jilvis, after an arranged marriage proposal arises between them following her love at first sight.

If only I could become a proper “heroine”... When I was reincarnated into another world, I wasn't the protagonist or the villainous noble lady—I was just an unnamed extra!?

A quietly sweet love story between the "Clumsy Knight Commander" and the "Lady with Dead Facial Muscles".

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title.native: 氷花の初恋 笑わぬ令嬢は無骨な騎士団長を恋い慕う
title.romaji: Hibana no Hatsukoi Warawanu Reijou wa Bukotsu na Kishi Danchou wo Koishitau

202308.description:
Saeka has worked at her company for four years, and is generally seen as a reliable coworker who is trusted by everyone. However, she’s not so good at relying on other people! Not even her own boyfriend! Smoking in secret is the only way she knows how to de-stress. One day, her former superior who knows about all her screw-ups back in her rookie days transfers from Kansai to her office. While she tries her best not to show any weakness to him, she also finds herself bonding with him over time as he helps her with her stress in his own way!

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: A Sweet Kiss After the Last Train
title.native: 終電後は甘いキスして

202310.description:
Magazine editor Miku is considering her future with her live-in boyfriend, Souta, but her busy work schedule keeps them drifting apart. One day, when her work finally settles down, she comes home and discovers Souta cheating on her with a female coworker! Frantically running out of the house, Miku is saved by Aoi, the young owner of a long-established kimono shop she previously interviewed. Knowing she has nowhere to go, he invites her to his house, and when she tries to leave immediately, he tells her, "I want you to stay here a little longer!"

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title.english: Come Over to My Place, I'll Love You: Luxury Living With the Young Heir
title.native: うちにおいで、愛してあげる 若旦那様と極上同棲

202311.description:
"I won't let you be alone anymore."

An Ashduster refers to a person who captures ash-flies, black butterflies that are believed to bring misfortune, and delivers them to the mortal gods. Yoi is one such Ashduster, and is viewed with disdain by the villagers. But despite their terrible treatment, she lives each day with positivity. Her whole world changes when a mortal god saves her from an attack by the angry villagers, who blame her for the village's misfortunes.

"And if anything ill comes your way, I will purge it."

Don't miss out on this fantastic tale of a lonely girl awkwardly learning about love.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Mortal God of Night and the Maiden Ashduster
