202313.description:
"Yuki is the best" - Yuki believed those words and spent a lovey-dovey week with Seiichi, a disco bartender. However, one after another, women started appearing in front of Yuki claiming to be Seiichi's girlfriend... Her happy mood suddenly turned into the depths of despair!! Will she have to break up with Seiichi like this? After stealing her detective father's handcuffs, Yuki takes a surprising action to make Seiichi her own...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

202314.description:
Nanae, 16, finds out her boyfriend is actually the "king of the sex industry"!? Panicked by this shocking revelation, Nanae turns to Mimata, the school's top sex expert, to impart her techniques to captivate him! During her sensual training with Mimata, Nanae's mind and body are thrown into disarray, but...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

202315.description:
This is Shinjuku Kabukicho. Why not make your life blossom at the legendary cabaret club "Feeling Goddess," where you can get everything you need, from love to money? A miserable life where you've never been popular, an office lady who's too inconspicuous and only a wallflower, a poor student who dreams of brand-name items... The club manager, Ryuu, will help you to blossom! A slightly naughty and warm, sexy cabaret story.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

202320.description:
"Choroin" is the only spell capable of breaking the karmic bond with the demon race. Using this spell, the protagonist has sex with the hero in the bath, engages in "big sister" play with the magician, punishes the doubting priest, and indulges in whatever desires he pleases. What effects does this spell unleash, and how far can its erotic potential go? This is the story of a jobless, unemployed NEET protagonist who, after reincarnating into another world, builds a harem of beautiful girls tailored to his liking.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

202321.description:
Yulia is the beautiful daughter of the Duke Anker, but she has the reputation of being a haughty and cold-hearted "villainess," which caused the Fourth Prince to break off their engagement. Instead, she gets married to the widowed Marquis Winkler, a man with the fearsome nickname of "The Grim Reaper."

(Source: Comic ZeroSum, translated)

Note: Originally published as a short-story in vol. 14 of the anthology "Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Shiawase ni Natte Misemasu wa!"

202322.description:
There is a 34.9% chance that a cloned organism is going to make the same choices as in its "previous life." When the results of this experiment were confirmed, many institutions began implementing human cloning programs in secret; eventually, a baby boy was born on a winter night.

(Creative Comic Collection, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Their secret encounter is heating up. ♥

202332.description:
Nighthawk was a hitman who left even the most evil of men shaking in their boots at just the mention of their name. But it’s been eight years since the last hunt, and Nighthawk remains in the shadows. Well, not exactly the shadows. Nighthawk is now retired, living on her own in a pigsty apartment, spending every last bit of money on gambling and gacha games. She’s far from the fearsome figure she used to be and is more of a NEET than a stone-cold killer! But with eviction on the horizon and barely any yen left, Nighthawk will have to make her return. Can this current female failure go back to being the deadly killer of legend, or has retirement turned her into someone useless?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

202333.description:
Underground idols. It's a world of darkness so strong that it swallows up the light that idols radiate. There are innocent girls who jump in without even realizing it, and people with a reason who hide their identities and sneak in. Because it's underground, there's also the smell of something dangerous going on. Hanako (15 years old), a streamer who wants to go viral, senses there's something interesting to film and infiltrates the underground idol group "Wonder Festival." But there's something dark about this group...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

202345.description:
When Seong-Ho logs off Survival Life for the final time, the last thing he expects is for the video game to become reality. Worse still, the game is set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and deadly monsters. Having awakened as a hunter with the ability to open dimensional gates, Seong-Ho rushes to build a hideout in another realm in order to survive as he works to level up his skills and abilities, preparing to save the world from impending doom. But with other hunters emerging and forming parties, there may be more to worry about than just monsters…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ผู้เชี่ยวชาญวันสิ้นโลก

202346.description:
The informal investigation carried out by the Japanese government, the military, investigative agencies, and ordinary citizens since 1892, about the strange phenomena called "Uzono Shiniko." It is said that if a human, animal, or any inanimate object's name is changed to "Uzono Shiniko," it suddenly attracts disaster.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.romaji: Mung Min Chiu Yan Lung Kei

title.native: 駈斗戦士 仮面ライダーズ

202349.description:
I-Sol Yeon, the school’s top student and biggest outcast, gains the ability to see people’s true feelings about her through the Hashtag Lens, which she acquires after making the ten‑quintillionth wish. Through the lens, she discovers that Shin-U Seong, her former middle‑school best friend she had a painful fallout with, has tagged her as “#my_first_love_and_trash.” Can I-Sol mend their broken relationship and overcome the pain of being betrayed by her first love?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: รักแรกติดแฮชแท็ก

202351.description:
In the year 20XX, the eruption of Mount Fuji caused a rapid deterioration in public safety in Japan, turning Tokyo into a crime-ridden city with an annual crime rate of 1.36 million. Chitose (15 years old), who transfers from Hokkaido to a high school in Tokyo, meets her classmate Ema (15 years old), whose hobby is watching adult videos. The girls head out into the dangerous streets after school. However, there are rumors that in this crime-ridden city of Tokyo there is a god called "Enma" who "eliminates" bad guys...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

202352.description:
High school student Sora Ueno lives in a small mountain town, but she has never truly felt comfortable there. The only person she could open her heart to was her childhood friend, Hinako. However, on the night of the Minazuki Festival in 1984, Hinako mysteriously disappeared. Everyone in the village claimed it was a “kamikakushi”—a divine abduction—and they made little effort to search for her.
Years passed, and in 1988, Hinako suddenly returned… looking exactly the same as she did four years earlier. After her “return,” Hinako faces fear and rejection from the villagers and slowly becomes isolated. Determined to protect her no matter what, Sora stays by her side. But soon, disturbing mysteries surrounding the town and Hinako’s disappearance begin to surface…

(Source: Yuri-hime, translated)

title.native: ひなちゃんが生きてるなら

202354.description: Note: Published in Little Girl Strike Vol. 8

title.native: 勉強よりもエッチしよ♥

202357.description:
Kairakuten's proud Big sister master invades anew.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #38

title.native: ココハ家族ガキエル町
title.romaji: Koko wa Kazoku ga Kieru Machi

202359.description:
Living together with her boyfriend for the first time. Yui always gets dumped because of her caring motherly personality, but she hopes that this time she'll finally be able to live happily ever after, but she soon finds out that her boyfriend is cheating on her. With nowhere to go, she ends up staying in the room of her close childhood friend, Mizuki. They've been together since they were little, and she thought she knew everything about him. But then Mizuki says something meaningful to her in a low tone: "Don't ever come into my room"...?

A thrilling, sweet, and strange obsessive love that crosses the line between childhood friends!!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title.native: 僕の愛はふしだらに歪んでいる
title.romaji: Boku no Ai wa Fushidara ni Yugan de Iru

title.native: 有栖ツバサの探偵奇譚

202361.description:
Kanae is having trouble balancing her work and love life and she is now contemplating her future with her younger boyfriend. As the difference in their way of thinking and daily routine started to put a strain on their relationship, that's when the handsome and highly educated Haruka started working at Kanae's place.

Haruka's presence has provoked Kanae's insecurities and now she sees him as her rival. In the midst of this, she got dumped by her younger boyfriend!

title.native: キスでとろけて～エリート研究員からは逃げられない～
title.romaji: Kiss de Torokete: Elite Kenkyuuin Kara wa Nigerarenai

202363.description:
Sayo was the breadwinner of a family of four and worked as a full-time housekeeper. However, one day, her employer decided to emigrate overseas and she lost her job. The interview her younger brother recommended to Sayo, who was feeling down, was actually an arranged marriage meeting with Arima Junya, the heir to a large corporation!? In order to support her family, Sayo decided to become Junya's contract wife under the conditions he presented to her! Junya was cold towards her at first, but he gradually became attracted to her, as he showed occasional awkward kindness. And Junya, in turn, began to be captivated by Sayo's earnestness.

We just needed to spend a year as a fake couple. Or so we thought, but...

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

title.native: 雇われ婚～冷徹社長は契約妻を甘く愛す～
title.romaji: Yatoware Kon: Reitetsu Shachou wa Keiyaku Tsuma wo Amaku Aisu

202364.description:
One day, Kinu, who works as a maid, suddenly finds herself married off to a famous "eccentric" linguist, Mayuri Matomi, who is older than she is. Kinu, who feels inferior because she has no home to return to and is a "returnee," is unsure if she can make it as a married couple with someone she doesn't even know,

What will happen when Kinu and Iyeri begin their awkward married life together? This is a pure love story for adults that depicts how two clumsy couples slowly develop their love and become irreplaceable.

title.native: 出戻り女中と奇人学者のと或る結婚
title.romaji: Demodori Jochuu to Kijin Gakusha no to Aru Kekkon

202365.description:
Even if she didn't have any friends in her class, she thought music was enough. Until she became "friends" with him... Ryou, a second-year high school student, was born with a mean look in her eyes, has trouble talking to people, and tends to be unsociable. Because of this, people around her often fear her, earning her the nickname "Iron Mask" in middle school. Even after class changes this year, she hasn't been able to make any friends, and she feels depressed every day. Then one day, when Umemori, the most outgoing student in her class, approaches her, her lonely daily life begins to change into a bittersweet school life...!?

Her first male friend, her first feelings, her first love... A pure love story filled with many firsts between a girl in a band and a outgoing boy with a secret!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: はじめての男友達、はじめての××
title.romaji: Hajimete no Otoko Tomodachi, Hajimete no xx

202366.description:
Two years ago, zombies appeared all over the world. Countries fell into panic, and human society was on the brink of an end—but it never came! In a "With Zombies" society where people live with zombies who neither attack nor infect others, the fundamental principle of human history that "dead people can be resurrected" has been turned upside down, causing a frenzy of work for government officials! This is a comedy about the work of the Resurrection Department, starring the passionate new heroine, Tokai Rin, and the talented and eccentric section chief, Samura, in a slapstick duo!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: There Are Zombies Buried Under the Government Office.

title.native: 役所の下にはゾンビが埋まっている
title.romaji: Yakusho no Shita ni wa Zombie ga Umatteiru

202367.description:
When someone you love asks you to do something, you have no choice but to do your best. The cat who works at the company in place of the missing Yoshizawa is called "Yoshizawa Cat." It's already been five years since he started waiting, enduring harassment in human society... When will Yoshizawa come back?! A comedy manga about the everyday life of a hardworking cat who is both tough and adorable, and devoted to Yoshizawa!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ボーイミーツ心霊ガール
寝ている(?)お兄ちゃんにイロイロしたいっ!
好きな子がいるのに魔法少女に犯されています
title.romaji: Suki na Ko ga Iru no ni Mahou Shoujo ni Okasareteimasu

202371.description: Tsumugi Anzaki, the center of the underground idol group "Frozen Raspberry," has been abandoned by the president of a small agency, and she takes a huge gamble to keep the group alive! "Cinderella Game" is an underground internet show that makes girls play various games. Viewers invest in the girls, and the winner gets all the money invested in the loser. A humiliating punishment game awaits the loser. Just participating in the game will raise the group's profile - Tsumugi takes to the stage to get her hands on the glass slippers!

202372.description:
Hiroki Dan, the Chief of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's 1st Investigation Division, is an elite among elites with a brilliant career. But his hidden side is that of a serial killer who dispenses vigilante justice upon sinful villains.

This is the second official spin-off of "Trace: Reminiscences of a Forensic Scientist." The devil's enviable record of vengeance, preying upon the wicked, begins again.

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

title.native: ドゥーム 殺人警察官の断罪録

202373.description:
"You look like you want to come back tomorrow, too."

Arai, a former high school teacher who recently joined a window-cleaning company, is finally assigned to high-rise work. His mentor is Takami-san, a senior colleague who is younger than him. Although afraid of heights, he heads out in the gondola, only to find his heart racing even faster thanks to her words and actions...?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

202374.description:
The story is set in 18th century London. Megan, the daughter of a wealthy merchant who is a sensation in high society, travels to Scotland, her father's homeland, after a certain incident. This is a historical romance about a girl who survives a stormy fate.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

202375.description:
Kokorosaki Nora, who will soon be in her second year of high school, is saved from a difficult situation by a male classmate, Sasaki Haru, and falls in love with him. Competition is fierce, and Nora hears rumors that there is a person nearby who is so beautiful that it makes people lose the will to fight, but she still refuses to give up. However, one day, the person in question appears before Nora...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 恋とシンクロニシティ

202376.description:
Machida Rei lost her parents at a young age and was bullied by her aunt and uncle and her twin sister. She often dreams of herself in a hakama, sewing while thinking of someone, but she never understood what these dreams meant... One day, after being hurt by her sister's fiance and having her mother's keepsake broken, Rei runs away from home and heads to Kitsunozaka Shrine. There, she hums a tune she heard in her dream, and Aoi, the head of the Kitsunozaka family, appears as if guided! He saved people during the great earthquake 100 years ago and is worshipped as "Tenko-sama," and even now he continues to wait for the reincarnation of his one and only "soulmate."

This is the Cinderella story of a girl guided by fate, with a dramatic reversal of events!

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

202377.description:
Zhen Jin is a woman who made a fortune as a jewelry craftsman. She was living a life filled with happiness as she was about to marry her kind-hearted fiancé. However, her beloved, who was to become her husband, died suddenly in a freak accident. Since then, unable to accept the truth, Jin has become devoted to psychics and religion, seeking advice from many people only to be deceived repeatedly in her desperate hope of seeing her fiancé again. One day, Jin is visited by a man named Roilo Urara, who claims to be a posthumous marriage consultant.

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

title.native: 快楽堕ちした女優の末路
title.romaji: Kairaku Ochi shita Joyuu no Matsuro

202379.description:
Notes:
- Originally published as a one-shot in Dear+ November 2022 issue, was then picked up for serialization.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: レンタルくんの溺愛は（仮）じゃない
title.romaji: Rental-kun no Dekiai wa (Kari) ja Nai

202382.description:
Hogil Byeon is a third-class killer in the criminal organization Glory Club, with no way up and only one way out. He pivots into law, but his knack for killing doesn’t disappear. Juggling courtrooms and bullets, Hogil starts redefining justice his own way. The law has limits, but Hogil doesn’t. When a lawyer has killer skills, justice is served… with a bang!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ทนายสายนักฆ่า

202383.description:
Ji-Yu thought her first relationship would be nothing but happiness, until an uneasy suspicion takes root. Her boyfriend seems a little too attached to his female friend, and Ji-Yu can’t tell whether she’s being paranoid or not. Desperate for clarity, she downloads an AI dating advice app called Love Meddler. Instead of gentle reassurance, it hits her with brutal honesty. As the app starts “meddling” in her love life, Ji-Yu is left wondering how an AI understands her so well. The thing is, perhaps it’s not AI at all and rather someone who has recently re-entered her life…

(Source: WEBTOON)

202388.description:
Hired as a pretend interpreter for a masked band who secretly just makes up all the answers for them during interviews…?!

The latest work of Abishi Wakatake: a tear-jerking, laugh-out-loud, coming-of-age comedy-drama for adults!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synonyms: Putting My Broken Husband to Sleep

202393.description:
My dad is a famous rock guitarist. He sometimes appears in front of me and teaches me how to play the guitar. But my mom hates him and the guitar. But that doesn't stop me from dreaming about him. Even if I'm teased or scolded, as long as I have this...

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

202398.description:
In 1943, on the European front of World War II, men soared through the blood-stained skies. Captain Stanley commanded the B-17 bomber "Prison Lady." Though they belonged to the U.S. Eighth Air Force, while regular bomber crews could return after 25 missions, these men were under the harsh condition of not being able to leave until the end of the war. But why? These hellish knights, dodging bullets and flying through the roaring noise and flames, could they ever find a place of rest?

(Source: Group Zero, translated)

Note: includes one extra chapter.

202400.description:
The main character, Mao, has trouble reading the mood and building good relationships with others. He has stopped going to school and has been holed up at home, spending his days drawing. One day, he goes to a ballet studio in Sapporo to help out at his family's restaurant. There, he witnesses the performance of "one of the country's leading professional ballet dancers".

"The more cruel, the more beautiful life is." His heart is drawn into the cruel yet brilliant world of ballet.

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

202401.description:
There's a mouse in this house. Masaki Osawa, who runs a small dental clinic in a certain town, has a secret. His eldest son, Shota, was accepted into a prestigious junior high school and was aiming to become a doctor, but he has been holed up in his room for seven years. The distortion he has repeatedly glossed over with phrases like "Eventually...", "I'm sure...", and "Eventually..." begins to move again when his daughter proposes marriage.

This is a comic version of a story of a family's despair and rebirth in an age when one million people are hikikomori!

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

202402.description:
In the north of the continent, far from civilization, a young girl named Luca lives in a village inhabited by nomads. As a child, she dreams of becoming a "hunter," but her father, who is a hunter by trade, does not seem to approve of her.

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

202410.description: Nanami Maesaka, a fourth-year university student, aspires to be an architect. Her current goal is to win the "Sendai Design League," an architectural competition to determine the No. 1 student architect. Can Nanami, together with her trustworthy juniors, create a masterpiece and take a big step forward as an architect? Low pay, grueling work, and a ruthless meritocracy...but dreams are limitless! Set in a cutting-edge "atelier-style architectural firm," this is a passionate coming-of-age story of young people striving to forge their future through architecture!
synonyms: MYS - The Myth of Architecture and Architects

202411.description:
In this world, there exist divine beings beyond mortal comprehension. To them, the concepts of good and evil mean nothing. From destructive physical manifestations to the manipulation of dreams and warps in the very fabric of reality, the gods continuously threaten peace across Japan. And humans are completely at their mercy. Agent Katagishi and his junior partner Miyagi belong to a secret government organization tasked with investigating supernatural incidents. It's their job to handle cases involving deities and the dangerous humans who worship them. And in the midst of it all, Katagishi is determined to track down his missing wife, even if it forces him to confront a terrible truth...

(Source: Yen Press)

202413.description:
Created as a government measure against the declining birthrate and marriage rate, the "Room You Can't Leave Unless You Have Sex" came to be. The protagonist, Mutsuki, is summoned to the room during his summer vacation, where he runs into his stepsister, Tomoe, who was born from his parents' remarriage. Mutsuki is completely flustered, thinking, "She's family, after all!" But Tomoe aggressively pursues him regardless. Just when he thinks he might be able to leave soon, Tomoe declares, "I have no intention of having sex with you, Mutsuki-kun." Instead, she decides to treat the comfortable room as a vacation resort. "Can this really be called a vacation!?" Mutsuki is left utterly bewildered. Can he survive this bizarre holiday with a stepsister who claims, "I'll do anything naughty for you, as long as it's not sex!?"

(Source: melonbooks; translated)
synonyms: Vacation in a Room You Can't Leave Until You Have Sex

Hitomi, known as the 'Lunch Boss' for her unmatched passion for a good meal, lets her own 'lunch antenna' guide her once again today as she hunts down another perfect 'nice lunch'.

202433.description:
A Heian-period fantasy from the author of Naraku no Exorcist!
A twisted, outlaw magic-user and a mischievous, elite onmyouji.
Fate cruelly separates these two lovers…

202434.description:
She escapes a broken marriage determined to rebuild her life yet something feels strangely off. The husband who once seemed distant now treats her with overwhelming devotion, almost as if he had always cherished her. Even knowing her future is headed toward ruin, nothing changes overnight… until she discovers a hidden truth about herself that shifts everything. Armed with new confidence and a second chance, she vows to rise to the top in every part of her life family, business, revenge, and maybe even freedom from her marriage. This time, she refuses to lose anything.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Mr. Akasaka is a successful salaryman. He's got money, looks and style. But for some reason he cannot find a good man for himself. So after consulting his favorite bartender, he was given some great advice... "If you can't find a good partner, then just make one for yourself." Now Akasaka is determined to find himself a young partner who he can turn into the perfect prince! Maybe he may find one amongst his new work recruits...

Oikawa is a completely normal student, except for being a little sulky. One day during gym class, while he is captivated by Kawai, a carefree girl he secretly has a crush on, a flying ball hits him in the head and he passes out. When he wakes up in the nurse's office, Kawai is there! Oikawa tries to stand up immediately, but loses his balance and dives into Kawai's chest! What's more, Kawai has noticed Oikawa's penis, which has been quietly growing, leading to an unexpected development...!? He has a cute face but is quite extreme! A slapstick, sexually charged romantic comedy begins!

(Source: Rush!, translated)

202449.description:
"Crap... I think I'm hooked."

The cute introvert is the only one who can make me feel good. Tsubaki is the textbook definition of an introverted wallflower, but her extroverted classmate Sara is her biggest fan. Sara adores the curly-haired Tsubaki so much, but struggles to become friends with her. That is, until one day when Tsubaki suddenly starts heaving in the changing room when it's just the two of them. "I'm hypersexual..." she feverously explains. She was avoiding Sara because she had feelings for her. Seeing Sara's confusion, Tsubaki thinks it's over for her until Sara responds in a completely unexpected way.

"Tsubaki, it's all right... You can touch me if you want..."

(Source: Coolmic)

202450.description:
Our needy heroine and her friend who harbors complicated feelings for her meet for the first time in quite a while. This is the story of their strange cohabitation life.
Natsu, Hato's childhood friend, has finally returned after living in America for a while. They meet for the first time in quite a while.
Reminded of the times he bullied her, Hato was hesitant at first, but after seeing what a nice young man he had matured into, she was surprised.
The conversation and the alcohol flow.
"We should hang out more," Hato says, but suddenly Natsu's expression grows cold.
Suddenly, he steals a kiss and shows her something he's been holding on to.
How does Natsu know her secret...?
Natsu, who had been holding on to his feelings for Hato all these years, mercilessly violates Hato. And so begins their life together, bondage, domination... Will she escape his oppressive clutches?!

(Source: DLsite, translated)

202453.description:
Using suggestion, he erased all her sexual memories to teach her anew...

Shimaka, our main character, still recovering from the trauma of her ex-husband cheating on her, is no longer able to enjoy sex. After learning that her boyfriend from her university days, Tokioka, has gained some interesting talents, she asks him for the kind of help only he can provide.

But Shimaka's deep scars keep her from enjoying herself, so Tokioka suggests erasing all of her sexual knowledge. Now completely ignorant about sex, Shimaka feels no shame and no reason to hold back, so Tokioka teaches her all about being lewd.

Tokioka, however, is unable to control his feelings toward Shimaka, and indulges in the guilty pleasure granted by having his ex completely under his control...

(Source: DLsite, translated)

A single ship drifting through the vast expanse of space. A woman and a cat are heading toward Earth, but they cannot seem to reach it, and their hunger only grows. Then, someone arrives at her spacecraft...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

チートなスライム職人に令嬢ライフは難しい！
title.romaji: Cheat na Slime Shokunin ni Reijou Life wa Muzukashii!

202457.description:
In order to eliminate prejudice against them, Sister Mari Sakimori is sent to Mememori Forest Night School, a place attended only by the undead.

However, from her very first day, Mari is forced to search for the body of Nono, a scatterbrained zombie. On top of that, she’s attacked by zombies “in heat” along the way...
Can Mari really become friends with the undead under such circumstances?

202458.description:
The year is 1899. The Tokugawa Shogunate and the Satsuma-Choshu Alliance, which have yet to fall, are both preoccupied with hasty modernization and military buildup. Meanwhile, in the wilderness where the light of reinforced arc lamps does not reach, demons and monsters still run rampant. In this dark age, there was a man who continued to hunt demons unbeknownst to others. His weapons were the Winchester M1876Z rifle, the Colt Ambrose Bierce Special, and his unwavering resolve. As the last surviving member of the Imperial Demon Extermination Corps, he donned the ominous attire of a demon hunter and rode the black warhorse Shadow Wing. His name was... Lafcadio Hearn.

(Source: Amazon)
synonyms: Hearn the Last Hunter and the Esoteric Seven

title.native: 妖怪処刑人 小泉ハーン

202459.description:
Explore the true, dark history of Platy before the do-over. A must-read volume jam-packed with stories following Hadis without his Dragon Consort!

These are the darker stories about the continent of Platy, divided into the Rave Empire and the Kratos Kingdom, where there is no do-over and no Dragon Consort who loves Hadis. As various issues smolder beneath the surface of the two nations, tensions are high, and Hadis claims the throne as the Dragon Emperor. His only pillar of support is the Dragon God, invisible to the rest of the world. As the unfortunate history of the nations is unraveled and the secrets of his birth are revealed, countless betrayals and misunderstandings lead him to choose one route—purging everything within his sight.

What thoughts and hopes ran through the emperor’s mind as Jill’s family, friends, and Hadis’s siblings were all sent to their miserable deaths?! Explore the true history of the world if Jill had never become the Dragon Consort and set the emperor straight.

“Kill everyone. Don’t let a single soul escape.”

Join Hadis in bringing about the end of the world…

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title.english: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers the Dragon Emperor: The Official History of the Continent of Platy

Japan has collapsed in the wake of a zombie outbreak. Yet Dumitru the vampire continues his journey, alongside Ren; a young survivor whom he keeps around to serve as nourishment. What does he make of this world as they wander its ruins...?

The famed erotic novelist, Duan Jinghong, had a secret: with just a touch, he could foresee the intimate encounters of others. He avoided physical contact at all costs—until the notorious General Shen Tinglan, a man he’d never met, appeared uninvited at his door, demanding to share his bed.

To Duan Jinghong’s horror, his vision revealed an impossible future: tangled in passion with none other than the general himself… the same man betrothed to a royal princess.

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Frenzied Pleasure: Caught in the Allure of Vanity

202465.description:
As the son of the fallen House Anatold, Michel's only duty is to help his family's social standing by marrying the prominent Duke Shelleg of the north. However, upon his arrival, he is met with the servant Ain, who is acting as the duke's stand-in to teach Michel what it means to be a northern husband. To his surprise, his most important duties take place in the bedroom! Michel is determined to be a proper partner, but what will he do when his newfound feelings for Ain start to get in the way?

(Source: Tapas)

202466.description:
A collection of short stories detailing Jill’s life and work as the Dragon Consort!

“I didn’t think that I’d get a wife… A Dragon Consort.”

Hadis was asked for his hand in marriage during Gerald’s birthday party. What did he say unbeknownst to Jill? Find out in the bonus short story, A Gift from God.

In Operation Endless Surprise Attacks, Jill dresses up to surprise Hadis at the party, but she’s the one enamored by his enchanting appearance!

This short story collection is jam-packed with stories about the birth of Hadis Bear, a cooking battle between Hadis and Lawrence, and various scenes from the point of view of Jill’s friends! Learn more about their antics in the operation records of the do-over damsel!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

202493.description:
After failing to find employment three times, Toudou Kaede (29), who makes a living as a manga artist, is summoned to another world three days before the deadline. She is more afraid of dropping her manuscript than she is of the Demon King, so she decides to head into battle at full speed...!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

202494.description:
Wakagi Aine, a high school girl in love, has circumstances that prevent her from making public her beloved boyfriend. The only person who knows her secret is her best friend, Kazu-chan... A girl in love is always the strongest! A new love story from the masterpiece romance manga, Hanatsuka Soushiki!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

202495.description:
Back in high school, Shinonome-senpai was the shining star of the light music club. But when Sumi reunited with her 3 years later, something about her had changed completely...?!

A 42-page coming-of-age story connected through music, from a promising new talent.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

202496.description:
[Special one-shot published in Weekly Young Jump No. 14]

Aguro, the head of the art club, is attracted to club member Shirasaki, but...

(Source: Young Jump, translated)

202498.description:
"That day, I met my destiny..."

Hinata Ashiko, an office worker who has never been in love , meets a beautiful girl of unknown status, Reika, who says, "I'll do anything, just let me stay over." The two begin living together, and the true love that emerges is here. A beautifully written yuri tale of love and madness begins!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

202499.description:
Uhyeon Baek logs into Reverse Planet expecting a VR game, only to discover that the world is painfully real. A decade of grief and experiments turns him into a superhuman contract killer, and he finally executes the director behind his suffering. But when he returns to his original life, the ghosts of his fallen companions follow him. Haunted and restless, he goes back to Reverse Planet, only to realize he's entered the real game this time. Paired with superstar streamer Soyul Kang, his lethal efficiency goes viral... and puts him on the conspirator's radar.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: สตรีมเมอร์ยอดมนุษย์

title.native: こちら葛飾区亀有公園前派出所: 夏の納涼船の巻
title.romaji: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo: Natsu no Nouryousen no Maki

202501.description:
Hiro, a self-proclaimed former yakuza and outlaw YouTuber, goes to meet a man who has just been released from Osaka Prison after serving over a decade in prison. The man's name is Jinnai Sosuke. The story goes back to 1997, when they were working enthusiastically as members of the Tokushima-gumi gang... The story is set in Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture. The youth and repentance of a man who has just completed his prison sentence.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: ムショぼけ～懲役たちのレクイエム～
ガテン系巨乳ママに欲情して夜這いしてしまった件
title.romaji: Gaten-kei Kyonyuu Mama ni Yokujou Shite Yobai Shite Shimatta Ken

title.native: 勃起しやすい女装彼氏と清楚系淫乱な巨乳彼女
title.romaji: Bokki Shiyasui Josou Kareshi to Seiso-kei Inran na Kyonyuu Kanojo

title.native: 私の彼氏は「やさしい」だけ

202506.description:
Pako-chan is a part-time worker approaching her 30s. She has a strong desire to serve others and loves sex. But she's also lonely, sensitive, and a little unhealthy. This is the story of just one ordinary mentally unstable girl. It depicts the "sexuality" of human beings.

(Source: Homesha, translated)

202507.description:
Arose, a "trainer" who contributed to the hero's party's level-up with his skills but was expelled as he was no longer needed, returns to his hometown where budding adventurers gather.

He had decided to live a quiet life from then on, but then a young adventurer girl who showed no signs of growing up visits him, and before he knows it, he ends up accompanying her in her training.

An unconsciously powerful fantasy begins with a kind-hearted, all-round trainer and his friends who unknowingly become the "strongest"!

(Source: Micro Magazine, translated)

title.native: はじまりの町の育て屋さん～追放された万能育成師はポンコツ冒険者を覚醒させて最強スローライフを目指します～ THE COMIC
title.romaji: Hachimari no Machi no Sodateya-san: Tsuihou Sareta Bannou Ikusei-shi wa Ponkotsu Boukensha wo Kakusei Sasete Saikyou Slow Life wo Mezashimasu THE COMIC

202509.description:
Battling the supernatural are... a gyaru! A delinquent! And a scary-as-hell mom!? What kind of nightly battles with supernatural beings unfold at the Tamura family home!? A paranormal domestic comedy!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

202510.description:
On the day of the funeral, the younger brother suddenly comes back to life...! And then an older sister who calls herself God appears!? What choice does this God present to him...?

A beautifully illustrated one-shot drama about a funeral!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

202511.description:
A girl gazes out at the ocean one day, when a Great Old One appears?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

202513.description:
Despite receiving recruitment offers from prestigious high schools, Akane Hinageshi, left traumatized after conflicts with past teammates, has given up on playing basketball. But what happens when she suddenly receives an offer she quite literally can’t refuse…?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 美人妻・西崎薫の淫鬱な日常
title.romaji: Bijin Tsuma Nishizaki Kaori no Iin Utsu Na Nichijou

202515.description:
Eating is living. Hiromu is worried about his grandfather, who hasn't been eating as much since his grandmother passed away. Hiromu struggles with how to convey his feelings to his grandfather...

A quiet and warm story about the bonds of family.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

202516.description:
Miyano, a member of the same cleaning committee as me, always makes me do all the work?but she lets me touch her breasts as a reward, despite always looking down on me. What's going on here?

(Source: Coolmic)

202517.description:
A man visits a painter renowned for his skill but also known as an eccentric, having been ordered by his lord to commission a fusuma painting. The painter insists he won't paint the next work until he can properly depict a cat. As the man grows increasingly anxious over the never-ending, incomplete painting...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

202519.description:
An antique fantasy about an eccentric teacher and a tea bowl that is inhabited by a tsukumogami spirit.

One spring day in Ashiya, Hyogo Prefecture, a man unearths a beautiful tea bowl in his garden. The bowl is home to a tsukumogami spirit, whom the man names Shiro-san. They begin living together. Though Shiro-san has no memory of when or how he came to exist, he eventually learns that the bowl is actually a Shiro Tenmoku masterpiece and a national treasure that was once cherished by the Sengoku-period warlord Oda Nobunaga...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Note: Based on the 2022 novel of the same name by Madoka Takadono.

title.native: 芦屋山手 お道具迎賓館

202521.description:
A life-changing love story in a new world between a hard-working girl and a reliable old man.

Deer, a daughter who was cheated on her wedding day, broke her engagement, and was abandoned by her family.
She decides to abandon her home, her family, her hometown, and live alone in a remote village where she has no connections or connections.
However, Jiro, a former mercenary she met by chance, ran for her as a bodyguard, and decided to run away from town together.
She thought, "Let's forget everything and live alone."
synonyms: 질투와 승인 욕구, 그런 건 전부 버리고 시골에 틀어박힐 생각입니다

title.native: 嫉妬とか承認欲求とか、そういうの全部捨てて田舎にひきこもる所存
title.romaji: Shitto Toka Shounin Yokkyuu Toka, Souiu no Zenbu Sutete Inaka ni Hikikomoru Shozon

title.native: 転生した俺が可愛いすぎるので、愛されキャラを目指してがんばります
title.romaji: Tensei shita Ore ga Kawaii Sugiru node, Aisare Chara wo Mezashite Ganbarimasu

title.native: 堕ちた剣聖、腐神に拾われる
title.romaji: Ochita Kensei, Kusa Kami ni Hirowa Reru

202525.description:
"Please go out with me, with marriage in mind!"

A workaholic vice president dotes on his housekeeper... 10 years younger than him! After her older sister's matchmaking session with Koichi Otori, the vice president of a major company, fails, Shiori Sumida ends up meeting him too. Feeling that a girl like herself who can only do housework is not a suitable match for him, she is accepting when he tells her that he is not interested in marriage. However, instead, he offers her a job as his housekeeper and invites her to his place. Shiori cleans and makes dinner... After enjoying her homecooked meal, Koichi falls asleep, hugging Shiori as his body pillow...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: 신세 좀 질게요! 배부른, 고민 속 달콤한 생활

title.english: Thanks for Taking Care of Me!: A Lovey-Dovey, Delicious Life
title.native: お世話になります！ お腹いっぱい、もだあま生活
title.romaji: Osewa ni Narimasu! Onakaippai, mo Da Ama Seikatsu

title.native: アイドルを探せ 番外編

202527.description:
One day Sangha was suddenly kidnapped on her way home and murdered. During her final moments all she could look at was the wishing bracelet she had, the one she used to wish that someday she could be with the person she loves the most. With that being her last memory before fainting, Sangha suddenly wakes up four months before her death, Knowing that her death is already set, she decides to fulfill her wish and be with the man she loves, Her "Dad" which has a particular relationship with her.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: I Want To Hug Dad Today

title.native: あなたに愛や恋は求めません
title.romaji: Anata ni Ai ya Koi wa Motomemasen

202529.description:
Kitagawa is a funeral home employee with zero tolerance for irregularities. One day, while she's transporting a body, it suddenly strikes up a conversation—a talking corpse! Thus begins its final escapade—a wild car chase!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 月下のふたり～もういない君は、この恋を許さないだろう～
title.romaji: Gekka no Futari: Mou Inai Kimi wa, Kono Koi wo Yurusanai Darou

title.native: 少女漫画のはじめかた

202532.description:
Editor Hatsune is assigned a new role to a picture book author, "Ui-sensei," who turns out to be Mikado, her former middle school boyfriend! Hatsune's Mikado was her first love and first boyfriend. Now that she's reunited with him, she can't help but notice him...!? The two, who naturally drifted apart without even a kiss, are back together in this doting, redo-love story, doing everything they couldn't do 10 years ago!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

202533.description:
Insomniac CEO x Poor Girl: I'll sleep with you to settle your debts...!

Asahi, who works at a toy company, works hard to pay off her father's debts. However, her father takes out a new debt of 10 million yen and disappears. Kicked out of her apartment and at a loss, Asahi secretly stays at the company, but is found by the cold-hearted CEO Omi. "If you sleep with me, I'll give you 10 million yen," the CEO suddenly proposes, and they end up living together...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 眠れないのは月のせい
title.romaji: Nemurenai no wa Tsuki no Sei

202534.description:
"His kisses are sweeter than chocolate" -- The vice president, who is handsome, smells great, and is high-spec in every way, has suddenly chosen me as his fiancée! Misuzu has started working at a chocolate company. Her first impression of the bossy vice president is terrible... But she's charmed by his earnest dedication to his work, and at the mercy of the lonely expression he sometimes shows...? The vice president's sweet kisses just won't stop!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: His kisses are sweeter than chocolate

title.native: 俺様副社長のキスはチョコより甘い
title.romaji: Ore-sama Fuku Shachou no Kiss wa Choco Yori Amai

202535.description:
Tamako, 32, lives a steady life without drawing attention to herself. One day, she begins to think that romance doesn't suit her, until she meets a handsome young man, Yuma, at her workplace. Yuma turns out to be an old childhood friend of hers, and he immediately becomes attached to her! What's more, he asks her, "I don't have a place to stay, so can you let me stay with you for about a week?"...!? Suddenly, she's living with a man who keeps giving her money, and even having sex with him - this is not the right path for her! 32 years old and a second virgin, she begins a "restarting her life with a younger, worthless guy"!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 珠子はダメになることにした
title.romaji: Tamako wa Dame ni Naru Koto ni Shita

202537.description:
Erika's favorite actor is Yoshino, who is active in a theater company. Erika was always happy to watch Yoshino's plays at small theaters, but when Yoshino's drama debut was announced, the situation changed completely. "My favorite actor has been discovered by the world..." Erika follows Yoshino into this dazzling new "scene," but what happens next?! This is a life story filled with the "reality" of the favorite actor and his fan, who are the farthest and yet closest in the world.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title.romaji: Oshi no Jinsei × Watashi no Isshou

title.native: 柴崎さんのケモノみち

202539.description:
What she saw after losing her powers was the true beauty of the world... Amira, once hailed as the "omnipotent caster," has fully exhausted her magic force, making her just a regular dark elf. Once, she illuminated the world with her spells; now, she converses with the wind, kindles fire, leans how to cook, and searches for new meaning to her life. Quiet happiness and small miracles have taken the place of almighty magic in her life. What will she find in this second-life fantasy as she experiences rebirth after her loss?

(Source: K MANGA)

Note: Originally published as a one-shot, was then picked up for serialization in Monthly Young Magazine.

title.english: The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers
title.native: 魔力枯れのダークエルフ

202540.description:
In a world filled with monsters known as "labyrinths," Luke, who has been living alone in a labyrinth deep in the mountains, studies magic using a book left behind by his parents. He masters status magic, a requirement for admission to the Conqueror School (a training institution for those who can conquer labyrinths), and takes the exam, but fails the entrance exam. He is forced to become a "self-taught" conqueror, but despite starting from adversity, he overcomes various difficulties with his overwhelming ability and becomes the strongest adventurer.

(Source: Coamix, translated)
synonyms: The Strongest Mage Without Common Sense

title.native: 常識知らずの最強魔導師

202541.description:
Have you given up on that compensation? You gave up on your infidelity-filled husband and quickly divorced him, but your alimony and child support payments soon fell behind...?

The battle of the trampled-on couple begins, as they want to recover the full amount instead of just putting up with it!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 俺様婚約者には惚れたくありません！@COMIC
title.romaji: Ore-sama Konyakusha ni wa Horetaku Arimasen!@COMIC

202546.description:
On that day, one year ago, I kissed you and lost you.

Haruto, who attends high school in a seaside town, has two secrets.
One is that when he kisses someone, he can erase their memories.
And the other is—!?

A love story about a high school boy tormented by an unwelcome ability!

(Source: Monthly Shonen Sunday, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue chapter.

title.native: 君のキスが泣いている

202548.description: A manga based on SOUL BANKER, a game event series that is part of the Quiz RPG: The World of Mystic Wiz mobile game by COLOPL.

202549.description:
In the game world of Pangaenia, Hyeon-Myeong is known as “the Phantom,” an anonymous legend admired by players. In real life, however, he is jobless and still getting over his recent breakup. When his character is killed and permanently deleted, his only remaining goal to become the first gamer to beat Pangaenia is shattered. Soon, however, Pangaenia begins to merge with the real world, and Hyeon-Myeong gets a chance to start over--this time, with 13 hidden traits.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: เริ่มเกมพร้อม 13 คุณสมบัติลับ

title.native: 臆病くらげと恋知らず

title.romaji: Sono Te de Hi wo Tsukete

title.native: 異世界に転生しても社畜ですが、推し似の上司と頑張ります！
title.romaji: Isekai ni Tensei Shite mo Shachiku desu ga, Oshi ni no Joushi to Ganbarimasu!

title.native: 可愛がらないで、可愛がらせて

202555.description:
Ren Kanbe, a six-foot-tall omega who's never gone into heat, receives a furry proposal from an alpha with genetic reversion! Kanbe's spent his days being anything but a typical omega. One day, an alpha by the name of Hokuto Ashina passionately confesses his love for him. Ashina has genetic reversion, which in exchange for abilities greater than the average man, transforms him into a shiba inu whenever he gets tired. Kanbe can't hide his hesitation at Ashina's proposal, nor can he resist Ashina's cute shiba inu form...

An adorable omegaverse story with an even more adorable shiba inu to fawn over!!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: My One And Only Shiba Inu Love

202556.description:
Omomaru, a high school student with a strong conviction to hate and resent everything in this world, believing that all humans should simply die, one day meets a ghost named Reiko.

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

title.native: サラマンダーがご案内します

202558.description:
The world's most popular man, Onnadakou, will teach you secret tricks to become popular just by reading, such as what to wear to impress women and how to avoid mistakes on the first date! A love psychology guide manga brought to you by the golden duo of Yuuki Yuu and Sou!

(Source: Shounen Gahosha, translated)

202559.description:
This is a government authorized killing ground. In this classroom are 23 humans and 5 witches. Hunt down and identify the witches hiding in the class. A life-or-death “Witch Trial” begins, where deception reigns, and even friendships are exploited.

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

202560.description:
In the post-apocalyptic wasteland, the Void Sovereign Chen Luo outlasted all others by hiding with his special powers. But as the only remaining survivor in this zombie-infested world, he lost all hope and took his own life.

But he found himself reawakening back to one month before the apocalypse, and he retained the power to manipulate spatial dimensions from his past life. No time to talk, got to stock up on a billion goods! Chen Luo decided he will do things differently this time. He will build a safe haven and become the leader to survive the apocalypse!

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)
synonyms: Stockpiling Ten Thousand Tons of Pork During the Apocalypse

title.english: Stockpiling Ten Thousand Tons of Pork During the Apocalypse
title.native: 空间系老六，末世先囤一万吨猪肉
title.romaji: Kongjianxi Laoliu, Moshi Xian Tun Yiwandun Zhrou

202561.description:
As the ace of the PR department, Yuki is respected at work for her cool, dependable presence… but in reality, she adores cute things and has never dated a guy. Harsh words from an ex-boyfriend left her traumatized, making her afraid of commitment. Worried she can't go on like this, Yuki encounters Minato at her favorite bar — in the middle of a messy breakup with his girlfriend. They start talking, drinks flow, and — the next morning, she wakes up in a hotel room. Yuki flees in panic, only to find out that Minato is coming to work at her company!

And to make matters worse, Minato proposes a secret arrangement — a lover's contract — if she wants him to keep quiet about what happened...⁉︎

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: (嘘)恋人契約～気持ちイイ恋､始まりはワンナイト!?～
title.romaji: (Uso) Koibito Keiyaku: Kimochi Ii Koi, Hajimari wa One Night!?

202562.description:
“I used to wonder what kind of people would want to run away in the middle of the night... but actually, they're ordinary folks just like us, the kind you'd find anywhere...”

"Runaway Helpers" is a service that assists people escaping from abusive partners, toxic parents, or other untenable situations. This comic essay realistically depicts the shocking realities inside homes that appear perfectly normal from the outside — as seen through the eyes of the author who actually worked for Runaway Helpers.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

202563.description:
The I Tried Asking in Dogeza series is back and better than ever! Can you get reluctant women to do whatever you want just by getting on your knees and begging? All the reveal pages where the girls show their boobs and panties are drawn in full color!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: もっと土下座で頼んでみた

202565.description:
A mysterious day for a god and a kid whose family owns a bathhouse.

Note: Published in iHertZ band.82.

title.romaji: Ame no Hi ni Aeru yo
Kare wa Itoshii Mitsu no Aji

202571.description:
Jo A-yeong is a university student who is a celebrity on social media, but who worries about other people's opinions. She meets Kwak Ju-Hyeon, an underground rapper who doesn't care what others think of her. The two become friends and later girlfriends, facing various challenges and adventures in university life.

Note:
-Originally self-published on the author's Postype. Was published by KakaoPage on 2023-03-09.
- Include two extra chapters.

202572.description:
In the quiet village of Feltham, Eloise Surbiton leads a peaceful life far from the hubbub of the city, tending to geese and secretly fawning over dashing war hero Lt. Col. Ryan Wilgrave from afar. When her father mentions that a certain military man named Ryan will be moving to the nearby town of Cambourne, Eloise is thrilled — only to have her hopes dashed when she meets her new neighbor Ryan Thornton, a gruff soldier who is the opposite of the Ryan Wilgrave she knows. Little does she realize, there may be more to Ryan than meets the eye…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ไรอันที่รัก

202573.description:
"It's simple. Fuck them!"

I became a vampire after a ridiculous accident. For better or worse, I didn't need blood to survive. There's only one way to survive. Become a predator and suck girls' vital essence!

(Source: TOPTOON)
synonyms: 起死回生した俺は異能力で女を感覚操作してエロ無双する

title.native: オッサンの異世界は、何故かハードモード。
title.romaji: Ossan no Isekai wa, Naze ka Hard Mode.

202575.description:
Mok Na-Young, five years older than him, and Do-An, five years younger. They tied the knot after dating for just six months, and they're adoring each other every day! Na-Young, who enjoys every day of her newlywed life, is suspicious of her husband. With that face, she's saying he's her first love? With that body, she's experiencing everything for the first time?

The heart-pounding story of Na-young and Do-an's married life, a couple with a difference in age and gender.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: おっさんだけど聖女です

202577.description:
Meet Lifestyle Man, part-time superhero. Screwing up at work by day, smiting evil, saving lives, and earning gratitude by night, the most beloved hero of all time gets his own slice-of-life comedy series!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

202578.description:
Kayamori Yuuma, 24, runs a mobile supermarket in a lush mountainous area. One day after work, he drops by his usual store and has a disastrous reunion with his best friend, Rikuto, who suddenly disappeared when they were in elementary school. A chance request leads to the two of them being asked to do various things by the townspeople. A troubled high school girl asks them to investigate her father's infidelity, and they discover an unidentified flying object...

Up-and-coming artist Ayaki's first serialized work is a story of growth that begins with a reunion.

(Source: Michikusacomics, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: なつみのおじいとカメラ

202580.description:
Lee Yun, the youngest son of the Sermin family, a prominent house on the Dreia Continent. The once peaceful family descends into ruin after the disappearance of his father and brothers. And in the moment everything collapses, Lee Yun is captured by the Paton family and meets his end after horrific torture. But when he opened his eyes, he found himself not in reality, but in Adeon; an endless battlefield and playground of the gods. In that place where countless players lost their lives, Lee Yun grew into the Ghost King, a master player who mastered all classes: Assassin, Necromancer, and Ghost. He challenged the gods. He met his end in defeat, but his story did not end there. The moment he awoke again, he had returned to his childhood at age twelve, retaining the power of a player. To prevent his family's downfall and reclaim everything lost, Ri-yun now begins transforming reality into his own game board. His first target is bloody vengeance against the Paton family, another great clan that destroyed the Sermin family and killed him.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Player of the Fallen Noble Family

202581.description:
From Ryoko Kui, author of Delicious in Dungeon, comes a lush compilation of artwork drawn over the course of the hit series’ creation! Featuring hundreds of pages of comics, sketches, and full color illustrations, this gorgeous collection will help you discover new sides to your favorite characters as they’re depicted in situations you’ve never seen before! 

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Doodles by Ryoko Kui: Daydream Hour
title.native: 九井諒子ラクガキ本 デイドリーム・アワー

202582.description:
One day, an alien named Yoden arrives on Earth and uses a mysterious tool called the "Ability Gun" to collect and inject the special powers of various living creatures! Using the special abilities he has collected from space, he will change the fate of Earthlings into something super happy!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

202583.description:
Take a peek into the uneventful (...but still funny) daily lives of Aki, the older sister who is a working adult, and Kotomi, the younger sister who is a university student!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

202584.description:
A booklet released with Monthly Comic Beam December 2025 issue celebrating their 30th anniversary.

Cover Illustration: Tomoro Yamanaka
1. Hibi (罅) [Rensuke Oshikiri]
2. Ichigo-chan to Watashi (いちごちゃんとわたし) [Ayaki]
3. Rakugo "Pablo" (落語「パブロ」) [Kentarou Ueno]
4. Ki ni Naru Kofude-kun (気になる小筆くん) [Auri Hirao]
5. Kagami no Ondo (鏡の温度) [Kujirou Inuze]
6. Kanata yori no Hana (彼方よりの祝花) [Itsumi Narita]
7. Michiru Shachou to Uchuu Kava (ミチル社長と宇宙カバ) [Junko Mizuno]
8. Okashii kedo Yasashii (おかしいけどやさしい) [Takako Shimura]

title.native: コミックビームＬＩＮＥＡ-リネア-

202585.description:
On the first day of school, Miemi notices that her classmate Seo is possessed by many spirits. While observing him from afar, a certain change occurs...

(Source: Magcomi, translated)

title.native: 憑いてるクラスメイト

202586.description:
Do not overlook any unusual behavior. If you notice anything unusual, turn back immediately. If you do not notice anything unusual, do not turn back. Leave from Exit 8.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: こちら後宮日陰の占い部屋

202589.description:
Miss Elf doesn’t get much from sex - it’s simply how she makes her living. But her life is about to change when she meets Futoshi, a salaryman who works hard to afford her services.

(Source: FAKKU)

title.native: 無言・無表情の褐色エルフ、レンタルしてます

ぼくとバインとカタラーナ

202593.description:
Terashima, a high school student, has a crush on someone. It's the attendant at the local public bath. He doesn't know if she's his or her, but what are his feelings for her?

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

202594.description:
Yui Sasame, a descendant of vampires, feels out of place in her high school class. Unable to fit in with her human classmates, she's often late to school—something for which the class representative, Sekiya, relentlessly criticizes her. One day, angered by Sekiya's nagging, a dark impulse flickers through Yui's mind...

"Maybe I should just... suck him dry."

But that thought marks the beginning of something far more dangerous—an ecstasy said to surpass sexual pleasure a hundredfold. Thus begins the tragic tale of those consumed and undone by their own desires.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: クレイジー・キッチン
全力めし アリサはよく読みよく食べる
title.romaji: Zenryoku Meshi: Arisa wa Yokuyomi Yoku Taberu

202599.description:
Yuichi, a boy with supernatural powers, sets out on a journey with the cat spirit Shou to search for the notes left behind by his late master, Iroha. Due to his painful past, Yuichi has avoided facing humans, but as he encounters the warmth of the people and spirits he encounters on his journey, his heart gradually melts. What message did his master want to convey to Yuichi...? The start of a fleeting yet beautiful tale of supernatural beings, brought to you by illustrator Hanamori.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: いろはの書き導べ -雪解の路-
title.romaji: Iroha no Kaki Shirube: Yukidoke no Michi

202600.description:
Miyori Sotono is so obsessed with dating simulation games that she's lost all interest in her own love life. Instead, she puts her passion to use as a blunt but talented advisor at a matchmaking agency. Despite her sharp tongue, she's deeply dedicated to helping others find happiness and get married. One day, Miyori heroically saves a newly engaged client from being hit by a car—only to be struck herself. Thinking that she's been killed, she wakes up in a different world where marriage and values are completely different from those of modern society! With no special powers to rely on, Miyori decides to open a matchmaking agency to survive; but the clients who come to her have all sorts of problems...

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: I Started a Dating Agency in a Different World
title.native: 異世界で結婚相談所はじめました

202601.description:
A high school teacher on the surface, a super CEO underneath!? A new homeroom teacher arrives for Class 3-0 at private Eto Academy, a class filled with students with "zero motivation, zero talent, and zero future potential." Assigned to this ridiculously underachieving class, nicknamed "Class Zero," is a handsome but somewhat eccentric teacher named Kagami Rei. This teacher, whose wealth and drive are "extraordinary," defies all school norms. His true identity is a billionaire, the CEO of one of Japan's leading conglomerates!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

202602.description:
"Labyrinth Streaming" is a streaming service where players conquer dungeons that have appeared all over the world. At the request of his sister Maya, a labyrinth streamer, Suzuta Jin, a doting older brother, acts as the cameraman and takes pictures of her adorable little sister... but he gets caught in an unexpected trap and is sent flying to the boss floor. While shielding Maya, who is trembling from the S-rank monster in front of him, Jin is hit by a powerful attack...!? Will it go viral? Will it lead to a harem? It doesn't matter! Just subscribe to his sister's channel! An unconcerned, unrivaled streamer who only loves his sister is born!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: While I was helping my sister stream the labyrinth I accidentally defeated an S-rank monster and here is the result

title.native: 妹の迷宮配信を手伝っていた俺が、うっかりＳランクモンスター相手に無双した結果がこちらです

202605.description:
The main character, a boy who accidentally becomes a magical girl, spends his days fighting evil monsters that bring misfortune to people.
One day, the main character goes to the house of another male magical girl to replenish the magical power he used up in the battle with the monsters, but there he learns that the male magical girl's way of replenishing her magical power is by cross-dressing... That's the story.

(Source: Melonbooks )

Note: Released at Comiket 106

202609.description: After the loss of someone she loved, Vivian drifts between memory and reality, mistaking another person with the same name for the one she mourns. A tender, melancholic portrait of grief, unexpected connections, and gradual healing.

202610.description:
During the Edo period, a humble young man, Keita, embarks on a journey in search of his sister, who has been kidnapped by a god. Accompanying him is his sister's husband, Tenmaru. Keita is earnest and has a strong sense of justice, while Tenmaru is carefree and innocent, a former dragon god feared by the people. The two are polar opposites, and their relationship is strained only by their love for their respective sister and wife. A fantastical period drama from the author of Naraku no Exorcist!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

202611.description:
1. Gokuraku Mishin (極楽ミシン)
2. Gojuu-nen no Koibito (五十年後の恋人)

202615.description:
This is the tale of a young man who dreams of conquering a S-rank dungeon to fulfill a promise he made with his childhood friend with the help of his Multiplication Enhancement Magic.

Desmond, a D-rank adventurer who can only use basic enhancement magic, has a secret. Unlike normal enhancement spells that increase stats through addition, his ability is based on multiplication. Not +20, but x20!

However, his party fails to understand his ability's true power and banishes him from the party. Just then, his childhood friend Cynthia, a S-Rank adventurer, appears before him. Accepting her offer, Desmond joins the top-tier clan Chevalier Garden.

With his enhancement magic, he begins taking down fearsome dungeon bosses, clearing dungeons at impossible speeds, and achieving success.
synonyms: The banished Enchanter Rises to the Top with Overpowered Multiplicative Buffs: My Enhancement Magic Isn't +20, It's ×20!

202617.description:
CoroCoro Kuukiyomi. The explosive birth! A miraculous collaboration between the hugely popular game "Minna de Kuukiyomi." and "CoroCoro Comic"! All 15 works, including currently serialized works and legendary works from the past, have been turned into "Omae." Enjoy them together with the popular game!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

202624.description:
My first love came back, with my fiancé.

"Long time no see, pretty girl?"

Do-kyung, her first love, suddenly appeared before Yu-Ju, who was about to get married. It had been nine years. They had broken up when she was twenty, and when she met him at twenty-nine, he was still handsome, strong, and a mad dog.

"Just know this. I just bet everything I have on breaking off your engagement."

Yu-Ju tried to push Do-Kyung away, who had come to ruin her life again. Do-Kyung was incomprehensibly desperate for Yu-Ju.

"Yu-Ju. How far would you go for the person you love? I would be a mad dog for you, willingly."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

202625.description:
One-shot adaptation of "The Adventure of the Speckled Band", a short story by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle.

Note: Published in Kage No. 1 (April 1956).

202626.description:
Won Yu-Ha, a trainee who was unfairly robbed of the chance to appear on a survival program that was expected to be a huge hit, became a 'loser'. After six years of struggling to lead the members who had no motivation, a series of scandals among the members and a sudden traffic accident resulted in him being declared ineligible for a comeback.

"If I were born again, I would never become an idol."

Just when he was about to give up on life, determined to never dream of such a life again, "Appearing on Design Your Idol. You'll give it to me, right?" He returned to six years ago when he missed the opportunity of a lifetime... ?

『Tutorial: The Crossroads of Life! Spin the Roulette and Decide Your Life!』

And what is this thing that just popped up before his eyes?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Lucky Plan of An Idol In His Second Life

title.native: ヨシモトムチッ子物語

202629.description:
The wife's name is Asagi Yume, and the husband's name is Kujirakawa Ryou. These two ordinary manga artists fell in love in an ordinary way, and had an ordinary marriage. But there was one thing that was different: the wife wanted to eat "that thing inside their heads"! From reindeer, scorpions, centipedes, camels, Hokkaido deer brains, Japanese rat snakes, and chameleons! This is a unique and bizarre gourmet essay about bizarre foods, brought to you by a couple of manga artists who are among the industry's biggest fans of living things!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: アタマの中のアレを食べたい
title.romaji: Atama no Naka no Are wo Tabetai

202631.description:
After losing her parents, Seirena is forced to marry an elderly king and endure terrible abuse. Moreover, her uncle betrays her and eventually kills her. That should have been the end... But she wakes up back in the past, before this tragedy unfolded. This time, Seirena has a plan. She will change her fate by becoming a Chevalier, the highest rank of knight, to protect herself and her family. But having a relationship with her handsome captain was not part of her plan!

(Source: Tapas)

202632.description: A one-shot published in Manga Tengoku.

202633.description: Taiga Amachi, a diehard SD Gundam fan, joins the Gundam Research Group (also commonly known as "G-Group"). He does battle in a Gunpla battle simulator against the many enemies aiming to take down G-Group.

202636.description:
I, Sora Satou, woke up to find myself transported to what they call a "reverse chastity world." Although I was confused at first, little by little I adapted to this new world's values and eventually ended up working at a supermarket across from an all-girls high school. Just when I had finally gotten used to life as an employee under the kind and beautiful manager, a rumor started spreading: "That male employee... they say if you ask him, he'll let you do it." And so, a group of beautiful girls who took that rumor literally began to gather around me...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Rumor is I’m Easy Man if You Ask in a World of Reversed Chastity

202644.description:
Hanna, an ordinary high school student blessed with endless stamina, finds herself taking on a not-so-ordinary part-time job as a character performer for the beloved mascot and local hero Panboo. Donning a hefty panda costume, she does her best to embody the part, protecting the town as only Panboo can—even when the kiddies get too rough. But just as she starts to get the hang of things, she bumps into Ubukata-kun, a boy from the class next door, who comes dangerously close to uncovering the girl behind the panda. Will he figure out her little secret? How long can she keep bamboo-zling him? Only time will tell in this bear-ly believable love story!

(Source: K MANGA)

202645.description:
My younger brother's friend, Yeon-Jun, was just so cute. After he left for America, I completely forgot about him—but a few years later, he suddenly appeared and said, "You can just eat it and throw it away, so at least try it." His unfamiliar tone, his relaxed gaze. He returned as a completely different man.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

202653.description: A philosophical work depicting the turbulent daily life of a downtrodden, penniless young man living in an apartment building plagued by frequent hangings. Having come to a sheer cliff to end his life, Hajime Demodori is persuaded not to die by a beautiful woman he meets while eating his last supper, and they become a couple. The next day, when Hajime wakes up, he searches for the vanished women only to find three suicide notes left behind...!?

202654.description: Ekko Nakajima is a feisty little girl who lives alone with her father. One day, after many struggles, one of her father's musical compositions get selected by the Japan Music Association. From there, many joys and sorrows present themselves before them as Ekko's father ascends in the world of music.

202655.description:
Most people in this world are blessed at birth and receive their "Calling" when they come of age. Those who never receive their gift are known as the "Cursed Ones." When Fumi Matsukata turns ten without receiving her Calling, she's about to be abandoned by her family. Instead, however, they decide to keep her around as their servant.

Fumi's younger brother, Itsuki, on the other hand, is born with a powerful Calling, which he uses to torment Fumi incessantly. One day, the Matsukatas receive a proposal of marriage from the prestigious Togo Clan, a long line of clairvoyants. They assumed that the clan's eldest daughter wished to marry their talented son. So how will they react when they find out that the heir Seiji wishes to come take Fumi for his own?! In a world where those without a divine gift are scorned, a girl who's been taught that she's worthless suddenly becomes the wife of a formidable heir. Now that she's escaped her horrible family's clutches, will she find happiness? Will she find love?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: How I Married Into the Togo Clan

"There's one way to cure your frigidity... Let me love you."

A hot, assertive carpenter wants to change my body with passionate love?! After a year of marriage and becoming a victim of her husband's infidelity, Maki returns to her hometown. The reason? Her frigidity. Having lost all confidence in her femininity, Maki visits a shrine near her parents' home that allegedly heals what has been hurt if shown to the shrine's idol. However, as she slowly unbuttons her blouse and offers herself up, a buff hottie suddenly appears!

(Source: Coolmic)

A professional shogi player in his 40s, without a title, is shocked after losing to a young genius shogi player known as the "Demon King" in a Meijin match and is reincarnated as a little girl named Sakura.

Sakura has a twin sister named "Ouka" by her side. Sakura's thirst for shogi never ceases and she vows to get revenge on the "Demon King," discovering Ouka's talent!

Sirius has been surviving through hardship as a sex slave, when suddenly a noblewoman with a dwindling estate buys him from his previous owners. Sirius felt nothing but gratitude for the girl who decided to save him, but it seems upon hearing the name Astrea Matthews that he knows her from somewhere in his past... The man that was once a sex slave seems to have been a prince, charming and eloquent in every capacity... and what more could this mean in both heart and the bedroom...?

Alicia, the youngest daughter of Bloom Trading Company, which handles products for the royal family, is engaged to Felix, the son of a viscount. However, Felix, who is obsessed with cheating, neglects her. One day, Felix brings his lover home, and Alicia is fed up with him. She was supposed to break off the engagement and return to her peaceful daily life, but... The handsome, tough knight Einhart and her mysterious drinking buddy Noah suddenly become close! She ends up being aware of both of them at the same time...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

202669.description:
Adults tell children that bullying is wrong. But even adults cannot escape it... Bullying is a structural problem in Japanese society. It is an even more serious problem in the adult world. Long working hours, heavy workloads, and excessive pressure in the workplace create horrific scenes that are hard to bear. The reality is that adults have no way out. Is the oppressed weak left with no choice but to accept it? Kurosaki of the Green Labor Union uses the strategies of the weak to stand up against this unreasonable reality!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

202671.description:
"An incredibly dangerous story of sexual lust between teachers and students!" My name is Ukishima... I'm a passionate, peace-loving teacher who was transferred to a girls' high school after a terrible experience at a boys' high school! By the way, aren't kids these days dangerous? Are they okay...? No, no, no, they're all perfectly polite and smart, the best, but there are some students who are dangerous in a slightly different sense... There are girls who keep sneaking into narrow gaps like corners of the road, corners of the garden, cleaning lockers, and the teacher's podium. ...And they're in heat!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ランチユーインザスカイ

202674.description:
I’m way too unlucky, seriously. While others get to be time travellers, I can only watch as historical figures traverse to the present While others enjoy flirting with girls, I’m the one being played. My name is Xiao Qiang, but I go by Qiang. One day, I encountered an old man named Liu Laoliu, who claimed to be a deity, and somehow ended up making a deal with him. I run “The Nth Pawnshop,” where I now receive customers like Jing Ke, Li Bai, Xiang Yu, and Qin Hui. As the tale unfolds…

This story is filled with a sense of humor, cultivation, time traversing, slice of life, romance, you name it. That’s the Greatest Chaos in History for you.
synonyms: The Most Chaotic Ones in History
俺が転生するんじゃないのかよ!?

202675.description:
"Yuki (29), a married woman, enters into a sexual relationship with a man who is stalking her. Will she be able to escape the traps this cunning man sets for her?!"

Yuki Orikawa (29) is a full-time housewife who is secretly considering divorcing her abusive husband, Kenji (35). One day, her friend Motoko forcefully recommends a dating app to her, forcing her to sign up. Yuki ignores messages from the man who wants to meet her, but at a painter's exhibition, a younger man named Ogami (25), who had been messaging her, suddenly appears in front of her... The season of hell begins now!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ストーカーに抱かれて
住所不定キャンパーはダンジョンでのんびりと暮らしたい
title.romaji: Juushofutei Camper wa Dungeon de Nonbiri to Kurashitai: KIken na Shinsou Monster mo Ore ni Totte wa Shokuzai desu

202677.description:
Ning Bei suffers a family tragedy when he is a little boy. To survive, he flees to the North alone. For thirteen years, he has honed his skills and become an invincible war god, protecting his country with a saber. One day, Ning Bei returns to Loong City, a place of love and hatred. He then embarks on a path of revenge.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Strongest God of War in the City
The City's Strongest God of War
最強の王たる強者の帰還リベンジ

title.native: 住所不定キャンパーはダンジョンでのんびりと暮らしたい
title.romaji: Juushofutei Camper wa Dungeon de Nonbiri to Kurashitai: KIken na Shinsou Monster mo Ore ni Totte wa Shokuzai desu

202680.description:
Sister Lily is a kind-hearted woman who is in charge of a small village church.

One day, a young boy from the village, Chris, witnesses the sister's secret affair...

The scene burned into his mind and left him with a throbbing ache in his lower body...

However, the sister knows that he has been peeping... and invites him into the confessional!

title.native: シスターと性なる懺悔

202682.description:
Cute, sexy, mature, and the golden retriever type! Today, I'm being led by the nose by a mysterious boy whose charm is totally unfair. Meiko works part-time at a vocational school once a week. She's still getting used to teaching, but there's one thing that gets her through the day... her serious student, Yukari. He's Meiko's angel. Just seeing his cute face calms her heart. But outside of school... Yukari has a hidden side?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: ゆかりくんはギャップがずるい

202683.description:
Kikuka is a server at Hananoya, a high-class restaurant frequented by well-to-do politicians and entrepreneurs. She's also the daughter of the establishment's current owner and his late mistress. Her mother was kind and gentle, but suffered from illness, and eventually passed on to the next world. Since then, Kikuka has been working hard at Hananoya while enduring constant mistreatment from her mother- and sister-in-law. She never argues back, keeping her promise to her mother: always smile and never resent those around her.
