But when her sister-in-law grows tired of putting up with her, she's abandoned in the mountains one night. However, before despair takes ahold of her, Kikuka stumbles upon the rumored pavilion, Hell's Gateway. There, she meets Homura, a man with glistening, vermillion hair and otherworldly beauty... And for reasons she cannot understand, he treats her with a warm kindness that she's never known...

(Source: Manga Plaza, translated)

title.english: Bride to the Lord of the Underworld

202684.description:
After marrying the person she met in the office, it's been 5 years... and he never comes home. Yuka's been juggling housework and her full-time job. She's treated at a housewife by her husband and pressured for children by her mother-in-law (typical). Everyone's got to be like this, right? It just means that more needs to be done... or at least that's what Yuka's thought. One day, after some harsh words from her husband, Yuka darts out to try and find some peace. But suddenly the headlights are coming at her when-... As she found herself dying in a hospital bed, one thing burned into her retinas... her husband embracing Riko, her childhood friend. They can never be forgiven. They need to pay. As Yuka swears this onto herself while her life begins to fade, she suddenly finds herself at the moment she was proposed to... five years ago. Now it's time to devise a plan for revenge.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Revenge Marriage: I Went Back in Time to Get Revenge on My Cheating Husband
title.native: リベンジ婚～時を戻して不倫夫に復讐します～
title.romaji: Revenge Kon: Ji Omodoshite Furin Otto ni Fukushuu Shimasu

202685.description:
"I'll treasure you like no other, my bride."

The Hinowa Empire is protected by the dragon god. Since ancient times, the Shiryu Family has served as the empire's protectors, offering a "bride" to appease the dragon god every one hundred years. Although she is called the dragon god's bride, she is, in truth, an offering; a sacrifice. Chiyo, taken in by the Shiryu Family to fulfill this role, endures constant ab*se from her family, clinging to the hope of escaping through the sweet release of being devoured by the dragon god. But when the dragon god finally appears, he doesn't devour her. Instead, he embraces her and vows to cherish her.

Follow Chiyo's journey as she transforms from a sacrificial offering to the beloved wife of the dragon god in this sweet romantic fantasy.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: The Dragon's Betrothed: Until the Offering Finds Happiness
title.native: 龍の花贄～生贄の私が幸せになるまで～
title.romaji: Ryuu no Hana Nie: Ikenie no Watashi ga Shiawase ni Naru made

title.native: その婚約者、いらないのでしたらわたしがもらいます！　ずたぼろ令息が天下無双の旦那様になりました
title.romaji: Sono Konyakusha, Iranai no Deshitara Watashi ga Moraimasu!: Zutaboro Reisoku ga Tenka Musou no Danna-sama ni Narimashita

202687.description:
My child has already left the small adventures of kindergarten and crossed the threshold of elementary school! I write this as a picture diary of elementary school life, but read it as a picture diary of parenting! Crazy, wild, squeaky, and rambunctious! Now, a truly new war begins for our three families.

(Source: Naver, translated)

202688.description:
Late-stage cancer. 3 months to live. How will retired detective In-Su Kang make the most of it? When seeing the death-row convicts he arrested all escape from a prison van, he finds his answer: finish the job. It’s something he could never do as an officer, but the law didn’t do its duty. The problem is all the escaped convicts are moving far too swiftly for it to be a coincidence. They have someone behind the scenes giving them a helping. And this someone also has In-Su’s daughter in their sights. This series contains strong themes and disturbing imagery.

(Source: WEBTOON)

202689.description:
Mocked for having top-tier talent but the worst looks, Yeppeum Kim falls into despair, betrayed by those she trusted and robbed of everything she worked for. But then, a seeming miracle transforms her into someone breathtakingly beautiful. In the following days, she watches a dreamlike new life unfold before her eyes. Fame, attention, and endless praise are intoxicating, but something feels off. Soon, she realizes this beauty isn’t a blessing. It is a curse.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: สวยต้องสาป

202690.description:
Seo Si-A, a genius actress renowned for her method acting, is about to premiere a new drama. A string of suspicious murders occur around her. Her new bodyguard, Bong-Su, discovers a connection between her and the murders, and he delves deeper into the case to uncover the mystery...

What secret lies hidden within her flawless acting skills?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

202691.description:
Her lovely and scary secret... Even if you see the truth behind her in the shadows, can you still cheer her on?

(Source: Naver, translated)

202692.description:
A criminal has joined a mystery horror channel created by friends. The channel is a huge hit... but when the water rises, stop rowing?! A breathtaking live thriller!

(Source: Naver, translated)

202693.description:
Become a detective at the crime scene and uncover the truth! The culprit is definitely inside!

(Source: Naver, translated)

1-5. Daehaksaeng Sageon Ilji (대학생 사건 일지) [Mangsoon]
6-10. Geomeunnabi Sageon Ilji (검은나비 사건 일지) [Yong-Ki Kim]
11-15. Bakoejang Sageon Ilji (박회장 사건 일지) [ Story: Inggyu, Art: Drawing Changgo]
16-20. Baeu Sageon Ilji (배우 사건 일지) [Dalgonyak]

202694.description:
One day, zombies spread to every corner of the world. The living are unsure whether to be lucky or unlucky, whether to become accomplices to the zombies, or to strive for survival but ultimately become food. What should they do?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

202696.description:
He wants to find his own way of chivalry! Theor, a young boy born into a family of assassins, was branded "incompetent" by his uncle, the head of the family, and banished. Because Theor's stealth skills were so high, no one in his family realized that he was also a powerful assassin magic user...! Taking his banishment as an opportunity, Theor decides to become the knight he has always dreamed of becoming, and joins the Sixth Knights of the Kingdom of Oikot. While carrying out missions using assassin magic alongside his senior knight Lina and other unique companions, the former strongest assassin awakens to his mission to protect the people! From an assassin who takes lives to a knight who protects the people - the story of this former assassin and unrivaled knight begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Knight Life of the Former Strongest Assassin.

title.native: 元・最強暗殺者の騎士生活
title.romaji: Moto Saikyou Ansatsusha no Kishi Seikatsu

202697.description: Mitsuru Sugaya's debut work, based on the 1971 Kamen Rider tokusatsu series.

title.native: テレビマガジン版 仮面ライダー

202698.description:
Having lived as a beta his whole life, Seo Yee-Hyeon never imagined his path would cross with a golden Alpha like Liu Weikun - someone so far above his world it, felt like fate would never even bother. But one day, Weikun catches an impossible scent adrift in the air: the sweet, addictive pheromone of an Omega…coming from Hyun. Stranger still, it’s a scent only he can perceive. As desire and instinct blur into obsession, Yee-Hyeon finds himself caught between disbelief and temptation, his world crystalizing into one he never thought possible…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Diamond Dust：ダイヤモンド・ダスト

202699.description:
To pay off his parents’ debt, Hyeon-Do is sold into an arrangement as the fake fiancé of a powerful conglomerate heir. His supposed partner, Yi-Sak, is an infamous alpha known for his volatility, a man others call mad. Yet when Yi-Sak realizes his uncontrollable pheromones only calm in Hyeon-Do’s presence, their dangerous charade begins to blur into something else. As secrets pile up and emotions tangle, Hyeon-Do must keep his true identity hidden long enough to survive the wedding or risk being devoured by the man he’s bound to marry.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: クォ・ヴァディス・ドミネ〜主よどこへ行かれるのですか？〜

202700.description:
Famous actor Kim Seong-Jae follows a suspicious man claiming to be his temporary manager, only to arrive at a remote village he escaped from at fifteen - the compound of a cult that once consumed his life. As Seong-Jae attempts to flee the place haunted by his past, a fatal mistake leaves the cult leader dead by his hand. Moments later, the followers arrive, forcing Seongjae into an irreversible decision to survive. Trapped on a stage where faith, violence, and performance blur, Seong-Jae realizes the man who led him here has been directing everything from the shadows. Once the cameras begin to roll, there is no cutting the scene short.

(Source: Lezhin US)

202701.description:
Jeong Ah-Hun, a bright and cute part-timer with a slight quirk, is a bit of a jerk. Seeing Ah-Hun being kind and lovable to everyone, Im Seung-Hu diligently builds a wall around him, saying that he dislikes him exactly. Ah-Hun begins to show his affection for Seung-Hu at every opportunity, but Seung-Hu accidentally reads his diary and misunderstands Ah-Hun. He realizes that Ah-Hun only approached him to sleep with him. Feeling betrayed, Seung-Hu, in a fit of rage, proposes a one-night stand to Ah-Hun...

"Didn't you want to sleep with me? You don't like it?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: ปิ๊งรักพาร์ตไทม์ที่หมายหัว

202702.description:
My first love, whom I met again after a long time.

"Seong-min, what are you going to do when you grow up?"

"I want to marry you..."

Seong-Min, who was excited at the thought of meeting his first love, Tae-Su, ended up reuniting with him in a slightly awkward situation. Tae-Su has changed since their childhood, but Seong-Min still finds him adorable...

Will he be able to make Tae-Su, who has become a loner in his room, happy?

(Source: Bomtoon, translate)
synonyms: เพื่อนซี้ของผมมันไม่เอาถ่าน

202703.description:
Mu-Jin Jeong, a member of the Beomsohoe, goes out drinking with her boss and ends up sleeping with a stranger. The man turns out to be Choi Seok-Yeon, a member of the Cheon-I faction. From then on, wherever Jin-Jeong goes and wherever he goes, he encounters Seok-Yeon...?! They say a bowl of warm soup will make you forget!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.native: 先生とオレの訳あり同棲アパートメント
title.romaji: Sensei to Ore no Wakeari Dousei Apartment

202705.description:
Pregnant and stuck at home with her emotionally abusive husband and self-serving in-laws, Sekka tried to grin and bear it by holding onto the hope that he would change once the baby came. Then she finds out he's been cheating...and while she's still reeling from that news, he deliberately sets her beloved pet cockatiel loose, which finally pushes her past the breaking point. Unable to stand by and watch her suffer anymore, her twin sister Rikka makes an offer: "I'll take your place and get revenge on your husband!"

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Goodbye Forever, You Scumbag! Changing Places with My Twin Sister to Get Sweet Revenge
title.native: さよなら、モラシタ夫。～サレ妻双子の入れ替わり復讐～
title.romaji: Sayonara, Morashita Otto.: Saretsuma Futago no Irekawari Fukushuu

title.native: 鳴上マイコのはんぶん農家

202707.description:
"Ah...jeez! I want to have sex...!"

Aya is a 33-year-old office worker who's dealing with sexual frustration. She wants to feel the touch and love of a man but hasn't had a boyfriend in 8 years. And societally speaking, if women show their desire, they are looked down upon. One day, Aya's flirty supervisor Dojima invites her out for drinks. Dojima is divorced and down to have a one-night stand instead of a partner. Hearing this, Aya makes up her own rules to not get carried away or have any regrets for having a one-night stand and sets out to make her one-stand a reality.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: マイ・ワンナイト・ルール

202708.description:
"If you want a place to belong, I'll make one for you. Let's get along, dear wife."

The newly wedded gentleman who is air to a grand corporate conglomerate is said to have had a terrible cursed placed upon him... Luna Shimizu has been working as a stylist and dealing with an endless amount of bullying from her boss. One night, while looking in the mirror, the face of a woman in a Kimono named Chizuko that looks just like hers appears and sucks her into the mirror. Suddenly, Luna now finds herself in the past?! If she wants to get back home, she will have to go along with what this mysterious organization wants of her: to pose as Chizuko and marry Keiichiro Kuroda, heir to the Kuroda Conglomerate!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: 黒田家の身代わり花嫁

202709.description:
Lisary falls in love with Marquis Orion's only son, Hugo, while working as a servant in the Orion manor. Many protest the idea of a nobleman marrying a servant, but through the power of their love, Lisary and Hugo convince the marquis to allow their marriage on the condition that she go away to finishing school to learn how to be a proper aristocratic bride. Though both their hearts ache to be separated, she departs for the school... Six months later, she returns from her studies and rushes straight to Hugo's side. However, her excitement at finally seeing him again is cut short when he looks at her and blearily asks, "Who... are you...?"

Thus begins a fantasy romance about this former count's daughter, raised as a commoner, and her second chance at love with the amnesiac nobleman her heart desires!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Trials and Tribulations of the Lady Maidservant: A Second Chance at Love with Her Amnesiac Fiance
title.native: 使用人令嬢の受難 ～記憶喪失の婚約者と二度目の恋～
title.romaji: Shiyounin Reijou no Junan: Kioku Soushitsu no Konyakusha to Nidome no Koi

title.native: 王子ちゃんに負けたくない！

202713.description:
When middle school teacher Rika's lack of self-care catches up to her, she quits her job to recover her health and ends up taking a part-time gig at the local Chinese restaurant: no overtime, no take-home work, and two delicious employee meals a day. The owner Momose and his lack of brain-to-mouth filter prove to be a handful, but his amazing cooking shoots Rika's quality of life straight through the roof! This exhausted overachiever is realizing that being a "proper adult" is harder than it seemed... and her journey of healing might just come with a side of romance!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Burned-Out Rika Can't Take Care of Herself
title.native: 限界女子リカちゃんはご自愛できない
title.romaji: Genkai Joshi Rika-chan wa Gojiai Dekinai

202714.description:
A coworker who keeps chasing after teen idols despite her age; a useless boss; and a completely unsociable new hire. Ann, a fortyish woman who looks down on those around her and blames everything on others, dreams only of marriage with the boyfriend who won't sleep with her. But then one day, when she learns that one of the colleagues she looked down on is getting married, she reveals her hidden nasty side right in front of the newbie. From that day on, she is visited by one misfortune after another....

(Source: Manga Plaza)

202715.description:
"Mrs. Monou, it's unfortunate, but you're infertile."

After her pre-marital check-up, Sui's fiance breaks up with her when she tells him the news. Despite working together, she tries to move on with her life, but rumors soon begin to spread about her infertility. To make matters worse, her ex-fiance has already started flirting with other women in the company. Fed up, Sui decides to quit and start fresh somewhere new. With her heart battered and bruised, she has a chance encounter with a handsome younger man and ends up spending the night with him...?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: できても、できなくても

202716.description:
Neptune here! I got an invitation from Veil so I've come to Resort Island! But why is it so cold? That's no problem, really. After all, this is the beta test of a zombie game on a virtual game console so advanced, you can turn the whole island into eternal summer with just one button! But during the game, I got a report that zombies are spawning all over the world!

(Source: MF Bunko J, translated)

title.native: 超次元ゲイム ネプテューヌ おぶ・ざ・ないとめあ？
title.romaji: Choujigen Game Neptune of the Nightmare?

202718.description:
Yohan died broke in modern Korea and woke up broke again -- now the lowest-ranked son of a noble house in a savage medieval world. Armed with superhuman strength and modern know-how, he chases the money that buys his way out -- but every scheme turns into heroism. Can a man who only wants gold survive an imperial enforcer razing noble houses across the realm, or become another body in the bloodshed?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: How to Survive as a Wandering Knight

202719.description:
When infamous mercenary Leopold Gregory gets falsely accused of murdering Hareid Bakadi, the last thing he expects is to wind up working for the dead man’s wife, Hena! He uses a fake name to further avoid detection and even winds up getting close to Hena’s son, Daniel. Leo intends to figure out who framed him, but along the way, he finds himself drawn to the mysterious lady of the house who still has no idea he’s a suspect in her husband’s murder. Will his search for the truth end up ruining what he’s built with Hena and Daniel?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: สวนแห่งความลับ

202720.description:
Shy and lonely college junior Do-Rae Lee never expects to see her high school crush again until she runs into Hae-Won Cha, who’s just as handsome as she remembers. When Hae-Won suddenly confesses his feelings, Do-Rae is completely thrown off. Because one, he already has a popular girlfriend who happens to be Do-rae’s friend, and two, he believes he’s still eighteen years old. After a car accident erased five years of his memories, Hae-Won is stuck in the past and determined to make Do-Rae his girlfriend. Now the two are confronted by the question: Can first love survive reality?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: รักเก่าเขย่าใจ
El primer amor de un rebelde

title.native: ぼくの推しがメロすぎる！
title.romaji: Boku no Oshi ga Mero Sugiru!

title.native: 事実は小説より怪なり

202723.description:
Art club president Nito Gin has been searching for the artist of the painting that gave him such a crushing sense of defeat. The artist's true identity is Tenkinsai, a girl who attends the same high school!

A semi-finalist in the 3rd JUMP Start Dash Manga Awards and winner of the U18 Award! An explosive burst of energetic talent! A new and exciting art story!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

202724.description:
Seo Yue, who was forced to marry the barbarian King of Northern Wei instead of the legitimate princess, is now in the position of a false princess. The King of Northern Wei's reaction to Seo Yue is somewhat strange.

"This ugly body. The mere smell of rain makes me horny..."

"Come to the bridal chamber quickly, my beautiful princess."

How can they be having a wedding while the sun is still high in the sky?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

202725.description:
As part of his pre-graduation internship, culinary student Lee Eun-Seong finds himself working at a sushi restaurant, where one familiar face shows up day after day. But when Eun-Seong accidentally stumbles upon his regular’s secret, things take an unexpected turn. Jeon Ho-Yeong is determined to keep it hidden, while Eun-Seong can’t decide whether he’s annoyed… or oddly drawn in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

202726.description:
She finds her boyfriend cheating, and at the same spot her ex shows up out of nowhere!! Her harmonious lovey-dovey life with a popular photographer is suddenly overturned, and she's knocked down to her lowest rock bottom ever - what will become of Mahiru now!? Truth and lies become entangled as this complicated four-way affair begins...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: I Caught My Boyfriend Cheating, and My Ex Was There Too?!
title.native: 彼氏の浮気現場で元カレと!?
title.romaji: Kareshi no Uwaki Genba de Motokare to!?

202727.description:
42-year-old Kyoko Otsuka has spent the last 13 years living life as "mom" for her rebellious daughter and soft-spoken husband. Kyoko thought her average and hectic life would continue this way until one day she is told that she only has a year left to live! Shocked by this news, Kyoko decides she wants to spend the remainder of her life "living for herself." She declares to her family, who have been spoiled and taken her for granted, that she is done being their "mom" and is going to take back her life as "Kyoko"!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: I'm Done With This Mom Gig: My Last Year to Live
title.native: ママ、やめます～余命一年の決断～
title.romaji: Mama, Yamemasu: Yomei Ichi-nen no Ketsudan

202728.description:
Kanane Shinohara's been in plenty of relationships, but they've never panned out. Now, she's in her mid-30s and has become incapable of falling in love. As she drinks her sorrows away, she convinces herself that the reason she can't find a decent man lies within her. However, before Kanane has a chance to fully accept her "harsh reality," a handsome man named Shirosaki appears before her. Has she finally met her Prince Charming? Or is there something more to him?

Deep down, all Kanane wants is her own Cinderella story, but her experience tells her she's too old for fairytale romances. Using age as an excuse, she attempts to make a break for it and leave Shirosaki behind. However, he might not be so willing to let her escape his reach.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

202729.description:
"Don't you think it's time we get divorced?"

Liliange was married to the eldest son of a duke, Alekseid, at the tender age of eight for the good of her country. Even though she was only young, she fell hard for her much older husband anyway. However, on her 16th birthday, she overhears him telling a friend, "I bet that even when she's of age, I won't be able to see her as a member of the opposite sex at all." Now, with her love for Alekseid still in her heart, Liliange decides to bring the whole marriage to an end by asking him to divorce her...! A story of how earnest feelings can sometimes be overlooked. Liliange and Alekseid's love-filled marriage story begins now!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Darling Husband, Don't You Think It's Time We Get Divorced?
title.native: 旦那サマ、そろそろ離婚しませんか？

202730.description:
1. My Etoile (私のエトワール)
2. 3 Byoukan (３秒間)
3. Tsuki e Iku Tsumori Janakatta (月へ行くつもりじゃなかった)
4. Yurigokko (ゆりごっこ)
5. #Mika-chan and Mona-chan (＃ミカちゃんともなちゃん)
6. Baka Mitai na Love you (バカみたいなLoveYou)
7. Itsumo Tsuki wa Kirei (いつも月はきれい)
8. fuzzy arcadia
9. Towa to Setsuna no Cafe au Lait (永遠と刹那のカフェオレ)
10. Ai no Sainou (愛の才能)
11. Watashi no Etoile Gojitsudan (私のエトワール 後日譚)
synonyms: Towa to Setsuna no Cafe au Lait

title.native: 私の中でいちばんに光る、貴方
title.romaji: Watashi no Naka de Ichiban ni Hikaru, Anata

202732.description:
While job hunting, Shinobu is transported to another world and gets a job at the Royal Academy. As a carefree office worker, she should be able to enjoy a peaceful life in another world, but every day she finds herself in a battle with the cold-hearted and unsociable magic professor, Emmerich! What's more, she's rumored to be a "goddess" with holy magical powers... Is this how it should be?! Stand up to your sadistic boss!? A peaceful office worker vs. a scheming professor in an alternate world work life!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 異世界転移したけど、王立学院で事務員やってます　平穏な日常、時々腹黒教授
title.romaji: Isekai Teni Shitaikedo, Ouritsu Gakuin de Jimuin Yattemasu: Heion na Nichijou, Tokidoki Haraguro Kyouju

202733.description:
Odette, the daughter of a count, is arranged to marry Alphonse, the royal guard she has long admired. But this marriage isn't born of love; it's a royal decree. On a rainy day, Alphonse, a master of both swordsmanship and magic, saved Odette from a bandit attack. Struck by his gallant presence, Odette fell deeply for him. However, she soon heard a troubling rumor that Alphonse and the princess were secretly involved as lovers. Despite her heartbreak, Odette kept her feelings hidden. Years later, a marriage proposal arrived, and her intended husband was none other than Alphonse. Knowing the marriage was a cover to hide his forbidden relationship with the princess, Odette still accepted, unable to deny her longing for him. And so began a bittersweet tale of unfulfilled love, destined to be marked by heartache and quiet yearning.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 私と結婚した事、後悔していませんか？
title.romaji: Watashi to Kekkon Shita Koto, Koukai Shiteimasen ka?

202735.description:
Caleb wakes up reborn... with a Tycoon System. Every second that passes, his wealth increases-automatically. As the system levels up, his fortune explodes at an insane rate. Status, power, influence-everything starts coming to him. After a lifetime of regret and restraint, he makes one decision-this time, he plays by no rules. If fate is handing him everything...he's going to enjoy every second of it.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I’m Super Rich, So Being A Trash Man Is Reasonable, Right?
I'm a Rich Tycoon, So Being a Scumbag Makes Perfect Sense!

title.english: My Billionaire Life: Just a Playboy
title.native: 我一个神豪，当渣男很合理吧
title.romaji: Wo Yige Shen Hao, Dang Zha Nan Hen Heli Ba

202736.description:
Seol Ha-Eun has always been puzzled by her long-time childhood friend, Yun Do-Jun. Despite his quiet, introverted nature and somewhat gloomy aura, Do-Jun is far from unattractive, he possesses a solid physique and a face that should easily draw romantic interest. Yet, strangely, he has remained perpetually single. Driven by a mix of genuine concern and relentless curiosity, Ha-Eun finally corners him for the truth, only to be met with a shocking confession. It turns out Do-Jun suffers from a debilitating secret: whenever he attempts to get intimate with a woman, he simply cannot perform.

Stunned to discover her best friend is a "broken man," Ha-Eun impulsively resolves to take matters into her own hands to "cure" his dysfunction. However, what began as a clinical, hands-on lesson soon spirals into an unpredictable, heated entanglement. As the boundaries of their friendship blur, Ha-Eun finds herself whispering a daring proposal: "Yun Do-Jun... would it be okay if I’m the one to take your virginity?"

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: How about we stay just friends?

202737.description:
Naito, a delinquent high school student, takes pleasure in harassing classmates and teachers he dislikes. But when he crosses Yabuchi?his mild-mannered homeroom teacher?he's met with unexpected and intense retaliation. Forced into special tutoring sessions, Naito soon finds both his mind and body slowly being reshaped under Yabuchi's unsettling care.

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: 学生指导～为嚣张不良学生提供雌堕再教育～
Student Counselling ~Feminizing Rehabilitation For No-Good Delinquents~

title.english: Student Tutoring ~Feminizing Correctional Program for Bad Boys~
title.native: 生徒指導~生意気不良のためのメス堕ち更生教育~
title.romaji: Seitoshidou: Namaiki Furyou no Tame no Mesu Ochi Kousei Kyouiku

202738.description:
"I'll never be a main character." Our hero has lost all hope in life when a mysterious woman suddenly appears before him, pleading with him to "save the world." What ends up in his hand? A game controller! Can he actually save the world?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: Part-Time Hero: Time Machine Memory Hack
title.native: フリータータイムマシンメモリーハック

synonyms: Toshikuni The Karaoke Staff in Kabukicho

title.native: 歌舞伎町カラオケ店員としくにさん

202740.description:
Rebecca is an animal-loving, slightly eccentric count's daughter. One day, she decides to hide a handsome knight who has fled onto the terrace at a party. To her surprise, he turns out to be the hero Alan. Alan, who has a silver wolf as his servitor and doesn't fit in with high society, falls in love with Rebecca as he talks with her and begins to aggressively pursue her! A sweet and gentle love story between a clumsy knight commander and a gentle lady!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: おっとり令嬢は騎士団長の溺愛包囲網に気がつかない　もふもふしてたら求婚ですか？
title.romaji: Ottori Reijou wa Kishi Danchou no Dekiai Houimou ni Kigatsukanai: Mofumofu Shitetara Kyuukon Desu ka?

title.native: どうも、前世で殺戮の魔道具を作っていた子爵令嬢です。
title.romaji: Doumo, Zense de Satsuriku no Madougu wo Tsukutteita Shishaku Reijou desu.

202742.description: A boy falls in love with a girl, but she does not love him back... A story evolving around theme of "youzhi (naivety)" begins.

202744.description:
After the system awakens, one beautiful woman after another awaits their fated binding for dual cultivation. Loli? Mature woman? Jiang Mao loves to make female demons submit and command maids with a whip. All enchantresses heed my command!

(Source: Webnovel)

202745.description:
Transmigrating into the Tang Dynasty as Prince Li Zhi, the future Emperor Gaozong of Tang. I plan to expand the Tang territory all the way to Europe. What? This is the world of Journey to the West? To obtain scriptures? Forget about that; I’ll expand the Tang territory to Mount Ling. Either submit or face annihilation. Let me show you how the Tang becomes a giant Tang! Tang Seng: I spent over a decade on my pilgrimage and still haven’t left the borders of the Tang Dynasty.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: This Li Zhi Is Too Rational

title.native: アンラッキーキューピッド

202747.description:
Betrayed and stripped of his powers, Chu Jianqiu was left broken. But fate had a different plan. He stumbles upon a legendary cultivation technique, the Divine Chaos Codex! Now, he's on a path to reclaim his glory and ascend to the top of the world!

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: 赤と白とロイヤルブルー
title.romaji: Aka to Shiro to Royal Blue

202749.description:
"I will not fogive anyone who lays a hand on my bride."

The Tenryu family has had women with powers of healing for generations, but when someone without those powers is born, they are treated as an outcast and treated harshly. Mitsuki was born into a power part of the Tenryu family but was quickly made an outcast as her lack of healing powers became apparent. At the age of seven, her mother suddenly passed away forcing her to move in with her aunt. Day by day, she has been treated terribly by her relatives due to her status as an outcast. However, all of that changed when the new head of the family came of age.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

202750.description:
A rose desperate to hide her thorns finally blooms in this office romance.

Suzu Takamine, the office's unattainable beauty who turns down anyone that asks her to date, is carrying a painful secret. Whenever she tries to be intimate with a man, they faint for some reason. Suzu wants to get married someday, but with her condition ruining her dating life, she's losing hope for any happily ever after. When the office playboy, Kinase, learns of her unbelievable secret, Suzu is shocked to hear him offer his "expert assistance" in resolving her problem. Now she has to decide: Will she give him a try?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: A Flaw in the Flawless Flower
title.native: 高嶺の花には難がある
title.romaji: Takane no Hana ni wa Nan ga Aru

202751.description: The role of hunter and prey now have changed, and Eli became the plaything of the other party! This pervert not only tied up and teased him, but also seemed to know a terrible secret about himself. Is there an ulterior motive or a hidden secret? As they fall in love and kill each other, a greater truth emerges... "Defile you, or save me."

202752.description:
The kingdom of Feng had been at odds with the neighboring state of Kun for many years until they finally signed a peace agreement. However, when the king of Feng senses suspicious activity within his kingdom that might be related to Kun, he orders his trusted court official, Lin Yu, to uncover the conspiracy. Lin Yu assigns the task to his most skilled spy, the cunning Wu Yao. When Lin Yu asks Wu Yao what he wants in return for this dangerous mission, Wu Yao unexpectedly replies, "I want to sleep with you." In Wu Yao's yearning expression, Lin Yu glimpses the face of his long-lost step-brother—the one he's searched for all these years. What fate awaits these two, torn apart by the past and separated by their status and station?

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 翡翠の夢見る宵月の烏
title.romaji: Hisui no Yumemiru Yoizuki no Karasu

202753.description:
The manga centers on An, a child who longs to have a pet cat or dog, but is sure her family would not allow it. When she is told by a monk that her wish would be granted if she prayed to a temple, she immediately finds a stray cat abandoned in a box.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: つきたて！ オモちゃん

202755.description:
1. Hotaru no Naku Shima (螢の泣く島)
2. Seijo ni Shiroi Chi (聖女に白い血)
3. Kawa no Kage 159 (皮の影159)
4. Saraba Roman no Toki yo (さらばロマンの時よ)
5. Geshuku-sou Ijin-den (下宿荘偉人伝)
6-7. Sei Sarumata-den (聖サルマタ伝)
8. Ugetsu Monogatari (雨月物語)
9. Hihoneshi Mugei (秘本絵師 無芸)
10-11. Sakezan (サケザン)
synonyms: 秘 本絵師 無芸

202759.description:
Due to certain circumstances, our protagonist, Tomohiko Suzuki, secretly develops feelings for Ruka Ayase, the class's top gal. His friends tell him to give up on his crazy love affair between a popular girl and an otaku, but he refuses and takes action...

(Source: Fanza, translated)
synonyms: The story of how an otaku like me ended up dating a top-tier gal

title.native: オタクの僕が一軍ギャルと付き合えるまでの話
title.romaji: Otaku no Boku ga Ichigun Gal to Tsukiaeru Made no Hanashi

202760.description:
"Danmachi" long-awaited official comic anthology,
featuring 13 artists with a variety of stories, full of laughter and tears.
synonyms: 던전에서 만남을 추구하면 안 되는 걸까 공식 앤솔로지 코믹

title.native: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうか 公式アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru no Darou ka: Koushiki Anthology Comic

202761.description:
Even a top-notch secretary can struggle with love.
Work is efficient, but romance is a mess.
Haruko Akizuki works as a temp secretary, helping to support everyone from top corporate officers to ordinary individuals.
Her work is flawless, but she has a weakness for falling for her employers, who each have their quirks…

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

202763.description:
Shen Yan, an unknown actor, joins the cast of "Dark Tide" without receiving any payment because he secretly loves film star Lu Ci. On and off screen, he hides his surging feelings, while Lu Ci sees through his thoughts and gently protects him. Faced with pressure from his company to create hype, Shen Yan stays true to his heart and resolutely breaks off the project, finally receiving a heartfelt confession from Lu Ci. This desperate, unrequited love story ends happily in mutual pursuit, a bittersweet and incredibly captivating tale!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

202764.description:
She had swallowed her pride for love throughout her marriage, only to be met with his divorce papers in the end. Did he really think he could walk away without paying any price? She's dead set on becoming the one woman he'll never forget-if she can't keep him, she'll keep his child-and that's final!

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: Sudden Babies: Mr. Huo, Please Sign
Cute Baby From Heaven: Mr. Huo, Please Sign
どうせ離婚するから、思いのままにします

title.english: Sign for Your Ten Babies, Mister!
title.romaji: Tian Jiang Meng Bao: Huo Ye Qing Qianshou

202765.description:
Gu Jiahui, single for 26 years, discovers she's unexpectedly pregnant on her birthday. The father is not only her longtime crush, but also the company's newly appointed CEO! Faced with this sudden change, should she keep the child? Should she tell him? What does her senior think of their tumultuous relationship? This barrage of questions leaves Gu Jiahui at a loss.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

synonyms: Ikusa Otome-tachi to Kizuku Moto Teihen Murabito no Saikyou Harem: Suumannin no Onna ni Taishi, Otoko wa Ore Hitori
The Survivors of Humanity Are the Valkyries, Except Me.

title.native: 戦乙女たちと築く元・底辺村人の最強ハーレム 　～数万人の女に対し、男は俺一人～
title.romaji: Valkyrie-tachi to Kizuku Moto Teihen Murabito no Saikyou Harem: Suumannin no Onna ni Taishi, Otoko wa Ore Hitori

synonyms: Ikusa Otome-tachi to Kizuku Moto Teihen Murabito no Saikyou Harem: Suumannin no Onna ni Taishi, Otoko wa Ore Hitori
The Survivors of Humanity Are the Valkyries, Except Me.

title.native: 戦乙女たちと築く元・底辺村人の最強ハーレム ～数万人の女に対し、男は俺一人～
title.romaji: Valkyrie-tachi to Kizuku Moto Teihen Murabito no Saikyou Harem: Suumannin no Onna ni Taishi, Otoko wa Ore Hitori

title.native: 日陰の鬼さん澄んで春の陽
title.romaji: Hikage no Oni-san Sunde Haru no Hi

202773.description:
Sara, a history teacher, was devastated after her boyfriend left her for another teacher. She had always chosen the safe path but in the end nothing worked out... So Sara makes a huge change and moves to Rome! Before her departure, her great-grandfather advises her to cure her broken heart with a new romance, to fall in love with a dark-eyed Italian. Sara laughs it off until it becomes reality! Matteo is mesmerizing... his passionate gaze makes her go weak!

(Source: Renta!)

202775.description:
The death land of Cheonmagumyeok (天魔禁域), where the Nine Great Heavenly Demons are imprisoned!

Kwaaang! Lightning strikes from the sky, and the Samramansang Geumsaejin surrounding Cheonmagumyeok is destroyed, causing the Nine Great Heavenly Demons to escape. The terrifying Heavenly Demons and the descendants of the Absolute Five Heavenly Demons are chasing them. The Heavenly Demons, who have reincarnated into unexpected identities, are strangling the world , and the Heavenly Demon Warriors, who were raised solely to fight the Heavenly Demons, appear. A fierce clash between the Nine Great Heavenly Demons and the Heavenly Demon Warriors. The future of the world is born through the clash of the past and the present!!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 月へ行くつもりじゃなかった
週末のあまい クリームソーダ

202784.description:
What’s the first thing Rhys Valdez does after being reborn into the recent past, realizing he has a second chance to correct any past mistakes? He breaks up with his girlfriend, setting up for a romantic saga of star-crossed lovers... until, that is, a mysterious System awakens and reveals that Earth’s impending Spiritual Energy Revival is merely one short year away from triggering the apocalypse. With the knowledge of the past and power of the future, can Rhys ascend the Realms of Cultivation in time to save humanity?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Dumped by My Girlfriend, I Turned to Martial Arts

title.english: Dumped... Then I Became a Martial God
title.native: 被校花分手后，我直接武道通神
title.romaji: Bei Xiaohua Fenshou Hou, Wo Zhijie Wudao Tong Shen

202785.description: Note: Published on Nagase Tooru's PixivFANBOX account.

title.native: 妖狐、ハジメテに溶ける

202786.description:
The legendary Blood Magic Book of the Blood Demon Sect...! The martial arts world is stained with blood over the Blood Magic Book. The Dansimryeon Yeonju dreams of reigning over the martial arts world, and he must be stopped. The one who will dominate the martial arts world in chaos! Who is he? The lustful demon Lee Gun-Ak who must save the martial arts world from the bloody storm that is raging.

“Ugh! My home the other day was Cheonghwaru, yesterday was Samyogak, and today it’s Banwolgwan. All the Giru are my home, so stop telling me to go home with that nonsense.”

Will he be able to stop the bloody storm?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 永遠と刹那のカフェオレ
title.romaji: Towa to Setsuna no Cafe au Lait

202789.description:
When pediatrician Katrina goes back to work after a vacation, she meets newly appointed Dr. Reese for the first time. He's an exceptionally handsome and talented doctor, but he also has a reputation for being cold. When he invites her to dinner, Katrina finds him to be surprisingly kind, and gradually she finds herself falling for him. But she's sworn to never get involved in a workplace romance again. On top of that, when Dr. Reese finds out that Katrina is deaf, he starts to distance himself from her. She knows she can't risk opening her heart to him...

(Source: Renta!)

202790.description:
A hamster that is put on the human world with a secret mission is attacked unexpectedly by a demon. She narrowly escapes death, but little does she know that it is only the beginning of the cohabitation between her and her enemy.

(Source: WebComics)

202792.description:
The only true lineage of the Demonic Cult, Lee Gun-Ak! He mastered the Demonic Cult's sacred art contained in the Demonic Cult's Three Treasures and emerged into the world. For him, the revival of the Demonic Cult is of no concern. His sword holds only another path.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

202793.description:
Lizzie works as a waitress at a tavern to cover the debt her brother has incurred. It's a job she'll never get used to, with the fancy clothes and shoes that don't fit... Then one day, the owner asks her to entertain customers! Lizzie's horrified, but a well-dressed gentleman comes to her rescue. Will is an investor and a member of a well-known local ranching family. She's surprised he's being so nice to her, a total stranger, and even more surprised when he later shows up on her doorstep to offer her a job!

(Source: Renta!)

202794.description:
Elena, an attendant to a nobleman, falls secretly in love with the Earl of Lavenham after he visits the mansion. She's excited by his enchanting kiss and proposal but is hurt when he says they can both have other lovers. With no other choice, Elena runs away. On her way to London, she meets a duke's widow, who finds Elena's story amusing and dresses her up to make her look like a beautiful princess. Elena is surprised by her new appearance and shocked when she runs into the earl, who has come to London to look for her. Will he see through her disguise?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 伯爵が愛した灰かぶり

202795.description:
Darcy's life is continually swept away by his arrogant father. Her mother isn't with her. She divorced her father and left with only Darcy's sister. Betrayed by the only lover she has ever shared love with, she experiences a cruel breakup. She thinks that no one has ever loved her. But when her father dies, everything changes. First is her reconciliation with her sister. Then, her father put his vast inheritance in trust for his former lover Curt, who is also a wealthy rancher. She is still unwilling to forgive him for his betrayal. But somewhere in her heart, Darcy, who is already exhausted in body and soul, is glad to see him again...?

(Source: Renta!)

202796.description:
Sian, a descendant of an infamous rebel, never had the opportunity to learn the manners of a noblewoman, and her brother is constantly critical of her. One day, while taking a break from her suffocating situation, Sian is attacked by a boar in the forest. But she's saved by a one-eyed knight, who shoots the beast with an arrow. He's a scary-looking man with a scar on his face, but Sian is immediately taken by his kindness. She falls for him, but little does she know her love might never be reciprocated...

(Source: Renta!)

202797.description:
The wife he thought was ordinary turns out to be a killer?! One day, Lee Man discovers his wife's affair and, convinced she's plotting to kill him, attempts to kill her first. However, Lee Man witnesses her murder at the hands of a man and becomes the target for killers...

Hired to protect Lee Man, the killer "Movie Gwang" must find her killer to survive and to learn about his "real" wife!

A spectacular revenge action thriller about two newlyweds!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 愛とか恋とかわからない
リボンはほどける、フリルは溶ける
title.romaji: Ribon wa Hodokeru, Frills wa Tokeru

202802.description:
When Han Ina wakes up as game villainess Tulia Frasier, with absolutely trash stats and a garbage personality, a status window tells her she must reach Rank A or die. Determined to succeed, she starts making strategic moves, striving to gain the recognition of her grandfather, the grand duke, and earn the affection of the male leads in order to rank up and ensure her survival. But with members of her own family plotting to take her out, can Tulia clean up her act before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: That Piece Of Trash Was Me

202803.description:
Princess Moriana has worked so hard on being disciplined and well-mannered that she's become known as the Ice Princess. And when her engagement is suddenly called off, she is left speechless. Soon after, however, she receives a proposal from Theo, the king of a neighboring kingdom. Although they've known each other since childhood, they've never been close. Theo, who has become an infamous playboy, needs a suitable woman to be his queen. But when they meet again, Moriana finds her body heating up with just one look from Theo's fiery eyes...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 国王陛下の無垢な花嫁
title.romaji: Kokuou Heika no Muku na Hanayome

202805.description:
When her father dies suddenly, nineteen-year-old Marianne and her family are left in dire straits. Distraught over the idea that she must now marry a haughty aristocrat to help her family, Marianne visits her great-aunt. On the way there, Marianne meets a mysterious gentleman. As soon as he looks at her, she is overwhelmed by a feeling of nostalgia, which confuses her. Marianne leaves without asking his name. What she doesn't know is that he's actually Drew, the Marquis of Marlbeck, and that she will meet him again in an unexpected place...

(Source: Renta!)

202806.description:
Maureen works as professional secretary and is dedicated to her job. The studious ingenue has her eye on everything that comes through the company's offices...including Jake, a man who has the face of a Greek god. But she becomes suspicious of him when one of the company's planes is sabotaged?and then is shocked when he seduces her! But Jake has a secret that will shock Maureen even more!

(Source: Renta!)

202807.description:
Johara, who has been brought up in confinement since childhood as the bride of the next king, is suddenly told that her engagement was called off. She thinks she finally has her own freedom. Johara is excited at the prospect of a new life, but her hopes are cruelly dashed. The rightful king to the throne, Azim, who has been missing for more than twenty years, comes back and decides to marry her. The first time they meet, Azim is so cold and indifferent that Johara turns pale. She wants to be free... For the first time in her life, Johara gives in to her impulses and runs away...?

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Ou to Hana Tsumami no Hanayome

202809.description:
Charity works as a secretary in a hospital with Professor Wyllie-Lyon, a handsome and popular doctor. One day after a hard day at work, she bursts into tears. When the professor sees her crying, he offers her a job as his personal assistant in his clinic. Charity's excited to work so closely with him and soon realizes she's in love with him. But the professor has a beautiful and kind fiancee. What will happen to this unrequited love that is sure to end in heartbreak?

(Source: Renta!)

202810.description:
Amie is a designer and a member of the family that owns a huge jewelry company. At her cousin's wedding party, she meets a man with whom she falls passionately in love and spends the night together. The next day, however, she discovers his true identity. He is Preston, the new CEO of her company. By order of her grandmother, who has absolute power, she and Preston travel together to a new product launch. On the plane, they reach an agreement to keep their relationship strictly business, but it's hard for them to spend day and night together when their body gets hot just by looking into each other's eyes.

(Source: Renta!)

202811.description:
Lina, who lives in a small village in Sicily, dreams of one day leaving the island and striking out on her own. But with her meager savings, it's still just a dream for the seamstress. Then one day she runs into the man she fell in love with a long time ago, Salvatore. The multimillionaire found success in New York and now he's back home for a funeral. The spark of love reignites and the two get carried away by the night. Lina is ready to give up her virginity to Salvatore, even though they barely know each other...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 富豪に拾われたお針子

202812.description:
I want to be like the great swordsman! A child born from the secret art of apostasy, Jang Seol becomes the disciple of Hwangbo Cheolseung, the swordsman who was once the confidant of the leader of the martial arts world, and begins to take his first steps as a martial artist. He has one ability...

This child can read the memories of iron.

Jang Seol grows stronger with each weapon that passes through his hands. He throws himself into the chaotic world of martial arts to find the 'Ten Great Records of the Martial Arts World', known as the legend of martial arts!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

202813.description:
Two years ago, Edie lost her husband , and since then she had been distracting herself by keeping busy with her actress mother and her sister's manager business. One day, she mes Nick, a famous architect, at a party and has a strange feeling for him. However, when she rebuked an approaching Nick and left him, she realized her mother's intentions. I have vowed to never fall in love again, but she's trying to introduce a man to me... Edie approached Nick again. And now he makes me an offer, acting like he understands my feelings?

(Source: Renta!)

202814.description:
"On the day of the wedding, Emma was shocked by her husband Christo's words. This marriage was a marriage of convenience, made by my grandfather, who was worried about me, in exchange for the transfer of real estate! She fled the ceremony and retreated to the island of Corfu. While she was planning her future, Christo appeared, having heard of her whereabouts. When Emma filed for divorce, he told her with icy eyes that he had no intention of divorcing her and that the grandfather had entrusted him with managing the estate. He gave her a condition: "You just have to live with me for one year, as my wife and my niece's mother."

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 花嫁は清らかなベッドに
title.romaji: Hanayome wa Kiyoraka na Bed ni

202815.description:
Andreas, the heir to a wealthy family, is introduced to Isla, his father's new housekeeper. Attracted by her beauty and reserved demeanor, he is swept away by passion and kisses her. A year and a half later, Andreas is surprised to learn that his father is getting married again. But he's dismayed when he finds out Isla is the bride-to-be. He rushes to his father's house to see Isla, but why can't she look Andreas straight in the eye?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: ギリシア大富豪との禁断の夜
title.romaji: Greece Daifuugou to no Kindan no Yoru

202816.description:
After a carriage accident leaves her family in (literal) pieces, Emily Walker is desperate to bring her brothers and twin sister back. With the help of a demon cat named Lev and a dabble in dark magic, she succeeds — but something isn’t right. The Walker siblings are cold, weak, and, well... dead. Now that her siblings are zombies, Emily faces a new challenge: keeping House Walker’s secret safe from the evils that await. How can she hold her family together when it seems destined to fall apart?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Duke's Daughter Is Hiding a Zombie
The Lady Wants to Hide Her Zombie Family

title.english: A Beginner's Guide to Hiding Zombies

202817.description:
After losing her job, a distraught Juliet drives the wrong way and crashes into an expensive car! Even worse, the man who owns the car is Rafael Casillas, the executive of the corporation that fired her. Juliet shakily apologizes to Rafael, but instead of demanding compensation for the damage, he makes her a proposal. To become the next CEO, Rafael needs a bride, and he's willing to pay her five million pounds to play the part. But how can she enter into a loveless marriage with a notorious womanizer?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 花嫁に選ばれた灰かぶり

202818.description:
Beth, a nurse, finds contact information for her niece's father in her late sister's belongings. She is desperate to find him as her niece has leukemia and needs a bone marrow transplant. However, Beth's attempts to contact him are unsuccessful. She is disappointed, and the handsome new doctor at the clinic where she works offers a much-needed distraction. But Beth is astonished when she hears his name. Adam Knight...her niece's father?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 天使の笑みをもう一度
title.romaji: Tenshi no Emi wo Mou Ichido

202819.description:
Ellie, a secretary to the king of Korosol, is known for her earnestness, but not for her looks. Despite that, she's had a dream since she was a little girl of dancing the waltz like Cinderella, if only for one night. One day, that dream is on the verge of coming true after she borrows a dress from Princess Lucia and heads to the ball. But on the way, she is mistaken for the princess and kidnapped! Ellie finds herself trapped in a filthy hut, surprised to see that one of her kidnappers appears to be protecting her...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: シンデレラは眠らない

202820.description:
One day, Him-Chan wakes up to find herself with a supernatural power that destroys everything she touches. Unable to find the cause or find a solution, days pass by, until she destroys everything around her with her uncontrollable power, eventually injuring a guy she's interested in. Feeling a sense of shame, she flees to transfer schools and vows to live quietly in her new home.

"This time, I'm really going to live quietly!"

While watching YouTube, Him-Chan learns about ghosts and shamans. With a determination to win, she visits a nearby shaman known for her strength.

"You can suppress your power by making physical contact, just like now."

She's found the solution he's been waiting for, but what a shocking revelation! To control your power, you need physical contact?! Will Him-Chan, who simply wants to live quietly like air, ever be able to achieve his school life?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: When You Wish Upon a Universe

202821.description:
"Rosa summoned up her courage and asked Lord Ashurst... ""Would you consider marrying me instead of my sister?"" She was troubled by the thought of her sister having to enter into an arranged marriage while already having someone she loved, and even though she knew it was foolish, she couldn't help but act. She had heard that the venerable Earl's family was now overwhelmed with debts and unable to manage their vast estate. My sister is not the only one who has inherited a huge fortune from my late father, if only I could marry him... The Earl refused to marry her and turned Rosa away, but...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: うたかたの恋を伯爵と
title.romaji: Utakata no Koi wo Hakushaku to

202822.description:
"Jade was renting a room at a friend's mansion, and despite being the opposite sex, they were building a friendship, when suddenly his brother Curtis came to visit and questioned their relationship. She told him that she had no romantic feelings for her friend, but he one-sidedly insulted her, saying, ""Is it because of your seduction that your brother ran away from the competition?"" This audacious man wants to make me out to be a bad girl...! Then Curtis said he was going to move in with his brother to see what's going on... How can I live under the same roof with an arrogant millionaire who suspects me?

(Source: Renta!)

202823.description:
Vicky is shocked to learn that her eggs, which she had stored at a clinic, have been used without her permission! Unable to contain the overflowing maternal feelings within her, Vicky contacts the father of her surprise twins, British aristocrat James, but he refuses to allow her contact with them. Determined, she flies to England and pretends to be a lawyer. But when she arrives at his ridiculously large mansion, she's stunned by handsome James and his cold demeanor...

(Source: Renta!)

202824.description:
The sheikh appears before a sobbing maid named Niesha, asking her if she'll stand in for his bride, who has run away. She's always been in love with him, but to act like his bride? Believing it to be a dream that would be broken when the real bride returned, Niesha agrees, only to find herself in the sheikh's bed on their wedding night. There, she hears him say, "I want you to be my queen and bear my child."

(Source: Renta!)

202825.description:
Abby was proposed to by the beautiful Duke Benedict, who was rumored to be the best groom in the world. She accepted in a dreamy mood, but ran away from the wedding when she found out he had a mistress. The whole of England criticized me for leaving the duke at the altar, and I can never hope to marry again. But that's okay. Three months later, Abby was traveling in a carriage when a storm hits, and she sought help at a nearby mansion, where it turned out Benedict, his mistress, and a gossipy socialite were staying...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 完璧な公爵のあやまち

202826.description:
After being betrayed and cast aside by her company, genius producer Jang Hye-Ri will stop at nothing to prove her worth. The perfect chance seems to fall into her lap when she meets Seok-Pil, a handsome stranger who asks her to turn him and his four friends into idols. The catch? All five of them are cursed to become cats and can only become human with enough love and care. Faced with her greatest challenge yet, does Hye-Ri have what it takes to lead these felines to fame?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Butler of Five Men
As of Today, I Have Become the Butler of Five Men

202827.description:
Sixteen-year-old Julienne and her younger sister were despised by the whole town. They'd been born to a prostitute, so Julienne was sure their fates would never change. Then one day she met Cristiano, a wealthy Italian millionaire. Just as Julienne was about to sell herself to survive, Cristiano saved her and gave her a place to live, an education and even a job. She knew it would be foolish to fall in love with him. But ten years after their first encounter, Julienne offers Cristiano her virginity and then immediately disappears from his life...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ジュリエンヌの悩める献身

202828.description:
Emilia is pregnant with her miracle baby. She had a successful in vitro implantation with her late husband's sperm. But one day, she's notified by the clinic that they had mistakenly swapped the sperm. And because of that, she is now pregnant with the millionaire Sam's baby instead of her late husband's. Sam invites an anxious Emilia to his mansion with a rose garden. He takes care of a lonely Emilia with his kindness, but she has to restrain herself. I can't keep relying on Sam. I can't keep burdening him with me and my baby when he's not obligated to do any of this.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ローズガーデンの贈り物

202829.description:
Hester, a servant of Princess Triscari, is astonished by a marriage proposal from Crown Prince Alek. He needs to marry in order to inherit the throne after his father's death. But Hester, who grew up as a neglected orphan, could never be the queen! It's not until Alek promises her a chaste marriage and a large donation to a charity does she eventually agree to the proposal. Soon, though, Hester finds herself attracted to Alek's gentle and carefree charm...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Shy Queen in the Royal Spotlight
title.native: 王子に恋したみにくいあひる

202830.description:
You're a scumbag!, said Kelsey to the Falconer, one of the world's leading real estate magnates. Falconer has Kelsey's father invest all of his money, which he says led to the latter's bankruptcy. Kelsey can never forgive him! Unable to stand by the sight of her father in his weakened state, Kelsey stormed into Falconer's Japanese office. But Falconer calmly brushes off Kelsey's accusations. "I'm sorry, I can't remember your name. I don't remember all the women in my past," he says and silences Kelsey with a kiss on her lips!

(Source: Renta!)

202831.description:
Darcy, who works for a temporary employment agency, is asked to deliver some documents to a hotel. A man named Neve is waiting for her, but he angrily accuses her of blackmailing him! She tries to explain why she's there, but he says he'd rather keep an eye on her until she proves her innocence. So he hires her to work for his large corporation as his secretary! At first Darcy's confused, but soon she's more concerned about Neve's devotion to his work...

(Source: Renta!)

202833.description:
Heroes of Gauri, conquer this world!

The most glorious name in this land, Gauri. He who protected that name. People call him the Steel Emperor! Go Jin-Cheon, the last general of the fallen Gauri (Goguryeo). At the moment of defeat, he and his elite unit, the "Mukapguima Squad," are cast into another world. It is an unfamiliar land inhabited by various races, including elves, orcs, dwarves, and wizards. If he cannot return, he has no choice but to establish a new Gauri. Go Jin-Cheon raises his flag once again to conquer the continent.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

202834.description:
She never thought she would be a queen! Born and raised in the United States, Kelly is suddenly asked by her grandmother's home kingdom to ascend the throne as queen in three weeks. During her studies and lessons in politics to become queen, Devon, the captain of the Kingsguard, was always by Kelly's side as a guard. Tall and handsome, Devon looks like something out of a fairy tale, and the shy Kelly, who is not immune to romance, falls in love with him surprisingly easily. Then, Devon decides to teach Kelly how to dance...?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: わたし今日から推しの推し！
title.romaji: Watashi Kyou kara Oshi no Oshi!

title.native: 友達だった人 絹田みや作品集
title.romaji: Tomodachi Datta Hito: Kinuta Miyu Sakuhinshuu

title.native: TS転生した私が所属するVTuber事務所のライバーを全員堕としにいく話
title.romaji: TS Tensei Shita Watashi ga Shozoku Suru VTuber Jimujo no Liver wo Zenin Ochiru to Shi ni Iku Hanashi

202841.description:
Nicole, a simple cleaning lady, married billionaire Rocco, but despite their modern-day Cinderella story, their marriage did not last long. After Nicole's miscarriage, Rocco's attitude toward her suddenly changed and he began neglecting her for work, so she left. Years later, Rocco tracks her down to work out the terms of their divorce. Rocco demands they make a public appearance as a couple to seal one of his business deals before going through with the divorce. Nicole accepts the terms, not knowing their little act would rekindle an unwanted passion...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 富豪と灰かぶりの花嫁

202842.description:
Jessie's twin sister, Jenna, has her wedding in one week, and she went AWOL! She begs Jessie to take her place before her fiancée, Mac. Jenna is a perfectionist compared to Jessie, a tomboy. They may look the same, but their personalities are total opposites. Can she really pretend to be her? Jessie does her best to play her sister's part, but eventually her heart is taken by Mac's refined and sexy charisma. She knows she shouldn't... How could she fall for the man who is meant to be her brother-in-law? Jessie does her best to suppress the yearnings of her heart, but then she discovers a secret behind her sister and her fiancée's wedding...

(Source: Barnes & Noble)

202843.description:
In 1668, our city earned the title of “The Safest Place in the Country.” I had a lot to do with that. How? Because I was arrested.

(Source: Tencent Comics, translated)

202844.description:
Flo is visiting a foreign country to attend the wedding of her best friend. While there, she runs into a man she once had a one-night stand with, Prince Hazin. But he'd coldly left her after their blissful night together and she swore she'd never be made a fool of like that again. Her heart still pounds when she sees him. Will he be as cold as ever toward her? Or is there something more between them?

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Hakui no Tenshi no Shinobu Koi

202845.description:
Real estate magnate Renzo was shocked when Esther, an American woman he had never met before, told him she was pregnant with his child. According to her, Renzo's ex-wife had asked her to be a surrogate for them but then told Esther that she didn't want the child anymore after she and Renzo divorced. Now Esther's come to Renzo in distress. Renzo is intrigued by the idea of having an heir, so he decides to have Esther act as his pretend fiancee. Gradually, however, he becomes fascinated by her innocence...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ローマの汚れなき花嫁

202847.description:
Maggie Delaney never imagined her yearlong adventure around the world would end with her being kidnapped in a desert country! There, she meets Sheikh Ilyas, who is outraged at her for a crime she never committed. Taken as a hostage, Maggie refuses to eat or drink, provoking the gorgeous prince to give her water mouth-to-mouth! The sweet kiss sparks a fire in the innocent twenty-four-year-old… But this man is royalty in a kingdom unlike anything she’s ever seen…

(Source: Barnes & Noble)

202848.description:
Dani is a new intern doctor in her stepbrother Josh's neonatal intensive care unit. In order to keep things professional, Josh tells Dani to keep their family relationship private. She has always admired him, but ever since an incident on her eighteenth birthday, there's been distance between them. While working together, Josh cannot help but admit Dani is a skillful doctor. She's no longer "Little Dani," the little sister whom he swore to protect...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: A Wife for the Baby Doctor

202849.description:
Emma takes a job as a maid at a high-class party to help pay off her late father's debts. Once upon a time these parties had been her life. Caught up in the spell of nostalgia, Emma makes a disastrous mistake on the job. Her boss tries to take advantage of her vulnerability and forces himself on her.That is, until Jack Westwood, the new earl of Redminster, intervenes. He claims Emma is his wife to scare off her boss. But his claim isn't far from the truth. It's been six years since Emma has seen Jack?her estranged husband?and now he's back in the picture.

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Fugoou Hakushaku to Himitsu no Tsuma

202850.description:
Sabine doesn't know what to do when Gavin, the millionaire she broke up with a few years ago, suddenly appears before her. He's found out that she secretly had his son three years ago and has been raising him on her own. But when Sabine refuses to let her son be taken away, Gavin asks for her hand in marriage instead! Sabine is hesitant, but she finds her resolve slowly breaking down as she witnesses how he cares for her son...

(Source: Renta!)

202852.description:
Deeply traumatized by the murder of her doctor parents, Mandy has been unable to speak ever since. One day, she was being harangued by a drunk man at a party, and novelist Brian Stone comes to her rescue. Mandy, who has no relatives, takes up residence in his mansion, working as a secretary and transcribing his novels. "Why is he being so nice to me? To him, I'm just a child he needs to help. It means nothing… I mustn't misunderstand…"

(Source: Renta!)

202853.description:
Stacy, a fledgling actress shooting a movie in Cornwall, is suddenly asked to leave the film by the director. The reason? She turned down an invitation from the womanizing lead actor. Stacy is frustrated, but then a handsome man named Jake crosses her path. He talks to the director, and in no time at all, she's back on the job. But who in the world is Jake? For the first time in her life, Stacy finds herself intensely attracted to a man, but when she discovers his true identity…

(Source: Renta!)

202854.description:
After a terrifying explosion, Regina is convinced that she has a stalker and begins taking self-defense lessons from instructor Riley Moore. Riley, a former SWAT member, feels a strong attraction to Regina and decides to investigate her case. While she's scared for her life, Regina feels at ease when she's with Riley, and she has no choice but to admit that there's a sizzling connection growing between them. But Regina's past trauma prevents her from having the confidence to take the next step in their relationship...

(Source: Renta!)

202855.description:
After getting into a car accident, Lorna is taken to the hospital where her ex-husband, James, is a doctor. It's been ten years since she had a miscarriage and divorced him. Lorna's heart races when she sees James, who is still as gentle as before. There are still feelings lingering, but Lorna knows she has to move on. But jobless and homeless, she can't help but accept James's offer that she recover at his place. And he's ready to offer her much more than that...

(Source: Renta!)

202856.description:
It happened the night of a masquerade ball when a twenty-three-year-old Molly was given a special kiss. The only thing she could see in the dark was a ring on his finger, Garrett's ring! Convinced that Garrett is the man she was destined to be with, she goes to his brother, Julian, asking him to teach her how to seduce a man. Julian suggests attracting his brother's attention by having Molly pretend to be his girlfriend. Maybe it will work - the notorious playboy should know. But she never thought she'd end up living with Julian, who is the first person that she had ever fallen in love with.

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Ouse no Mama ni Kiss wo

202857.description:
After the company she works for is bought out by a global corporation, Georgina is summoned by the new president. There's been gossip around the office that Georgina is a married man's mistress, and she's worried she'll lose her job over these unfounded accusations. The president of the company, Tullis, is a well-known businessman, and his stern but sexy face makes Georgina's heart flutter. Tullis is suspicious of Georgina, and determined to uncover the truth about the rumors, he appoints her as his secretary to keep a close watch on her...

(Source: Renta!)

202858.description:
Charlotte's poor grandmother was deceived by a con man and died of a broken heart, leaving her beloved dogs behind. When one of them, Flossie, runs off, Charlotte is at a loss. Suddenly, a beautiful stranger shows up, carrying Flossie in his arms. He introduces himself as Bryn and asks to stay the night because of bad weather. Charlotte is nervous about spending the night under the same roof with such a handsome man...and little does she know that he is the nephew of her grandmother's con man!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 孤独な男爵と無垢な乙女
title.romaji: Kodoku na Danshaku to Muku na Otome

202859.description:
"Darcy, a student at a music conservatory in England, received a letter from Julio Valdez, the brother of a friend. Two months earlier, Darcy had been involved in an accident while driving his friend home, and the letter was asking her to go to the mansion to see her friend, who was paralyzed in the accident. When Julio saw Darcy arriving, he was furious and said some shocking words. ""Welcome to Spain, my brother's bride."" This arrogant head of the family didn't even listen to my explanation, he asked me to marry a man I don't even love to make amends!

(Source: Renta!)

202860.description:
Sophie, a chambermaid at a first-class hotel in Rome, meets guest Bastiano Conti, a gorgeous Italian tycoon. The two connect instantly over their love of Sicily and an undeniable attraction to one another. They begin a secret relationship...with everything going well until they are found out. Sophie, disgraced, finds herself out of a job, alone and...pregnant!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 大富豪に恋したメイド

202861.description:
Located in the picturesque mountains of rural Italy is Castello Falcone, an estate that's become revered as the go-to destination for a fairy-tale wedding. Working tirelessly there is wedding planner Maddie. She's hoping to save up for her own big adventure, and to find her soul mate, someday... However, her plans are completely disrupted by Conte Falcone and his shocking request!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Summer Romance With the Italian Tycoon

202862.description:
Suki has always been in love with her best friend’s brother, gorgeous and kindhearted Ramon. After they spend the night of her twenty-fifth birthday together, her heart is shattered when he immediately gets back together with his stunning girlfriend. For the next year, she keeps her distance from Ramon, until a tragic accident brings them back together. Suki has never told him about the baby they almost had, but Ramon has shocking news of his own… He wants Suki to have his child!

(Source: Barnes & Noble)

title.native: 愛を償うウエディング

202863.description:
When a floundering singer and her daughter, Millie, are invited to a luxury yacht from the land of Khalifa, they're immediately suspicious. Millie is approached by the country's gruesome king but gets away thanks to Prince Khalid, also known as the Desert Hawk. He promises them safety, but the next day Millie's mother is found dead! Eight years later, Millie works at a dry cleaner's and has to deliver royal sheets to the infamous yacht. She's eager to find out any information about her mother's death but is surprised when she is greeted by the prince!

(Source: Renta!)

202864.description:
Merida works at a gallery by day as she awaits her big break on Broadway. She is called in one day to show their newest exhibit to Ethan Devereux, youngest son of New York real estate royalty. Seeing his raven hair and piercing eyes, Merida struggles to keep her well-trained composure... When a night of passion with Ethan results in pregnancy, Merida finds herself married to this cold and stoic man, faced with the biggest role in her career yet-the part of a loving wife. With the entire world as her stage, can she succeed in keeping her act and her heart apart?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 花嫁は愛される夢を見る
title.romaji: Hanayome wa Aisareru Yume wo Miru

202865.description:
January works with her two sisters to protect her late parents' farm. One day, while earning extra money working part-time as a singer, she meets a mysterious man. His name is Max, and his confident blue eyes captivate January. She swore she would never open her heart to a man again, but she's touched by Max's tenderness and ends up sharing a sweet kiss with him. But what will happen when she discovers that he's a lawyer for a company that is planning to buy her ranch?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: シンデレラと呼ばないで

202866.description:
Luciana hid her identity as the princess of Arunthia to travel to Zurich, where she fell in love with a beautiful man. Knowing that it was going to be her first and last romance, Luciana gave her virginity to the man of her dreams. However, she realized later that he was actually Thane Guerrero, the infamous prince of enemy country Galancia, and fled from his bed. Five years later, Luciana tries to fulfill her promise with her father to marry a chosen partner. It's the only way to protect her beloved son, whom she became pregnant with during her passionate night of romance with the dark prince!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: To Claim His Heir by Christmas

202867.description:
The abandoned heroine finds doting love! A Cinderella story filled with happiness!

Lane, who lives in a small village far from the royal capital, hears that her fiancé, who left her five years ago, is marrying a saint. Having given up on the idea, she doesn't think much of it. For some reason, he wants to invite his childhood friends to the wedding. Unable to refuse an invitation from the royal castle, Lane ends up attending the wedding of her fiancé and the saint. She heads to the royal capital with a gloomy heart, but meets someone and her destiny changes drastically. Lane, who has been in misfortune, finds true love in this happy-ending romance.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 婚約者が明日、結婚するそうです。
title.romaji: Konyakusha ga Asu, Kekkon Suru Sou Desu.

202868.description:
Bok-Ja Moon is a simple bath maid desperate to provide for her ailing family. And as fate would have it, she comes across the perfect opportunity when she catches the eye of the young emperor desperate to birth an heir to his throne. Now one of his royal concubines, Bok-Ja must compete with the other women after the king's heart to ensure both her and her family's continued survival.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 後宮のポクチャ〜下女から王の側室へ!?〜
ชีวิตรักในวังหลวง

202869.description:
In my last year of my twenties, I was sure I'd decided to live for my work, but... My favorite ASMR streamer is a junior colleague who sits next to me, so I ended up helping him practice to increase his views!!! Is it really okay for me to take on such an important role, that my favorite streamer will use my reactions to improve his stream?!

"Secret Practice Just for the Two of Us" was started to support my favorite streamer's views, and the first episode is a massage that starts with the ears, or is this...?! Is this...?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 推しが、今日も眠らせてくれません
title.romaji: Oshi ga, Kyou mo Nemurasete Kuremasen

title.native: まよなかミクソロジー

synonyms: With the Alpha Childhood Friend I Despise

202872.description:
There was a time when, overflowing with love, I let myself run wild without a thought for the other person's feelings or the people around us, and soon enough my love crashed and burned. Traumatized by this, I've now developed a bad habit of avoiding anyone I have eyes for, to keep my affection from showing. Then one day, my coworker invited me out to a bar, where I met Sawaguchi and fell in love with him at first sight - but thanks to my avoidant tendency, I ended up making him hate me... No matter how many times I reflect and repent, I just can't get this bad habit of mine to change. I want to be able to say "I love you" to the person I love! With my conviction made, I set out to see a counselor, but there I find none other than-?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: 三ツ島さんはスキが言えない

202873.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Yeonjeong Danpyeonseon (연정 단편선) Collection.

202874.description:
When a global blackout wipes out electricity overnight, shut-in inventor Ori Kenshi finds his carefully isolated life in the mountains of Okutama turned upside down. A mechanical genius who prefers machines to people, Kenshi once made a quiet living crafting intricate devices and anime weapons from his workshop. But when a meteor crashes into his garden during the outage, he carves it into a wand just to pass the time—only to discover that the meteors which destroyed the world’s power grids have unleashed something else entirely: magic. As civilization collapses and chaos spreads, Kenshi’s handmade wand might be the key to a new kind of power. Now this reluctant loner must step beyond the safety of his workshop and use his unusual talents to survive in a world where technology is gone and magic has taken its place.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 崩壊世界の魔法杖職人

202875.description:
In order to shake off the hurt of being cheated on by her now ex-boyfriend, Hana goes on a trip with her best friend Mizuki. At their destination, the two meet a pair of guys, but just as they've started to get to know each other, it dawns on Hana that her troubles are the result of her own too-sweet personality. Now determined to better herself, Hana sets out to change her pushover ways...?!
