This is the hapless love story of a clumsy quartet: Hana, who's always sacrificing herself for others; Mizuki, who only wants to be loved; Narita, who earns others' ire when he tells them blunt truths; and Ayumu, who is kind, but also something of a playboy. Can the four of them get their acts together long enough to avoid stumbling over themselves?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: 僕らは恋がヘタすぎる
title.romaji: Bokura wa Koi ga Heta Sugiru

202876.description:
Eun-Sul spends her days doing bookkeeping for a loan office in a rundown part of town. Her quiet routine is upended when the dangerously charming Woo-Kyung Choi suddenly takes an interest in her. He offers to take care of the men making her life difficult—but his help comes with strings attached.

(Source: Manta)

202877.description:
She doesn't know how it feels to be in love, and her body can't bear children, but that doesn't mean she doesn't want a perfect family like the ones you see on TV! And who should appear before down-on-her-luck, marriage-crazy Sachiko, but Keiichi! He's got looks and money to spare, and most importantly, he accepts all of Sachiko's conditions! But Keiichi's got secrets of his own...

Can Sachiko overcome these hurdles to obtain the happy home she's dreamed of?!

(Source: Manga Plaza, translated)

title.english: Who Needs Love? I Just Wanna Get Hitched!
title.native: 恋はないけど、結婚します！
title.romaji: Koi wa Nai Kedo, Kekkon Shimasu!

title.native: イナズマイレブン 英雄たちのヴィクトリーロード
title.romaji: Inazuma Eleven: Eiyuutachi no Victory Road

202879.description:
Is this love a dream come true? Or is it the beginning of a nightmare? From cheating, to gold-digging, to dangerous cults, Satoru is a man so unlucky in love that every woman he's ever fallen for has betrayed him. He decides that if he's only capable of falling in love with wicked women, he might as well go with the marriage match his parents have picked out for him. But one look at Michiru, the woman they've set him up with, and Satoru is head-over-heels. And that can only mean one thing...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: This Love Is The Start Of My Nightmare
title.native: この恋は地獄のはじまり
title.romaji: Kono Koi wa Jigoku no Hajimari

202880.description:
Seo-Yeon has lived next door to Doha most of her life. They went from childhood friends to lovers, but Doha's betrayal made Seo-Yeon leave him. They're home from university, and Doha won't leave her alone. Seo-Yeon doesn't want to like him after all she went through, but can she stay strong?

(Source: Manta)

202881.description:
Komachi Sakanoue, 20 years old. Ten days into a new part-time job and can't follow directions. But, come on, I'm so curious... I just have to know more about that man in the special seat by the window, where the sunlight hits... - The cafe where I work has a long-time regular, a comic book artist who writes a certain popular comic series, and right now I'm pretty obsessed with him. Even the boss getting angry doesn't discourage me from sneaking stealthy peeks as he works. Sure enough, the world flowing from his pen is brimming with love again today. I adore his work, and I adore him, too. I want those listless eyes to be fixed on me. I want to know what he's thinking, and what the world looks like through his eyes. Sir, please, tell me what I have to do to become someone special to you...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: 先生のメガネからみえる優しい世界
title.romaji: Sensei no Megane kara Mieru Yasashii Sekai

202882.description:
Astaroth, the demon of death and war, fell blindly in love with a human man and paid for it with her life. Betrayed and murdered by her lover Enrique, who used her to seize the throne, she is given a second chance by her demon sisters and awakens in the body of Leonarda, Enrique's empress. To reclaim her powers, she must fulfill one cruel condition: drive a dagger through the heart of the one she loves. Falling in love was her ruin, but this time it will be her deadliest weapon.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Scandal of the Empress's Concubines

202883.description:
Living together with a handsome man...no, wait, ghost...?! Yui Yamada's in her second year of high school when her nagging parents are sent overseas to Brazil for work. She was about to rejoice over finally getting to live alone in her very own apartment (yay!!) when she found out there was a ghost already living there...?! But wait, this ghost isn't scary at all... Though he sure is obnoxious! Whether she likes it or not, this ghost whose awful personality puts his handsome face to shame is going to be her roommate from here on out...!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

202885.description:
Hyeon Seong-Min, who has already turned 40, looks around and becomes acutely aware of the reality that he is alone. Hyeon Seong-Min faces a crisis not only in his life but also at work and decides to struggle to find true happiness. It's not too late to reach that age.

(Source: Naver, translated)

202886.description:
"Can't you just tell me you love me?"

Yuna and Naoki are a lovey-dovey couple. But they have a big secret from each other. Yuna's real identity is that of a special police officer on the hunt for werewolves and vampires. Naoki, on the other hand, has been hiding the fact that he is a werewolf. One new moon day, Yuna is suddenly attacked by a vampire, and is saved by a werewolf who is also her enemy...?!

A suspense love story about the fate of the strongest werewolf boy!
synonyms: Say You Love Me, Until a Full Moon

title.native: 愛してるは満月の夜に
title.romaji: Aishiteru wa Mangetsu no Yoru ni

202887.description:
I thought we'd always be together as three, forever…

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: A Wish on the Bones, A Curse on the Stars

title.native: 骨に願いを, 星に呪いを
title.romaji: Hone ni Negai wo, Hoshi ni Noroi wo

202888.description:
Luke Smith is a young police officer in London. One day, he apprehended a criminal belonging to the “Red Dawn” organization, a cult seeking children's blood for rejuvenation...!? A spin-off story depicting Luke's exploits in his prime!!

(Source: Shonen Jump, translated)

title.native: 手とり足とり愛しましょう!

202890.description:
Aruv is a low-ranking demon who was banished from the demon world and came to the human world. His job is to invade humans' dreams, seduce them, and suck out their energy. He despises human women, thinking they're easy to fool, but when he invades Haruko's dream, he finds out that it's actually the fantasy of a BL-loving fujoshi... Meanwhile, Haruko is aware of her desire to "tittle a strong-willed uke," and is in the midst of a pure romance with Nonaka, a junior colleague at work. Humans are complicated!

A strange love triangle between a fujoshi, a handsome demon, and a younger man. Haruko's magical powers are gradually making it difficult for her to distinguish between reality and fantasy. This is a new type of romantic comedy with a touch of horror!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 悪魔は腐女子に逆らえない
あまい三神くんのデキない秘密

synonyms: Working At The Cheat Item Administration Bureau EX

title.native: チートアイテム管理局のお仕事EX 散々ヤラれた後だし、どうせ全部忘れるから、被害者つまみ食いしてもいいよね
title.romaji: Cheat Item Kanrikyoku no Oshigoto EX Sanzan Yarareta Ato Dashi Douse Zenbu Wasureru kara Higaisha Tsumamigui Shitemo Ii yo ne

202897.description:
Bianca, a PR maven, is asked by her ailing grandfather to find a bracelet he once owned. She happily discovers it at an auction, only to be outbid by Liev Dragunov, a mysterious and handsome Russian billionaire. When Bianca begs him for the bracelet, he tells her that he'll give it to her...but only if she'll pretend to be his fiancee and help him become a part of New York society!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 嘆きのエンゲージリング

202898.description:
Hope starts working as a live-in housekeeper as a way of proving her worth to her successful family. Upon arriving at the mansion, she's surprised to meet Ralph Browne, the owner of the estate. He was the boy who tore her dress in the middle of the dance floor in high school! Now she has to live with him? And on top of that, he won't stop whispering sweet nothings in her ear!

(Source: Renta!)

202899.description:
Sorrel is a mature, sophisticated woman who lives in an expensive apartment in London. Eight years ago, she fell in love at first sight with Ellis. But after leading her on, he mercilessly rejected her. That experience made her wary of people and has hindered her from living a normal life. Though that pain is now in the past, she refuses to fall in love ever again. But then she runs into Ellis...

(Source: Renta!)

202900.description:
Grace works for a charity group that volunteers at an orphanage in Africa. While she's vacationing in the Algarve, she hears that Marco Aguilar, a famous billionaire who was apparently an orphan before becoming successful, is returning home to the Algarve for work. Grace expects Marco to show concern for the kids in Africa and agree to donate to the orphanage, but instead Marco accuses Grace of trying to expose his past. Eventually, he decides to offer her a large donation for the orphanage, but he wants her to spend the rest of her vacation with him in exchange...

(Source: Renta!)

202901.description:
Sophie, Clive and Alonso had been best friends since high school. Shy and reserved, Sophie chose and married Clive over the fiercely passionate and dangerously attractive Alonso. But her marriage with Clive didn't last long before he was tragically murdered. Racked with guilt, Sophie decides to go to Brazil, his final resting place, but Alonso follows her there. With the same dangerous eyes as before, he looks at her and declares, "You need me."

(Source: Renta!)

202902.description:
After spending a night with playboy billionaire Ramsay against her better judgment, Nola is overwhelmed with regret and runs away from him. Three months later, she finds out she's pregnant and is resolved to raising the child on her own. However, Ramsay finds out and takes Nola to his mansion in a fit of rage. "Marry me," he demands, the proposal coming out like an order. In retaliation against his selfish and arrogant attitude, Nola vehemently refuses. But Ramsay is determined they marry...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 大富豪とうたかたの蜜月　愛のない結婚なんて

title.native: 大富豪とうたかたの蜜月

synonyms: The Abandoned Prince Treats an Enemy Soldier on the Frontline, but It Turns Out She’s the Seventh Princess

title.native: 捨てられ王子が最前線で敵国の兵士を治療したら実は第七皇女だった件
title.romaji: Suterare Ouji ga Saizensen de Tekikoku no Heishi wo Chiryou Shitara Jitsu wa Dainana Oujo Datta Ken

title.native: 捨てられ王子が最前線で敵国の兵士を治療したら実は第七皇女だった件
title.romaji: Suterare Ouji ga Saizensen de Tekikoku no Heishi wo Chiryou Shitara Jitsu wa Dainana Oujo Datta Ken

synonyms: I Was Found to Be Competent By a Heroic Female Knight and Lead a Beautiful Harem of Knights.

title.native: 英雄女騎士に有能とバレた俺の美人ハーレム騎士団 ガイカク・ヒクメの奇術騎士団
title.romaji: Eiyuu Onna Kishi ni Yuunou to Bareta Ore no Bijin Harem Kishidan: Gaikaku Hikume no Kijutsu Kishidan

202907.description:
When Princess Galila of the Kingdom of Khalia is summoned to her brother's office, she is shocked to see who's there. It's the man who had kindly comforted her the night before, leaving her with a precious kiss. Her delight in seeing him again is short-lived, though. He is Sheikh Karim of Zyria and he's there to ask for her hand in marriage. It all feels too sudden, but there's a secret held by the royal family...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 獅子王は惜しみなく奪う

202908.description:
Young nurse Adele can't help but notice surgeon Zahir. Not only is he drop-dead gorgeous, he's also a crown prince! When the queen takes a liking to Adele, she whisks her off to the golden desert to be her attending nurse. Seeing Zahir in his full royal glory makes Adele realize just how different their worlds are, but under the desert sun, the spark between them only burns brighter... She loves him, but he's set to marry a princess from a neighboring country. How could this possibly end well?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 砂漠の魔法に魅せられて

202909.description:
Romance novelist Kristin is struggling to recover from a heartbreak that has caused her severe writer's block. Her mother tries to help her out by taking her to an auction where guests can bid on dates with single men. Although Kristin should feel indifferent to these sorts of things, when a talented campaign advisor named Perry takes the stage, she feels her heart skip a beat. Without thinking, she stands up and bids on him for ten thousand dollars! The two of them lead completely different lifestyles. How will their special night end?

(Source: Renta!)

202910.description:
Seeking a fresh start in life, Abigail finds a job as a live-in nurse and travels from London to the Netherlands. It's at her employer's residence that she meets Dominic van Wijkelen, the dashing doctor-handsome but grumpy, cold yet alluring. Abby senses that he hates her and maintains her distance from him, but when her current job ends, van Wijkelen approaches her with a job offer. Perplexed, Abby accepts-and finds him smiling brilliantly. Didn't he hate her? What does that smile of his mean?

(Source: Renta!)

202911.description:
Daisy attended a party where she felt out of place, so she stayed quietly in a corner, feeling miserable. After an unknown man treated her kindly, she began harboring a crush on him. A few days later, she is helping her father out at his antiques shop, and the same man appears! The man is a Dutchman named Jules, a doctor with a fiancee, so Daisy's love was quickly squashed. Disappointed, she had to bring an antique that was his family's treasure to his home in the Netherlands, but she never expects their a reunion to be like this!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: デイジーの小さな願い

202912.description:
To gain some good publicity for his book tour, sex therapist Dylan agrees to pair up with Grace, another sex therapist, for a showdown on a TV show. However, the night before the show, he accidentally walks in on her in the middle of a shower! He has always promoted abstinence, so there's no way he can lose to a therapist who always calls men beasts. And yet, he can't get her out of his head. Is this battle going to start with him losing to the attractive, dazzling woman who has him so captivated?

(Source: Renta!)

202913.description:
Prior to her impending arranged marriage to a grand duke, Allegra goes to a masquerade ball. She figures it'll be the last party she attends as an unmarried woman and is eager to let herself go. Then a man dressed up as the God of Death appears before her. The attraction between them is undeniable, and before Allegra can stop to think through the consequences, she loses her virginity to the masked stranger. A few weeks later, she discovers that she's pregnant and is shocked to find out the identity of the mysterious man. It was Cristian Acosta, her brother's best friend...and the man who caused her to have an inferiority complex. She can't believe that the arrogant Spanish duke is the father of her child...

(Source: Renta!)

202914.description:
Katherine has just been given a death sentence. Thus, she decides that she will go out with a bang. She moves to the city of her dreams, London. There amid high society, she gets all dressed up and puts on the performance of her life. But she didn't expect to fall in love for the first and last time... His name is Dominic Duvall, a handsome and successful businessman from a famous family who is wanted by every woman alive. But Katherine has only a bit of time left. She has no choice but to turn down his proposal. Who would have thought that six years later she would not only still be alive, but that she would run into him in the most unexpected of situations...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 半年だけのシンデレラ

202915.description:
Gina has been married to her wealthy, handsome husband, Reid, for seven years. They were blessed with adorable children and supposedly living a happy life as a married couple. But then Gina started to suspect that her husband was cheating on her, and it left her in a state of indecision... Now, to make matters worse, her husband has announced the unthinkable?he and his secretary are heading off on a business trip. The worst part is they'll be staying in the same suite! Has his heart moved on from Gina to another woman? In order to win him back, Gina's going to take drastic measures that will shock even her!

(Source: Renta!)

202916.description:
"For the first time in six years, I'll be coming home...to witness your marriage to the duke." The long-awaited letter that young Evelyn received from Sam didn't contain the answer she was hoping for. When she was fifteen, Sam was her first kiss and her first love. But she can only assume it was a goodbye gesture before he left to study medicine overseas. Suppressing her lingering passion, Evelyn decides to try her best to form a new loving relationship with the duke. However, Sam, now a skilled and handsome doctor, struggles with his developing feelings for Eve as he hides a dark secret that will change their relationship forever...

(Source: Renta!)

202917.description:
Pursuing her dream of becoming a designer, Sophie dedicates her life to work. One snowy day, she bumps into dreamy Italian gentleman Marco, who offers her a high-end cashmere coat. For just one night, she lets herself indulge... When she is presented with the opportunity to see the textiles and craftsmanship Venice has to offer, she can't help but say yes, but a little secret threatens to interrupt this vacation...

(Source: Renta!)

202918.description:
Is she falling again for the man who already rejected her once?

Eight years after ending her mismatched marriage with an Italian tycoon, Sienna has finally established a cosmetics company and gained great success. But after reading about her ex-husband getting remarried in the newspaper, she decides to head to their spot to confirm that she no longer has feelings for him. There, she hears a familiar voice calling out to her. It’s her ex-husband, Niko! The newspaper was mistaken, and the one who got married was Niko’s brother. Unable to resist this reunion with Niko, Sienna spends a night of passion with him. Little did she know that she would become pregnant…and face Niko’s rejection once again?

title.native: 愛なき子爵と床磨きの娘
title.romaji: Ainaki Shishaku to Yuka Migaki no Musume

202919.description:
"You don't find me attractive? Then let's break off our engagement."

So said Serena, the daughter of a marquis, to Elliot, her childhood fiancé. He repeatedly broke his promise to escort Serena, and when he showed up to a party with Maribel, the daughter of a duke, who was seducing someone else's fiancé, she finally snapped!

After breaking off their engagement, Serena was able to fully enjoy the fashion she had been holding back on, and she began to rediscover her true self - her narcissistic and slightly bad-tempered self. Then, the second prince, Nox, who is known for hating women, suddenly proposed to Serena -!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 貴方に未練はありません！～浮気者の婚約者を捨てたら王子様の溺愛が待っていました～
title.romaji: Anata ni Miren wa Arimasen! Uwakimono no Konyakusha wo Sutetara Ouji-sama no Dekiai ga Matteimashita

202920.description:
Princess Leila of Surhaadi runs away from home after her mother says that she wished Leila had died instead of her sister. Leila arrives in New York and puts on the clothing and red lipstick her sister left behind sixteen years earlier. She visits the hotel's bar and is fascinated by a mysterious man with a wild aura. After growing up within the walls of a palace, Leila decides to take a brave step. But after giving him her virginity, she's taken aback when he coldly leaves her the next morning!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 一夜に賭けた家なき子
title.romaji: Ichiya ni Kaketa Ie na Kiko

202921.description:
In labor, Lexi is taken the local clinic, where she is shocked to meet the doctor on call. What is Tyler Braden doing here? Not so long ago, after she was fired from her job and, careworn and sad, ran into him outside their apartment building. They spent the night together, but when they woke up in the morning, he declared that he had no desire for a partner, a wife or a child in his life. But now Tyler is delivering his own child! She thinks there is no way he could know the child is his, but then he tries to take the baby away from her!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: はじまりはハプニング

202922.description:
While staying at a very fancy Venetian hotel, Lydia happens to be seated at a table beside Raul Di Savo, a real estate tycoon. He overhears the conversation between her and her stepfather, who plans to use Lydia for a business deal. Lydia is disgusted by the terms and flees the table, but Raul chases her and presents her with an offer she can't refuse. He'll stay with her tonight, but on her terms. She's never had anyone in her life respect her opinions, so why does he?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 嘆きの富豪たちⅠ 愛を授かりしベネチア

title.native: 愛を授かりしベネチア　恋心は投資家に利用される
title.romaji: Ai wo Sazukarishi Venice: Koigokoro wa Toushika ni Riyousareru

202923.description:
The protagonist, Mononobe Asahi, is a first-year high school student who loves the once-popular battle hobby "Battle Pin." He's shy and clumsy, and gets all flustered whenever he talks to people, but he really wants to have a "youthful" experience! Suddenly, Asahi and his partner, Battle Pin Red Sun, find themselves caught up in a war that threatens the very survival of the Earth. Will Asahi be able to have a proper "youthful" experience?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

202924.description:
Margo is determined to never fall in love. Even when Leonidas Marakaios, one of the most gorgeous men in Europe, proposes, she responds with a firm "no." Their playful relationship ends here or so they both thought...until Margo discovers she is pregnant. Because of her childhood trauma, she feels the desperate need to provide her child with a family, something she never had. Three months after the bitter breakup, Margo visits Leo, this time to ask him to marry her. Although doubtful of his ex-lover at first, Leo warms up to the idea of becoming a father and agrees to marriage...except without love.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 新妻物語 Ⅱ マラカイオスの孤独な花嫁

title.native: マラカイオスの孤独な花嫁

202925.description:
The moment Lindsay fell in love with Antonio, a wealthy Greek man, was the moment her tragedy began. After they married, she moved to his country from her humble home in New York, but what greeted her there were the condescending looks of her husband's brothers and sisters. Soon realizing that her husband was never around and focused only on work, Lindsay went back to New York, unable to stand the loneliness. Half a year after leaving, the husband she hasn't heard from all this time suddenly appears before her. If she wants him to agree to a divorce, she'll have to satisfy his demands...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 新妻物語 Ⅰ ギリシア富豪の花嫁の掟

title.native: ギリシア富豪の花嫁の掟
title.romaji: Greece Fugou no Hanayome no Okite

202926.description:
Hawk, a famous movie star, was surprised and angered to see a redheaded beauty suddenly show up at his house. His manager, Donald, was sick in bed with the flu, so this beautiful woman, Rosie, is taking over Donald's duties. For her part, Rosie was in a difficult position: if any one learns her real identity, she'll be taken away. No matter how much Rosie is attracted to Hawk, she just can't let him know who she really is.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: かけがえのない贈り物

202927.description:
Rachel's heart raced as the hardheaded billionaire Giovanni Marcello kissed her suddenly. She'd finally gotten her hands on the man who was supposed to be the most difficult to contact in all of Italy, but she wasn't going to throw away her plans just because of a single kiss. And why should she? She was here to make him recognize that Michael, the child left behind by her sister, was actually a blood relative of the Marcello family. However, it was reckless of young Rachel to go to war against Giovanni. She continues to find both her body and mind toyed with in the determined, sensual trap this beautiful man has set for her...

(Source: Renta!)

202928.description:
Time is wrong. It isn't flowing the way it should.
The person she killed the day before yesterday—their body was already rotting, putrid. But the next day, when she got home, they were standing right there, beaming at her.
What the hell is going on?
My doctor... he promised me. He swore that if I just took the medicine, I would wake up.
Where am I? What is this place?
And you... who are you?

(Source: BiliBili, translated)

202929.description:
Nik Prince is a filmmaker and a Hollywood darling. He's dying to make a film adaptation of a bestselling novel, but the author keeps their identity shrouded in mystery. Nik encounters a beautiful woman named Jinx, who's somehow connected to the author. Determined to do whatever it takes to obtain the rights to the novel, Nik decides to charm Jinx, but she shuts him down right away. Nik refuses to let the issue go, but Jinx has already made up her mind. She hides a sad truth, and she must protect the secretive author!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 華麗なる兄弟たち Ⅰ 永遠のジンクス

202931.description:
Lucy has trapped men with her angelic smile before, but she's put rich, handsome Michael under her spell before she even realizes it. She senses that he is a true prince among all the frogs who've betrayed her in the past. But now that she's fallen for him, all she can hope is that this passionate relationship isn't just a momentary fling...

(Source: Renta!)

202932.description:
Callie works at a hotel in Cape Town. On her way to the welcome party for the new CEO, she gets trapped in an elevator with a handsome stranger in a tuxedo. As they wait to be rescued, they get to talking and she ends up falling head over heels for him. However, when they finally arrive at the party, she realizes that she was trapped in the elevator with the CEO himself! Upon finding out that she's an employee, he suddenly turns cold and walks away. Did he think she was trying to seduce him?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: シンデレラへ最後の贈り物

202933.description:
Eddie has always lived as a prince, hiding her true gender identity. However, when her aide Harold tries to treat her injuries, he strips her and reveals to those around her that she is a woman. Eddie prepares herself for severe punishment, but the king commands her to become Harold's wife!?

This must be an unwanted marriage for Harold! Thinking this, Eddie becomes a bad wife and plots to get a divorce... but contrary to her wishes, she begins a fulfilling married life where Harold dotes on her...!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 男装王女の悪妻計画～旦那様がぜんぜん離婚に応じてくれません～
title.romaji: Dansou Oujo no Akusai Keikaku: Danna-sama ga Zenzen Rikon ni Oujite Kuremasen

202934.description:
Aisling, a headhunter, is hired by the Italian hotel magnate Gianluca. After making a big project a success, Aisling goes to a party at Gianluca's manor and decides to let loose for once. Gianluca keeps gazing at her as though she's prey... It doesn't seem like he'll back off until he makes her his. Aisling knows it's only for one night, but she wants to surrender both her body and her secrets to him...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 星のきらめく夜に　心に、はかない願いを閉じこめて
title.romaji: Hoshi no Kirameku Yoru ni Kokoro ni, Hakanai Negai wo Tojikomete

202935.description:
Schoolteacher Elisabeth falls in love the moment she first sees Angus, a guest cooking instructor at her school. Due to her wounds from a past relationship, she knows his dreamy good looks and confident gray eyes are exactly what she needs to avoid at all costs. Especially since he’s rumored to be a womanizer. While she’s painstakingly trying to suppress her feelings, Angus starts coming on to her… And the more he pursues her, the more she’s ready to give in and be his!

(Source: Harlequin)

synonyms: Move Aside, I'll Be the Magical Girl!
Step Aside I'm The One Becoming The Magical Girl

title.native: 起开，这个魔法少女我来当
title.romaji: Qikai, Zhege Mofa Shaonü Wo Lai Dang

202937.description:
"Chairman Kito, are you looking at my boobs?!"

While pondering something on the school rooftop, our protagonist, Kito, is suddenly told some shocking words by a female student. What is the reason for the protagonist's brooding, and what does the girl really mean? And... will she see his boobs?! A slightly naughty coming-of-age comedy!!

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

202938.description:
Lady Amira's strict earl father decided her marriage to a man she'd never met. She refuses the arrangement by escaping out her bedroom window and almost falls... As she clings onto the edge of the windowsill, she decides she'd rather die than be trapped in her cage. That is until handsome Sheikh Adir comes to her rescue. The two feel an instant deep connection and Adir promises Amira he'll come back for her. Four months later, on the day of her wedding, Adir finally returns and takes Amira away, but for some reason he feels different from before... He tells Amira he only rescued her to humiliate her fiance! Not only that, but he takes her to his kingdom and asks her to be his mistress!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 授かったのは、王家の秘密
title.romaji: Sazukatta no wa, Ouke no Himitsu

202939.description:
Immorality and two-timing can't work with love. She was enjoying her job and she was hoping to go to heaven by herself... Soumei Saya, 26 years old (unmarried) is that kind of woman. And then she'll bought an apartment at the mansion "Hitori-sama." She always thought that becoming an OL is the way to become a woman. that's why she was confident about her future... but then some problems happened! That's because of her colleague Kujou Aoi... he's too confident and a problematic person... and he's also the owner of her mansion...

Note: Includes one extra chapters.

202940.description:
Faith decided to work as a manager at Rose Cottage, a seaside villa. However, Lady Sunny, the villa owner, only wants to talk about the wonders of marriage and doesn't explain the job to her. Faith is not interested in marriage at all and is very suspicious of Harry, the man of the house... He keeps trying to interfere with Faith's work. Why does the extremely attractive Harry suddenly find himself worrying about her?

(Source: Renta!)

202941.description:
Since her husband's death, Rose has been living quietly in a small town. One day the handsome lawyer Sam Horton appears in her neighborhood and disrupts her peaceful life. Even though he treats her like a child and pesters her, Rose can't help but be drawn to him and his daughter. Still, haunted by her past marriage, she tries to push Sam away. However, unbeknownst to Rose, Sam isn't interested in her only out of attraction. He's on a secret mission...

(Source: Renta!)

202942.description:
In addition to the titular series includes the following one-shots:
- Fuuka-sou Hakubutsuki (風化荘博物記)
- Kaseki Onna (化石女)
- Akai Kiri no Lorelai (赤い霧のローレライ)
- Simba (シンバ)

202944.description:
At the hotel where Lucy works as a waitress, she's been asked to handle refreshments for a business meeting. When so many bodyguards appear, though, she wonders just who could be coming! The person who appears brings her heart to a standstill. It's Jax, the multimillionaire who cast her aside two years ago as if she were a dirty rag. She's a bundle of nerves, but he shows no sign of wanting to see her. Feeling foolish, Lucy realizes she shouldn't have expected anything from him. Once the meeting wraps up, Jax calls for her, but she has something she must tell him...about the life they brought into the world!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 愛に屈したギリシア富豪

synonyms: プリーズ セーブ ミー 神父サマ!

title.native: please save me 神父サマ！

202947.description:
After losing both her job and her work due to the schemes of the PD she worked with, Yeonwoo learns the truth and faces death from a heart attack. She thought her life was ending there, but when she opens her eyes, she finds herself back to her youngest writer days 20 years ago. Can this second chance at life turn into a successful one unlike before? The story of Yeonwoo, the youngest writer in broadcasting with a career-oriented perspective, begins anew.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: 放送作家の人生やり直し

202948.description:
Isaki, my boss here, is known as an elite because of his excellence, but he's so intimidating that he doesn't have a good reputation with everyone (even though he's not angry...). I was one of those people who was intimidated by Isaki... but then something happened that changed my perception of him. One day, Isaki found out about my side job as a BL doujinshi writer! This is bad... I'll get in trouble...! But Isaki's reaction was unexpected...!? The secret office love story between a BL writer and a rotten boy boss begins ♥

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 腐男子上司・伊佐木さんとの腐思議な恋
title.romaji: Fudanshi Joushi: Isaki-san to no Fushigi na Koi

202949.description:
"I have awakened to true love!" With these words, Adeline, the daughter of a duke, is broken off from her engagement by the prince. While the prince and the baron's daughter live happily together, Adeline is imprisoned and then murdered. When she wakes up, she finds herself reincarnated as their daughter, Princess Cecilia! Vowing revenge, Cecilia Adeline teams up with her brother-in-law from her previous life, the ice prince Elvis. At first, they think it's just a simple cooperative relationship, but gradually, something starts to change about him --!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 毒親に復讐したい悪役令嬢は、契約婚約した氷の貴公子に溺愛される
title.romaji: Dokuoya ni Fukushuu Shitai Akuyaku Reijou wa, Keiyaku Konyaku Shita Koori no Kikoushi ni Dekiai Sareru

202950.description:
Chubby, berated, and belittled by his younger co-workers, Rentaro, a 45-year-old man, yearns for the chance to relive his glory days from high school. "If only I could have one more shot... my life wouldn't be this way..." Despite his claims of past popularity, his colleagues find it hard to believe. Then, one miraculous day, Rentaro finds himself thrust back into his high school years. Could this be his chance to rewrite history and regain his former status? However, his excitement is short-lived when he realizes he's not inhabiting his own body, but that of a normal, unassuming girl from his class. As Rentaro grapples with this unexpected twist, he begins to question the true nature of his past popularity... Was it all a lie?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: タイムリープ・アイドル～おじさんはJKになって復讐す～
title.romaji: Time Leap Idol: Oji-san wa JK ni Natte Fukushuusu

202951.description:
The Naito family is suddenly diagnosed with an incurable disease and told they only have one month left to live. When asked if there is anything they want to accomplish before they die, the youngest brother, Tomoya, answers, "revenge." This is the story of a broken family as they try to reconnect before their final moments.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

202952.description:
High school girl Momiji decides to earn money by streaming games to support her older sister, who supports the family. However, after a lucky dip in her first points, she can't level up!? Resigned, Kureha aims to become the strongest at level 1! The unpredictable game streaming of the cute but clumsy high school girl Kureha is about to begin!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: レベル1の最強テイマー ～幸運極振りの初心者ゲーマーはもふもふ軍団を従え最強へ至ります～
title.romaji: Level 1 no Saikyou Tamer: Kouun no Kyokufuri no Shoshinsha Gamer wa Mofumofu Gundan wo Shitagae Saikyou e Itarimasu

202953.description:
As the first prince of my country, I returned to the royal capital for the first time in 10 years after my father, the king, fell ill. When I arrived, I was met with a sight my eyes couldn't believe. The main streets were deserted, the shops were empty, and the fields were overgrown and completely abandoned. After investigating, I discovered that the nobles had apparently started a rebellion. If things continued as they were, the country would be destroyed during my generation...even though I was in a position where I could live in luxury! I would definitely rebuild this country! First, I would gather together the best people. Even if that person was the Demon King... The greatest prince in history? The savior of the kingdom? I was simply making money for myself, but...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 貧乏国家の黒字改革〜金儲けのためなら手段を選ばない俺が、なぜか絶賛されている件について〜
title.romaji: Binbou Kokka no Kuroji Kaikaku: Kanemouke no Tame nara Shudan wo Erabanai Ore ga, Nazeka Zessan Sarete Iru Ken ni Tsuite

title.native: ハイこちら解奇部です
うわばみ姫とノンデリメガネ

202958.description:
Nanai Miguel. She's a stylish woman who's dedicated her heart and soul as a close aide to the Neo Zeon commander in chief. But is she so elegant and amazing on her time off...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: おひとり様のナナイさん
永久追放された聖女、大国の王子の執愛を知る
title.romaji: Eikyuu Uihou Sareta Seijo, Daikoku no Ouji no Toai wo Shiru

title.native: 赤髪エルフのお惣菜屋さん

202962.description:
Would the latest soccer IQ be useful in the Showa era?

Miura Anji travels from the present to 1986, a young soccer kid with exceptional skills and IQ. He must convince his delinquent father, who is one year older than him, to start a soccer team from scratch and achieve good results, or he might disappear altogether!
Fights, youth, family, nostalgia, passion...a raw look at humanity!

title.native: 私と相性良い人、いませんか？
title.romaji: Watashi to Aishou Yoi Hito, Imasen ka?

title.native: ぽりうれたん短編集-艶-
ぽりうれたん短編集-濡-

title.native: ぽりうれたん短編集-淫-
あかつきのヒマリとくま

202970.description:
Every time Lu Meixi, who had a very miserable career in the entertainment industry, still persevered in her efforts to move forward, someone would tell her that life was unfair. Lin Mo, who had a solid family background, always has a casual attitude towards his career in the entertainment industry, but has extremely high talent. So what kind of fighting will happen when "too serious" encounters "too casual"?

(Source: WebComics)

202971.description:
Kawaii girl? Cougar? Party queen? Which type is your dish? Stop worrying about not having a girlfriend and join us to find your sweetheart.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Jiu Xiang Yao Ge Nu Pengyou

202972.description:
Ye Kong traveled through another world, and he could break through a realm every day he fished. In the past ten years, he has broken through to more than 3,000 levels of Qi training. He thought his life would be dull, roasting white tigers and catching phoenixes, but one day, the empress was reborn and came to worship him as her master. Ye Kong: Hey, disciple, can you please stop worrying about me? Empress: No way, no way, my master is practicing Qi, he is just pretending, he can never be a peerless master!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Qi Refining Level 3000: Accept the Empress as Your Disciple
Qi Refining Level 3000: Starting With the Empress as Your Apprentice
Refined Qi for 3000 Levels and Accepted the Empress as His Disciple

title.native: 炼气3000层：开局收女帝为徒
title.romaji: Lian Qi 3000 Ceng: Kaiju Shou Nüdi Wei Tu

202973.description:
A lovely spirit animal from heaven is forced to marry a man? Travelling into another world, the girl actually became an adorable spirit animal and she even offended the cold and kindless prince who wanted to marry her! She thought she put herself under the patronage of a higher-up, it turned out that the new world is filled with danger and conspiracies...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Raise an Animal to Be a Concubine

title.english: Raise A Mink As My Wife

202974.description:
"You're already 30 years old! Women are only appealing when they're still young!" were the cruel words my husband spoke. Masumi and Shinichiro have been maried for seven years. With their five year old daughter, the three of them make up a happy family... Or so it seemed. The last time Shinichiro and Masumi had sex was three years ago. From wife to mother to 30 years old in the blink of an eye. Will Masumi spend the rest of her life simply aging and losing sex appeal? "... I won't stand for this!" Masumi's ready to polish up her charm and salvage her relationship with her husband... But then this...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: So Women Have an Expiration Date?
title.native: 女の期限はいつまでですか？
title.romaji: Onna no Kigen wa Itsu Made desu ka?

202975.description:
Aya (29) and Shota Shinozaki (31) have been married for two years. Recently, they've hit a rough patch due to a disagreement on when to have children. Aya wants to give it more time to prepare for their child financially. Shota on the other hand, is getting impatient, telling Aya she's just overthinking the situation. Needless to say, she's shocked by his unfounded and irresponsible optimism. And as he continues to pressure her, she only grows more disheartened, and a rift forms between her and Shota...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

202976.description:
Magic love story happening in mages’ club makes your heart dokidoki. Who is who’s only belonging?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: My Own Love Only Belongs to Me

1. Kuro Kishi Monogatari: Gaiden (黒騎士物語・外伝) [Motofumi Kobayashi]

8. Stingray wo Sagase!! (スティングレイを探せ!!) [Hiroyasu Hatakeyama]

title.native: タンク・ザ・ヒーロー 鋼鉄の野獣
title.romaji: Tank The Hero: Koutetsu no Nokemono

202979.description:
Masato is a first-year high school boy who is still struggling trying to fit in with his class. He is curious about Rinko, another loner who sits next to him. One day, he accidentally witnesses her secret wishlist, and ends up offering to help Rinko live out the spirited school life of her dreams…

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)
synonyms: Even a Parakeet Wants to Experience Youth

title.native: インコでも青春したい

202980.description:
After overcoming countless obstacles, Sister Elna and the vampire Richter are finally together. Their days are peaceful and filled with love, watched over by their butler Lawrence — but troubles are lurking!?

(Source: MangaPark, translated)

title.native: シスターとヴァンパイア-grace-

202981.description:
“This academy has multiple ‘taboos’—”

Seirin Girls' Academy — a prestigious institution steeped in history, renowned as one of the prefecture's foremost finishing schools for young ladies. Mio Tsujihara, who has just transferred here, finds herself strongly drawn to a figure deemed taboo: Yuka Nekomine. Meeting Yuka will draw Mio into more inexplicable events.

Because… "Yuka Nekomine is dead."

Who was she, really? And what is the secret hidden within this academy where so many brilliant, delicate girls live?
The most terrifying school mystery, filled with unsettling unease and psychological terror!

(Source; Young Animal Web, translated)

title.native: 猫ノ目ゆうかは語るべからず

202982.description:
1. Peppermint Essay (ペパーミント・エッセイ)
2. Mizutama Sherbert no Himitsu (水玉シャーベットの秘密)
3. Rikusei Kurage no Hangyaku (陸棲クラゲの反逆)
4. Twinkle Twinkle (トゥインクル・トゥインクル)

title.native: 水玉シャーベットの秘密

202986.description:
Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn’t quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Demon King Overrun by Heroes
I’m the Demon King, but There Are Too Many Heroes
Le Roi Démon submergé par les héros

title.english: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord

202987.description:
After an accident, Russel Reeve finds himself in a mysterious dimensional space where he's given the chance to choose one “Talent” from a selection of five to survive Mustard City. Expecting a weak ability and an easy mission, he picks what appears to be the weakest option. His task? Finish reading a specific novel.
However, things take a turn when he realizes the novel is incomplete, and worse, it’s based on real murders committed by an uncaught serial killer in Mustard City. Desperate to return to his real life, Russel tracks down the novel’s author, only to learn that the story can’t continue unless the real killer is caught. Now, to complete his mission and survive, Russel must dive into a dangerous game of cat and mouse, where fiction and reality blur, and the final chapter is yet to be written…

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: 竜に育てられた最強～全てを極めた少年は人間界を無双する～
title.romaji: Ryuu ni Sodaterareta Saikyou: Subete wo Kiwameta Shounen wa Ningenkai wo Musou suru

202989.description: Manga anthology based on Fate/Grand Order depicting the glamorous and chaotic daily life of Chaldea, centering on Jeanne [Alter] and Saber Artoria [Alter].
synonyms: Fate/Grand Order: CHAOS TRIP! nipi Works

title.native: Fate/Grand Order CHAOS TRIP! Nipi作品集
title.romaji: Fate/Grand Order: CHAOS TRIP! Nipi Sakuhinshuu

title.native: マリーのアトリエ: ザールブルグの錬金術士
title.romaji: Marie no Atelier: Salburg no Renkinjutsushi

202991.description:
In the new Virtual Reality MMORPG, a new Clan War has begun. The prize: 100 million yen! Since everyone's aiming to be the best, Hayato has been kicked out of his clan. He's chosen crafting skills over combat skills, so will he be stuck without a team? He thought so, until he tried to put an NPC in his clan. Who would have thought, with the right items, it's possible! Cooking, Medicine, Armor, all sorts of crafting is exactly what he needs to make a team of the best NPC's! The result: a maid who loves to eat, a mercenary that loves his sister, a butler with a mysterious past, and many others with their own stories! "You need me on your team! You can die or you can cook for me, the choice is yours!" "Stop that! That's the low HP sound!" Is this team going to be okay? Now begins an RPG fantasy story of the craziest team out there!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Another Frontier Online, How I Made the Best NPC Team
title.native: アナザー・フロンティア・オンライン~生産系スキルを極めたらチートなNPCを雇えるようになりました~@COMIC
title.romaji: Another Frontier Online Seisankei: Skill wo Kiwametara Cheat na NPC wo Yatoeru You ni Narimashita @COMIC

title.native: アナザー・フロンティア・オンライン~生産系スキルを極めたらチートなNPCを雇えるようになりました
title.romaji: Another Frontier Online Seisankei: Skill wo Kiwametara Cheat na NPC wo Yatoeru You ni Narimashita

202993.description:
Area 11, or Japan, is occupied by the superpower, the Holy Britannian Empire. Two boys live there: Mario Diesel and Lelouch Lamperouge. While Japanese people are oppressed as Elevens, Mario lives his school life hiding the fact that he is half Britannian and half Japanese. Lelouch lives his days as the vice president of the school's student council, hiding his true identity as the prince of Britannia. The destinies of these two people who never crossed paths intersect due to a certain incident, and a story of revenge and rebellion begins.

(Source: JumpToon, translated)
synonyms: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion Lost Stories

title.native: コードギアス　反逆のルルーシュ　ロストストーリーズ
title.romaji: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch - Lost Stories

202994.description:
My little sister is a goddess.
Just recently, she became someone who could be called that. If I were to say this to most people, they would probably laugh it off as a silly joke. Or perhaps they would notice the seriousness in my eyes and hurriedly run away. Honestly, I would probably react the same way if someone else said such a thing. That’s why I never do anything foolish like announcing it to everyone around me.

But this is the truth. Even if no one believes me, it is real.

My little sister, Yui Tōmi, who once lost her life in a maritime accident, became a goddess about two weeks ago—after a series of complicated events. These circumstances are long and convoluted. Explaining them to anyone not directly involved would hardly make sense.

And now, I live in this world as an ordinary human with no powers, alongside Magical Girl Alyssa Clarno-Stolling Light. Conversations at the start of a new daily life, or words exchanged at the end of the extraordinary—one could call it an infinite intersection.

At t

he place where twisted lines overlap—

The new series of the popular work RIGHT×LIGHT finally begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

202995.description: Year 4, Kouwa era. After "The Day of Miracles," large-scale conflicts between nations ceased, and the world enjoyed a period of peace. However, conflict was not entirely eradicated. Seeds of conflict inevitably sprouted, sown by those who could not survive without conflict, those who sought wealth through conflict, and those who simply desired conflict. An organization existed to nip these seeds of conflict in the bud and prevent conflicts from escalating. Its name is "Izayoi," a secret agency established by Sumeragi Kaguya, who once served as chairman of the United Federation of Nations. Hakuba Sōga, a member of Izayoi, as Agent Shinigetsu, along with his assistant Satori, is tasked with pursuing the mysterious black Nightmare Frame, Pure Elements G.

title.native: コードギアス新潔のアルマリア

202996.description: A unique compilation of Panpanya's work that was published in 1-gatsu to 7-gatsu. Including manga, travel essays, and other self published material.

title.native: チャックび～んず　2巻発売記念特別編

202998.description:
"I give you all permission to kill everyone here in order to earn the right to die."

To those who wish to go to heaven, kill each other and be the last one standing to survive. This place is called the "school", which lies between the world of the living and heaven. The group of 11 comprised of boys and girls are suddenly forced to participate in a death game hosted by someone who calls themselves "Sensei"! This school decides who dies and who doesn't. Only the person surviving at the end of the game can go to heaven. If one wants to die, they have to kill everyone else. Everyone has their "reasons of wanting to die", but who will be the last one remaining in this corrupted game...?!

(Source: Comikey)

title.english: A Game for the Dead: Those Who Crave Death Must Survive
title.native: 死願者ゲーム －死にたい奴は、生き残れ－
title.romaji: Shinegaisha Game Shinitai Yatsu wa, Ikinokore
